cues.en: Stewart and his team put out several issues of The Whole Earth Catalog, and then, when it had run its course, they put out a final issue.
cues.zh: 斯图尔特和他的团队出版了几期《全球概览》，然后，当它完成使命后，他们出版了最后一期。

cues.en: It was the mid-1970s, and I was your age.
cues.zh: 那是70年代中期，我那时和你们一样大。

cues.en: On the back cover of their final issue was a photograph of an early morning country road, the kind you might find yourself hitchhiking on if you were so adventurous.
cues.zh: 在他们最后一期的封底是一张清晨乡村道路的照片，那种如果你足够冒险可能会搭便车的那种。

cues.en: Beneath it were the words: Stay hungry, stay foolish.
cues.zh: 下面是这样一句话：求知若饥，虚心若愚。

cues.en: It was their farewell message as they signed off.
cues.zh: 这是他们告别时的留言。

cues.en: Stay hungry, stay foolish.
cues.zh: 求知若饥，虚心若愚。

cues.en: And I have always wished that for myself.
cues.zh: 我一直希望自己能如此。

cues.en: And now, as you graduate to begin a new, I wish that for you.
cues.zh: 现在，当你们毕业开始新的生活，我也希望你们能如此。

cues.en: Stay hungry, stay foolish.
cues.zh: 求知若饥，虚心若愚。

cues.en: Thank you all very much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢大家。

material.title: 特朗普 · 西点军校毕业演讲
material.subtitle: 英文原声 · 双语字幕 · 完整演讲

cues.en: Well, I want to thank you very much. This is a beautiful place. I've been here many times.
cues.zh: 嗯，非常感谢大家。这是一个美丽的地方。我来过这里很多次了。

cues.en: Going to high school, not so far away. Good, a good place. Also a military academy.
cues.zh: 去上高中，离这里不远。好，一个好地方。也是一所军事学院。

cues.en: Not quite of this distinction, but it was a lot of fun for me.
cues.zh: 不完全是这种区别，但对我来说很有趣。

cues.en: And I just want to say hello cadets, and on behalf of our entire nation.
cues.zh: 我想说，学员们你们好，并代表我们整个国家。

cues.en: Let me begin by saying congratulations to the West Point class of 2025. You are winners, every single one of you.
cues.zh: 首先我要祝贺西点军校2025届毕业生。你们都是赢家，你们中的每一个人。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: And now we want you to relax. And I'm supposed to say, at ease.
cues.zh: 现在我们希望你们放松。我应该说，请坐。

cues.en: But you're already at ease. You're at ease because you've made a great choice in what you're doing.
cues.zh: 但你们已经很放松了。你们很放松，因为你们在做的事情上做出了一个伟大的选择。

cues.en: Your choices in life have been really amazing.
cues.zh: 你们的人生选择一直都很棒。

cues.en: So this is a celebration, and let's have a little fun.
cues.zh: 所以这是一个庆祝活动，让我们开心地玩一会儿。

cues.en: I want to thank your highly respected superintendent, General Stephen Gilland, and he is really, uh, something.
cues.zh: 我想感谢你们备受尊敬的校长，史蒂芬·吉兰德将军，他确实是，呃，不一般。

cues.en: I got to know him backstage with his beautiful family, and his reputation, his wife is just incredible.
cues.zh: 我在后台认识了他和他美丽的家人，他的声誉，他的妻子简直令人难以置信。

cues.en: His reputation is unbelievable, and thank you very much. And your daughter is a winner also, just like everybody out there.
cues.zh: 他的声誉是不可思议的，非常感谢。你的女儿也是一位赢家，就像在座的各位一样。

cues.en: Real winner. Thank you. Thank you.
cues.zh: 真正的赢家。谢谢。谢谢。

cues.en: I also want to thank your Commandant General R.J. Garcia, Secretary of the Army Dan Driscoll.
cues.zh: 我还想感谢你们的指挥官R.J.加西亚将军，陆军部长丹·德里斯科尔。

cues.en: Army Chief of Staff General Randy George, Senator Ashley Moody.
cues.zh: 陆军参谋长兰迪·乔治将军，参议员阿什利·穆迪。

cues.en: Representatives Steve Womack, Bill Huizenga, Pat Ryan, Mark Green, Keith Sell.
cues.zh: 众议员史蒂夫·沃马克、比尔·惠曾加、帕特·瑞安、马克·格林、基思·塞尔。

cues.en: Acting U.S. Attorney Alina Habba, and very much, just all of the friends.
cues.zh: 代理美国检察官阿丽娜·哈巴，以及非常多的，就是所有的朋友们。

cues.en: We have a lot of friends in the audience today, and I just want to thank them all for being here.
cues.zh: 今天我们有很多朋友在观众席上，我只想感谢他们所有人的到来。

cues.en: We have a tremendous amount of my friends. They wanted to come up and they wanted to watch this ceremony, and they wanted to watch you much more so than me.
cues.zh: 我有非常多的朋友。他们想上来，他们想观看这个仪式，他们比想看我更想观看你们。

cues.en: So I just want to thank so many people are here.
cues.zh: 所以我想感谢很多人都在这里。

cues.en: Over the past four years, an extraordinary group of professors, teachers, coaches, leaders, our warriors have transformed this class of cadets into an exceptional group of scholars and soldiers.
cues.zh: 在过去的四年里，一群非凡的教授、教师、教练、领导者，我们的战士们将这批学员变成了杰出的学者和士兵。

cues.en: And so let's give the entire group, the entire West Point faculty, the staff, for their incredible love of you and outstanding devotion to the core.
cues.zh: 所以让我们为整个团队，整个西点军校的教职员工，为他们对你们难以置信的爱和对核心的杰出奉献，鼓掌。

cues.en: Let's give them a little hand.
cues.zh: 让我们给他们一点掌声。

cues.en: And importantly, we can't forget all of those people beaming with pride. Look at them in the audience.
cues.zh: 重要的是，我们不能忘记所有那些洋溢着自豪感的人们。看看他们，在观众席上。

cues.en: So proud. They're in the stands.
cues.zh: 如此自豪。他们在看台上。

cues.en: So thank your parents, your grandparents, and family members who made this all possible for you.
cues.zh: 所以感谢你们的父母、祖父母和家人，是他们让这一切成为可能。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: And I think they must have done something right based on what I'm looking at.
cues.zh: 我想他们一定做对了什么，根据我所看到的。

cues.en: America loves our military moms and dads. Nearly one-third of the cadets graduating today are themselves the children of veterans.
cues.zh: 美国爱我们的军人父母。今天毕业的学员中，近三分之一本身就是退伍军人的子女。

cues.en: So to everyone with us this morning, who served, America, in uniform, no matter your age, please stand so we can salute your service.
cues.zh: 所以，今天早上和我们在一起的每一位曾经服役过的人，美国，穿着军装，无论你们的年龄如何，请站起来，以便我们向你们的服务致敬。

cues.en: We'd like to see who you are.
cues.zh: 我们想看看你们是谁。

cues.en: Congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.en: Great job.
cues.zh: 干得好。

cues.en: Every cadet on the field before me should savor this morning, because this is a day that you will remember.
cues.zh: 我面前的每一位学员都应该珍惜今天早晨，因为这是你们将永远铭记的一天。

cues.en: In a few moments, you'll become graduates of the most elite and storied Military Academy in human history.
cues.zh: 几分钟后，你们将成为人类历史上最精英、最负盛名的军事学院的毕业生。

cues.en: And you will become officers in the greatest and most powerful army the world has ever known.
cues.zh: 你们将成为世界上最伟大、最强大的军队的军官。

cues.en: And I know because I rebuilt that army, and I rebuilt the military.
cues.zh: 我知道，因为我重建了那支军队，我重建了军队。

cues.en: And we rebuilt it like nobody has ever rebuilt it before in my first term.
cues.zh: 在我们任期内，我们以前所未有的方式重建了它。

cues.en: Your experience here at West Point has been anything but easy.
cues.zh: 你们在这里的西点军校的经历绝非易事。

cues.en: But you do not come to the U.S. Military Academy for the word easy.
cues.zh: 但你们来美国军事学院并非为了“容易”。

cues.en: You came for excellence, you came for duty, you came to serve your country, and you came to show yourselves, your family, and the world that you are among the smartest, toughest, strongest, most lethal warriors ever to walk on this planet.
cues.zh: 你们是为了卓越，为了责任，为了服务国家而来，你们是为了向自己、家人和世界证明，你们是这个星球上最聪明、最顽强、最强大、最致命的战士之一。

cues.en: Looking out at all of you today, I can proudly say, mission accomplished. Great job.
cues.zh: 今天看着你们所有人，我可以自豪地说，任务完成了。做得好。

cues.en: But now you have to go on.
cues.zh: 但现在你们必须继续前进。

cues.en: You have to forget that.
cues.zh: 你们必须忘记它。

cues.en: Because now you have another.
cues.zh: 因为现在你们还有另一个。

cues.en: It's a sad thing, isn't it?
cues.zh: 这真令人伤感，不是吗？

cues.en: You know, can't rest on your laurels, no matter what.
cues.zh: 你们知道，无论如何都不能沾沾自喜。

cues.en: You just have to keep going. You take it, you take a little day off and you go on to the rest.
cues.zh: 你们只需要继续前进。你们可以休息一天，然后继续前进，因为你们必须一场接一场地取得胜利。

cues.en: Because you have to have victory after victory after victory, and that's what you're going to have as you receive your commissions as second lieutenants.
cues.zh: 你们将获得胜利，而你们将作为少尉接受任命。

cues.en: Each of you continues down the same hallowed path, walked by titans and legends of U.S. military law, giants like Ulysses S. Grant, John "Blackjack" Pershing, and Stormin' Norman Schwarzkopf.
cues.zh: 你们每个人都将沿着同样的圣路前行，这条路曾走过美国军事法律的巨头和传奇人物，如尤利西斯·S·格兰特、约翰·“黑杰克”·潘兴和“风暴”诺曼·施瓦茨科普夫。

cues.en: All great.
cues.zh: 都非常伟大。

cues.en: So many more.
cues.zh: 还有更多。

cues.en: They and countless other patriots before you have walked out of these halls and straight into history, and today you officially join those immortal heroes in proud ranks of the long gray line.
cues.zh: 他们以及你们之前的无数爱国者都曾走出这些大厅，直接载入史册，今天你们正式加入那些不朽的英雄行列，成为那条长长的灰色队伍中的一员。

cues.en: You know that term, so beautiful, the long gray line.
cues.zh: 你们知道那个词，多么优美，“长长的灰色队伍”。

cues.en: Among the 1,000 cadets graduating today, 26 of you wear the prestigious star wreath signifying the highest level of academic achievement.
cues.zh: 在今天毕业的1000名学员中，有26人佩戴着象征最高学术成就的著名星形花环。

cues.en: Please stand up. 26.
cues.zh: 请站起来。26位。

cues.en: Let's see if somebody stands who shouldn't be standing.
cues.zh: 让我们看看是否有人不该站而站了。

cues.en: Congratulations. That's a big honor.
cues.zh: 恭喜。这是一个巨大的荣誉。

cues.en: This class includes an incredible four Rhodes Scholars.
cues.zh: 这一届包括了令人难以置信的四名罗德学者。

cues.en: Stand up, please. Four.
cues.zh: 请站起来。四位。

cues.en: Wow. That's tied for the most of any West Point class since 1959. That's great.
cues.zh: 哇。这追平了自1959年以来西点军校任何一届的最多纪录。太棒了。

cues.en: Congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.en: Boy, oh boy, oh boy.
cues.zh: 天哪，天哪，天哪。

cues.en: I want to bring them right to the Oval Office. I don't want to have them go too far away from me.
cues.zh: 我想把他们带到椭圆形办公室。我不想让他们离我太远。

cues.en: Eight cadets here today took on the challenge of designing their own hypersonic
cues.zh: 今天这里的八名学员接受了设计他们自己的高超音速的挑战

cues.en: Oh, we can use you.
cues.zh: 哦，我们可以用你。

cues.en: We're building them right now.
cues.zh: 我们现在就在制造它们。

cues.en: You know, we, uh, we had ours stolen. We had, we are the designer of it.
cues.zh: 你知道，我们，呃，我们被偷了。我们是它的设计者。

cues.en: We had it stolen during the Obama administration. They stole it.
cues.zh: 它在奥巴马政府期间被盗。他们偷了它。

cues.en: You know who stole it? The Russians stole it.
cues.zh: 你知道谁偷的吗？俄罗斯人偷的。

cues.en: Something bad happened.
cues.zh: 发生了一些不好的事情。

cues.en: But we're now, we're the designer of it and we're now building them and lots of them.
cues.zh: 但我们现在，我们是它的设计者，我们现在正在制造它们，而且数量很多。

cues.en: And earlier this year, they launched it into space setting a world record for amateur rocketry.
cues.zh: 今年早些时候，他们将其发射到太空，创造了业余火箭制造的世界纪录。

cues.en: Can't get you in there fast enough.
cues.zh: 无法让你足够快地进入其中。

cues.en: This class excelled not only mentally but also physically last January when more than 1,000 cadets volunteered for an 18 and a half mile march.
cues.zh: 这个班级不仅在精神上，而且在身体上也表现出色，去年一月，有 1000 多名学员自愿参加了 18.5 英里的行军。

cues.en: On a freezing winter night.
cues.zh: 在一个寒冷的冬夜。

cues.en: Cadet Chris Verdugo completed the task in two hours and 30 minutes flat, smashing the international record.
cues.zh: 学员克里斯·维尔杜戈以整整两小时 30 分钟完成了任务，打破了国际纪录。

cues.en: For the competition by 13 minutes. Where is he? Where is he?
cues.zh: 在比赛中提前了 13 分钟。他在哪儿？他在哪儿？

cues.en: Come up here. Come up here, Chris.
cues.zh: 上来。上来，克里斯。

cues.en: Get up here, Chris.
cues.zh: 上来，克里斯。

cues.en: Wow. Come in.
cues.zh: 哇。进来。

cues.en: By 13 minutes. Come here, Chris.
cues.zh: 提前了 13 分钟。过来，克里斯。

cues.en: I want to see this guy.
cues.zh: 我想见见这家伙。

cues.en: Wow. 13 minutes. That's a huge.
cues.zh: 哇。13 分钟。这太厉害了。

cues.en: Say something. Come in.
cues.zh: 说点什么。进来。

cues.en: It's been a long five years, but I couldn't have done it with any of these guys.
cues.zh: 这漫长的五年，但我不可能和这里的任何一个人一起完成。

cues.en: Love you guys all. Thank you.
cues.zh: 爱你们所有人。谢谢。

cues.en: That's great. Keep it going, Chris. That really is a definition of army strong, isn't it?
cues.zh: 太棒了。继续保持，克里斯。这确实是陆军强大的定义，不是吗？

cues.en: International. International.
cues.zh: 国际的。国际的。

cues.en: This class includes 513 graduates who completed Air Assault School, 70 who completed Airborne School.
cues.zh: 这一届包括 513 名完成了空降突击学校的毕业生，70 名完成了空降学校的学员。

cues.en: Eight who made it through the ultra-elite Army Diver School, among the most difficult and grueling programs anywhere on Earth.
cues.zh: 八名学员完成了极其精英化的陆军潜水学校，这是地球上最艰难、最艰苦的课程之一。

cues.en: That includes the first two women in West Point history to complete Diver School, Cadets Megan Cooper and Clara Saber. Where are you?
cues.zh: 其中包括西点军校历史上首批完成潜水学校的两名女性学员，梅根·库珀和克拉拉·塞伯。你们在哪儿？

cues.en: Stand up.
cues.zh: 站起来。

cues.en: Where are they?
cues.zh: 她们在哪儿？

cues.en: Wow, great job.
cues.zh: 哇，干得好。

cues.en: That is not easy.
cues.zh: 这可不容易。

cues.en: Congratulations, Megan, Clara, that's a job well done. Fantastic.
cues.zh: 恭喜你，梅根，克拉拉，做得好。太棒了。

cues.en: Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢。

cues.en: Some of you achieved a different kind of distinction here at the academy, including seven centurymen who completed 100 hours of marching for disciplinary infractions.
cues.zh: 你们中的一些人在学院取得了不同类型的荣誉，包括七名完成了 100 小时因违纪而行军的百夫长。

cues.en: Oh, no. Infractions.
cues.zh: 哦，不。违纪。

cues.en: No, don't tell me I'm doing this.
cues.zh: 不，别告诉我我得做这个。

cues.en: Oh, I'm so sorry.
cues.zh: 哦，我太抱歉了。

cues.en: Would you like to stand up? I don't know.
cues.zh: 你想站起来吗？我不知道。

cues.en: I think I saw Chris standing up.
cues.zh: 我想我看到克里斯站起来了。

cues.en: Chris, what, what's going on here?
cues.zh: 克里斯，什么，这是怎么回事？

cues.en: Well, you had one good, one not so good, right, Chris?
cues.zh: 嗯，你有一个好的，一个不太好的，对吧，克里斯？

cues.en: Can't believe Chris is standing up.
cues.zh: 真不敢相信克里斯站起来了。

cues.en: But we want everyone to leave here today, Chris.
cues.zh: 但我们希望每个人今天都能离开这里，克里斯。

cues.en: So you're gonna be okay because I'm gonna do something with a clean slate.
cues.zh: 所以你会没事的，因为我要从头开始做点什么。

cues.en: The class of 2025 is a lot to be proud of, including your first rate athletes and athletics. You are something. I've been watching too. I watch, I love the sports stuff. What you've done is pretty amazing.
cues.zh: 2025届毕业生有很多值得骄傲的地方，包括你们一流的运动员和体育项目。你们很了不起。我也一直在关注。我关注，我喜欢体育方面的东西。你们所做的非常了不起。

cues.en: Last year, for the first time ever, Army Lacrosse became the number one ranked men's Lacrosse team in the entire country. Take a look at that.
cues.zh: 去年，有史以来第一次，陆军长曲棍球队成为全国排名第一的男子长曲棍球队。看看这个。

cues.en: Those of you on the team, stand. That's a big honor. Stand.
cues.zh: 在队的队员们，请站起来。这是一个很大的荣誉。站起来。

cues.en: Great. That's a tough sport too.
cues.zh: 太棒了。那也是一项艰苦的运动。

cues.en: That's number one in the country.
cues.zh: 那是全国第一。

cues.en: Your sophomore year, Army Football beat Navy, 2017. And the next year, you did it again, beating Navy 17 to 11.
cues.zh: 你们大二那年，陆军橄榄球队以2017年击败了海军。第二年，你们又做到了，以17比11击败了海军。

cues.en: And dominating Air Force, 23 to 3. But this year, the Black Knights fought your way into the top 20 nationally.
cues.zh: 并以23比3的比分压倒了空军。但今年，黑骑士队在全国排名前20。并取得了你们自1949年以来最长的连胜纪录，在毕业四分卫布莱森·戴利，或者你们称他为美国队长的帮助下。

cues.en: And racked up your longest winning streak since 1949 with the help of graduating quarterback, Cadet Bryson Dally, or as you call him, Captain America. Captain America.
cues.zh: 并取得了你们自1949年以来最长的连胜纪录，在毕业四分卫布莱森·戴利，或者你们称他为美国队长的帮助下。美国队长。

cues.en: Stand up, Bryson. Where's Bryson?
cues.zh: 站起来，布莱森。布莱森在哪里？

cues.en: We got to get him up here, right? Come on, Bryson.
cues.zh: 我们得让他上来，对吧？来吧，布莱森。

cues.en: Man, oh man.
cues.zh: 天哪，天哪。

cues.en: I heard, I heard he's some. Well, I came to a game and he was, I said, he can get into the NFL, can he? But he chose this life.
cues.zh: 我听说，我听说他很厉害。我去看了一场比赛，他当时在场，我说，他可以进入NFL，是吧？但他选择了现在的生活。

cues.en: And you know what? I think he made a good choice. Come on up here, Bryson. Come on up.
cues.zh: 你知道吗？我认为他做出了一个正确的选择。上来吧，布莱森。上来。

cues.en: Go Army Football. Shout out to the Hogs. H4.
cues.zh: 陆军橄榄球队加油。向霍格斯致敬。H4。

cues.en: Can't wait to graduate. Love you guys.
cues.zh: 迫不及待想毕业了。爱你们。

cues.en: I just tapped his shoulders like I hit a piece of steel.
cues.zh: 我刚拍了拍他的肩膀，感觉像拍到了一块钢。

cues.en: Guys are in good shape.
cues.zh: 你们身体真棒。

cues.en: There's a reason, you know? There's always a reason for success. Thank you, Bryson.
cues.zh: 是有原因的，你们知道吗？成功总是有原因的。谢谢你，布莱森。

cues.en: And at a time when other top college quarterbacks were thinking about going pro, Bryson's mind was on something else. As he told an interviewer earlier this year, I'm focused on my career as an infantry officer.
cues.zh: 而在其他顶尖大学四分卫考虑进入职业联赛的时候，布莱森却想着别的事情。正如他今年早些时候告诉一位采访者的那样，我专注于我作为一名步兵军官的职业生涯。

cues.en: That's what he wants to do.
cues.zh: 这就是他想做的。

cues.en: So Bryson, you did the right thing and that service at its finest. Thanks, Bryson.
cues.zh: 所以布莱森，你做对了，这是最棒的服务。谢谢你，布莱森。

cues.en: That's amazing. He's an amazing guy with an amazing team.
cues.zh: 这太棒了。他是一个了不起的人，拥有一支了不起的球队。

cues.en: Each of you on the field today is among the most talented members of your generation. You could have done anything you wanted. You could have gone anywhere. You could have gone to any school.
cues.zh: 今天在场上的你们，都是你们这一代中最有才华的成员。你们可以做任何你们想做的事情。你们可以去任何地方。你们可以去任何学校。

cues.en: This is one of the hardest schools to get into. And writing your own ticket to top jobs on Wall Street or Silicon Valley wouldn't be bad.
cues.zh: 这是最难考入的学校之一。而且自己写一份进入华尔街或硅谷顶尖工作的简历也不会差。

cues.en: Instead of sports teams and spreadsheets and software, you chose a life of service, very important service, instead of stock options.
cues.zh: 你们选择了一种服务的生活，一种非常重要的服务，而不是体育队、电子表格和软件，而不是股票期权。

cues.en: And I do that stuff, it's sort of boring.
cues.zh: 我做那些事，有点无聊。

cues.en: Honestly, compared to what you're doing, it's real boring.
cues.zh: 老实说，和你们所做的相比，它真的很无聊。

cues.en: You chose honor and you chose sacrifice, and instead of business suits and dress shoes, you chose muddy boots and fatigues.
cues.zh: 你们选择了荣誉，选择了牺牲，而不是西装革履，你们选择了泥泞的靴子和军装。

cues.en: keeping yourself in shape because West Point cadets don't just have the brightest minds, you also have the bravest hearts.
cues.zh: 保持体形，因为西点军校的学员不仅头脑最聪明，而且心肠最勇敢。

cues.en: and the noblest souls, you're amazing people.
cues.zh: 以及最崇高的灵魂，你们是了不起的人。

cues.en: I could not be more proud to serve you as your Commander-in-Chief.
cues.zh: 我非常自豪能作为你们的总司令为你们服务。

cues.en: And our country is doing well. We've turned it around very quickly, we've turned it around.
cues.zh: 我们的国家正在好转。我们非常迅速地扭转了局面，我们扭转了局面。

cues.en: I just got back from the Middle East, and I was at, as you know, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, UAE.
cues.zh: 我刚从中东回来，我在，如你们所知，沙特阿拉伯、卡塔尔、阿联酋。

cues.en: And I will tell you, they said, all three leaders, great leaders of those three nations, they all said the same thing.
cues.zh: 我告诉你们，他们说，这三个国家的领导人，伟大的领导人，他们都说了同样的话。

cues.en: The United States of America is hotter now than we've ever seen it, and a year ago, it was as cold as it gets.
cues.zh: 美利坚合众国现在比我们以往任何时候都更热，而一年前，它却像它能达到的最冷一样。

cues.en: And it's true. It's true.
cues.zh: 这是真的。这是真的。

cues.en: We have the hottest country in the world, and the whole world is talking about it, and that's an honor for all of us.
cues.zh: 我们拥有世界上最热的国家，全世界都在谈论它，这对我们所有人来说都是一种荣誉。

cues.en: I cannot wait to see the glory that is still ahead, however, for the West Point class of 2025.
cues.zh: 我迫不及待地想看到仍然在我们面前的荣耀，然而，对于2025届西点军校的学员们来说。

cues.en: And we're going to help you a lot because we're going to give you a nation as good or better than it ever was.
cues.zh: 我们将极大地帮助你们，因为我们将给你们一个和以往一样好甚至更好的国家。

cues.en: That's what I promise you.
cues.zh: 我向你们保证。

cues.en: All the victories that you've had together on these grounds will soon pale in comparison to the momentous deeds that you'll perform.
cues.zh: 你们在这些场地共同取得的所有胜利，与你们将要完成的重大功绩相比，很快就会黯然失色。

cues.en: on the mission you're accepting today, and as the future leader of America's Army.
cues.zh: 在你们今天接受的任务中，以及作为美国陆军的未来领导者。

cues.en: And we have that army geared up. We have ordered, you know, we just went
cues.zh: 我们已经准备好了那支军队。我们已经下令，你知道，我们刚刚进行了

cues.en: one trillion dollar military budget, General. You know that? One trillion.
cues.zh: 一万亿美元的军费预算，将军。你知道吗？一万亿。

cues.en: Some people say, could you cut it back? I said, I'm not cutting
cues.zh: 有些人说，你能削减它吗？我说，我不会削减

cues.en: ten cents. It's another thing we can cut. We can cut plenty of others.
cues.zh: 十分之一。这是我们可以削减的另一件事。我们可以削减很多其他东西。

cues.en: Right, Dan? We can cut plenty of other things.
cues.zh: 对吧，丹？我们可以削减很多其他东西。

cues.en: And you have a good man in Dan, too, General. I think you're gonna find that.
cues.zh: 你也有一个好人丹，将军。我想你会发现的。

cues.en: It's a very different warfare out there today. Now, they've introduced a thing called drone.
cues.zh: 今天的战场非常不同。现在，他们引入了一种叫做无人机的东西。

cues.en: A drone is a little bit different. It makes you have to go back and learn a whole new form of warfare.
cues.zh: 无人机有点不同。它让你必须回去学习一种全新的作战方式。

cues.en: And you're gonna do it better than anybody else. There won't be anybody close.
cues.zh: 你们将比任何人都做得更好。没有人能与之匹敌。

cues.en: Generation after generation, the men and women of the Army have done whatever it takes to defend our flag, pouring out their blood onto the fields of battle all over the world.
cues.zh: 一代又一代，陆军的男女们不惜一切代价捍卫我们的旗帜，将鲜血洒遍世界各地的战场。

cues.en: And all over the world, you're respected like nobody has respected. Our soldiers have sprinted through storms of bullets, clouds of shrapnel.
cues.zh: 在全世界，你们受到前所未有的尊重。我们的士兵冲过子弹的风暴，穿过炮弹的云层。

cues.en: slogged through miles of dirt and oceans of sand, scaled towering cliffs of jagged rock.
cues.zh: 跋涉过数英里的泥泞和沙海，攀登过嶙峋的巨石峭壁。

cues.en: And time and time again, the American soldier has charged into the fires of hell and sent the devil racing in full retreat.
cues.zh: 一次又一次，美国士兵冲入地狱之火，让魔鬼仓皇逃窜。

cues.en: No task has ever been too tough for America's Army. And now, that 250-year legacy of glory and triumph belongs to you.
cues.zh: 对美国陆军来说，没有一项任务是过于艰巨的。现在，那250年的荣耀和胜利的传承属于你们。

cues.en: The 1,000 newest officers of the greatest fighting force in the history of the world, and that's what you are, and that's what you're being thought of again.
cues.zh: 世界上最伟大的战斗部队的1000名新军官，这就是你们，这就是你们再次被と考え的。

cues.en: You are the first West Point graduates of the golden age of America. This is the golden age, I tell you.
cues.zh: 你们是美国黄金时代的第一批西点军校毕业生。这是黄金时代，我告诉你们。

cues.en: And you are going to lead the army to summits of greatness it has never reached before. And you see that. And you see what's happening. You see what's going on in the world.
cues.zh: 你们将带领军队达到前所未未有的伟大高峰。你们看到了这一点。你们看到了正在发生的事情。你们看到了世界正在发生什么。

cues.en: Each of you is entering the officer corps at a defining moment in the army's history.
cues.zh: 你们每个人都将在军队历史上一个决定性的时刻进入军官团。

cues.en: For at least two decades, political leaders from both parties have dragged our military into missions it was never meant to be. It wasn't meant to be. People would say, why are we doing this? Why are we wasting our time, money and souls in some case?
cues.zh: 至少二十年来，两党的政治领导人都将我们的军队拖入了它从未被赋予过的任务。它本不该如此。人们会问，我们为什么要这样做？为什么我们要浪费我们的时间、金钱，有时甚至是生命？

cues.en: They sent our warriors on nation-building crusades to nations that wanted nothing to do with us, led by leaders that didn't have a clue in distant lands, while abusing our soldiers with absurd ideological experiments here at home.
cues.zh: 他们派遣我们的战士去进行国家建设的十字军东征，去那些与我们毫无关系的国家，由那些对遥远国度一无所知的领导人带领，同时在国内用荒谬的意识形态实验虐待我们的士兵。

cues.en: Well, that's ended. You know that. All of it's ended. Ended strongly ended.
cues.zh: 好了，那已经结束了。你们知道的。所有那些都结束了。强有力地结束了。

cues.en: They're not even allowed to think about it anymore.
cues.zh: 他们甚至不允许再考虑这件事了。

cues.en: They subjected the armed forces to all manner of social projects and political causes, while leaving our borders undefended and depleting our arsenals to fight other countries' wars.
cues.zh: 他们让军队参与各种社会项目和政治事业，同时让我们的边境门户大开，并耗尽我们的军火库去打别国的战争。

cues.en: We fought for other countries' borders, but we didn't fight for our own border, but now we do.
cues.zh: 我们为别国的边境而战，但我们没有为我们自己的边境而战，但现在我们会的。

cues.en: Like we have never fought before, by the way.
cues.zh: 就像我们以前从未战斗过一样，顺便说一句。

cues.en: But under the Trump administration, those days are over. We're getting rid of the distractions and we're focusing our military on its core mission: crushing America's adversaries, killing America's enemies and defending our great American flag like it has never been defended before.
cues.zh: 但在特朗普政府的领导下，那些日子已经结束了。我们正在摆脱干扰，并将我们的军队集中于其核心使命：击溃美国的对手，消灭美国的敌人，并像以前从未捍卫过美国国旗一样捍卫我们伟大的美国国旗。

cues.en: The job of the US armed forces is not to host drag shows, to transform foreign cultures, but to spread democracy to everybody around the world at the point of a gun.
cues.zh: 美国武装部队的职责不是举办变装秀，也不是改造外国文化，而是用枪杆子将民主 spread 到全世界的每个人。

cues.en: The military's job is to dominate any foe and annihilate any threat to America, anywhere, anytime, and anyplace.
cues.zh: 军队的职责是主宰任何敌人，并消灭对美国的任何威胁，无论在何地、何时、何处。

cues.en: A big part of that job is to be respected again. And you are, as of right now, respected more than any army anywhere in the world. And that's happening. And I can tell you, you are respected like nobody can believe.
cues.zh: 这项工作的一个重要部分是再次赢得尊重。而你们，从现在起，比世界上任何军队都更受尊重。这种情况正在发生。我可以告诉你们，你们受到了令人难以置信的尊重。

cues.en: As president, I am laser-focused on our core national interests. My preference will always be to make peace and to seek partnership, even with countries where our differences may be profound.
cues.zh: 作为总统，我将激光般地专注于我们的核心国家利益。我的首选将永远是寻求和平与伙伴关系，即使是与那些我们存在深刻分歧的国家。

cues.en: As you know, we're working on a lot of things right now. When I left office four years ago, we had no wars, we had no problems.
cues.zh: 如你们所知，我们现在正在处理很多事情。四年前我离任时，我们没有战争，没有问题。

cues.en: We had nothing but success. We had the most incredible economy, the greatest single greatest economy.
cues.zh: 我们只有成功。我们拥有最不可思议的经济，最伟大的单一最伟大的经济。

cues.en: For a president in history, I think we're going to beat it at this time by a lot, if you want to know the truth.
cues.zh: 对于历史上的总统来说，我想如果我们想知道真相，我们这次将远远超越它。

cues.en: But we had something going on very special.
cues.zh: 但我们当时有一些非常特别的事情在发生。

cues.en: But if the United States or its allies are ever threatened or attacked, the army will obliterate our opponents with overwhelming strength and devastating force.
cues.zh: 但如果美国或其盟友受到威胁或攻击，军队将以压倒性的力量和毁灭性的武力彻底消灭我们的对手。

cues.en: That's why my administration has begun a colossal build-up of the United States armed forces, a build-up like we've never had before.
cues.zh: 这就是为什么我的政府已经开始大规模扩建美国武装部队，这是我们前所未有的扩建。

cues.en: Peace through strength. You know the term. I've used it a lot.
cues.zh: 以实力求和平。你们知道这个词。我用了很多次。

cues.en: Because as much as you want to fight, I'd rather do it without having to fight. I just want to look at them and have them fold.
cues.zh: 因为无论你多么想战斗，我都宁愿不战而屈人之兵。我只想看着他们，让他们屈服。

cues.en: And that's happening. That's happening.
cues.zh: 而且这正在发生。这正在发生。

cues.en: And I've approved a one trillion dollar investment, and that will be again the largest ever in the history of our country.
cues.zh: 而且我批准了一万亿美元的投资，这将再次成为我们国家历史上最大的一笔投资。

cues.en: And we are buying you new airplanes, brand new beautiful planes, redesigned planes, brand new planes, totally stealth planes. I hope they're stealth.
cues.zh: 而且我们正在为你购买新的飞机，全新的漂亮飞机，重新设计的飞机，全新的飞机，完全隐形的飞机。我希望它们是隐形的。

cues.en: I don't know, that whole stealth thing, I'm sort of wondering. You mean if we shape a wing this way, they don't see it?
cues.zh: 我不知道，那个隐形的东西，我有点好奇。你的意思是如果我们这样塑造机翼，他们就看不见它？

cues.en: But the other way they see it, I'm not so sure.
cues.zh: 但另一边他们就能看见，我不太确定。

cues.en: But that's what they tell me.
cues.zh: 但他们是这么告诉我的。

cues.en: We have the best tanks anywhere in the world. We're going to start chip building again.
cues.zh: 我们拥有世界上最好的坦克。我们将重新开始芯片制造。

cues.en: We're going to start ship. We used to build a ship a day.
cues.zh: 我们将开始造船。我们过去每天造一艘船。

cues.en: Now we don't build them anymore. We had a lot of people that didn't know much about getting things built.
cues.zh: 现在我们不再造了。我们有很多不懂得如何制造东西的人。

cues.en: But that's all I've done in my life is build.
cues.zh: 但建造是我一生都在做的事情。

cues.en: We're going to have the best missiles. We already do. Drones, and much, much more.
cues.zh: 我们将拥有最好的导弹。我们已经有了。无人机，以及更多更多。

cues.en: And earlier this week, I think you'll like this, I announced that we are officially building all in America, made in America, designed in America.
cues.zh: 本周早些时候，我想你会喜欢这个，我宣布我们正在全面在美国制造，美国制造，美国设计。

cues.en: We're the only ones that could do it because we're the only ones that with the great technology.
cues.zh: 我们是唯一能做到这一点的人，因为我们是拥有伟大技术的唯一的人。

cues.en: We're building the golden dome missile defense shield to protect our homeland and to protect West Point from attack.
cues.zh: 我们正在建造金色穹顶导弹防御系统，以保护我们的家园并保护西点军校免受攻击。

cues.en: And it will be completed before I leave office.
cues.zh: 而且在我离任前就会完工。

cues.en: And you know, you wouldn't think this, but our enemies are very unhappy about it.
cues.zh: 而且你知道，你可能想不到，但我们的敌人对此非常不满。

cues.en: You've been hearing, you've been reading, why are they doing that? Why?
cues.zh: 你一直在听，你一直在读，他们为什么这样做？为什么？

cues.en: Well, we're doing it because we want to be around for a long time. That's why we're doing it.
cues.zh: 嗯，我们这样做是因为我们想长久地存在下去。这就是我们这样做的原因。

cues.en: We're also restoring the fundamental principle that a central purpose of our military is to protect our own borders from invasion.
cues.zh: 我们还在恢复一个基本原则，即我们军队的一个核心目的是保护我们自己的边境免受入侵。

cues.en: Our country was invaded for the last four years. And they've allowed people to come into our country that shouldn't be.
cues.zh: 在过去的四年里，我们的国家被入侵了。他们允许不该来的人进入我们的国家。

cues.en: They shouldn't be here. Criminals walk in.
cues.zh: 他们不应该在这里。罪犯大摇大摆地进来。

cues.en: No vetting, no check-in, no nothing. Where are they coming from?
cues.zh: 没有审查，没有登记，什么都没有。他们从哪里来？

cues.en: And they were taking people out of prisons, they were taking gang members, they were taking the mentally insane and allowing them to come in.
cues.zh: 他们把监狱里的人放出来，把帮派成员放出来，把精神病患者放出来，让他们进来。

cues.en: And we're getting them out of our country. We have no choice. We're getting them out and bringing them back where they came from.
cues.zh: 我们正在把他们赶出我们的国家。我们别无选择。我们正在把他们赶出去，送回他们来的地方。

cues.en: Have no choice.
cues.zh: 别无选择。

cues.en: And it's not easy.
cues.zh: 而且这并不容易。

cues.en: It's not easy.
cues.zh: 这并不容易。

cues.en: But hopefully the courts will allow us to continue. You know, we had the greatest election victory.
cues.zh: 但希望法院能允许我们继续。你知道，我们赢得了最伟大的选举胜利。

cues.en: This was uh November 5th was we won the popular vote by millions of votes. We won all seven swing states.
cues.zh: 这是呃，11月5日，我们以数百万张选票赢得了普选。我们赢得了所有七个摇摆州。

cues.en: We won everything. We won 2,750 districts.
cues.zh: 我们赢得了所有。我们赢得了2750个选区。

cues.en: Against 505. 2,750 against 505. We had a great mandate.
cues.zh: 对抗505。2750对抗505。我们有一个伟大的授权。

cues.en: And it gives us the right to do what we want to do, to make our country great again. And that's what we're going to do.
cues.zh: 它给了我们做我们想做的事情的权利，让我们的国家再次伟大。而这正是我们要做的。

cues.en: And on day one, I deployed our military to the southern border. And since that day, we've reduced the number of illegal border crossings.
cues.zh: 第一天，我就把我们的军队部署到了南部边境。从那天起，我们减少了非法越境的数量。

cues.en: Where there used to be hundreds of thousands of people coming into our country a day. We had nobody come in.
cues.zh: 过去每天有数十万人涌入我国。我们这里没有人进来。

cues.en: In the last week and a half, we were at 99.99999 percent.
cues.zh: 在过去的一个半星期里，我们达到了99.99999%。

cues.en: 99.99999, I think of that. That was with the help of our military.
cues.zh: 99.99999，我想想看。那是靠我们军队的帮助。

cues.en: We had one person come in.
cues.zh: 我们只有一个人进来。

cues.en: You know why?
cues.zh: 你知道为什么吗？

cues.en: He got very sick, and we brought him through.
cues.zh: 他病得很重，我们把他救了过来。

cues.en: To have him brought to a hospital, one person.
cues.zh: 把他送到医院，一个人。

cues.en: And for that, please don't hold me responsible, but that's okay.
cues.zh: 为此，请不要追究我的责任，但没关系。

cues.en: They did the right thing.
cues.zh: 他们做了正确的事。

cues.en: Gone are the days where defending every nation but our own was the primary thought.
cues.zh: 过去那种保卫所有国家却不保卫我们自己的想法已经一去不复返了。

cues.en: We are putting America first.
cues.zh: 我们把美国放在第一位。

cues.en: We have to put America first.
cues.zh: 我们必须把美国放在第一位。

cues.en: We have to rebuild and defend our nation.
cues.zh: 我们必须重建和保卫我们的国家。

cues.en: And very shortly, you're going to see a nation better than it's ever been.
cues.zh: 很快，你就会看到一个比以往任何时候都更强大的国家。

cues.en: And you see that with the trade, the years we've been ripped off by every nation in the world on trade.
cues.zh: 你看看贸易，这些年来我们被世界上所有国家在贸易上敲诈。

cues.en: We've been ripped off at the NATO level.
cues.zh: 我们在北约层面被敲诈。

cues.en: We've been ripped off like no country has ever been ripped off, but they don't rip us off anymore.
cues.zh: 我们被敲诈的程度是任何国家都无法比拟的，但他们再也不能敲诈我们了。

cues.en: They're not gonna rip us off anymore.
cues.zh: 他们再也不能敲诈我们了。

cues.en: And you're seeing it.
cues.zh: 你正在看到它。

cues.en: You have to watch what we're doing in trade.
cues.zh: 你必须关注我们在贸易方面所做的事情。

cues.en: I know it's not your primary thing.
cues.zh: 我知道这不是你的首要任务。

cues.en: But it's quite important to know fairness.
cues.zh: 但了解公平性相当重要。

cues.en: But watch, you'll see what's going on.
cues.zh: 但请注意，你会看到正在发生什么。

cues.en: You've been reading about it over the last few days.
cues.zh: 过去几天你一直在阅读相关信息。

cues.en: We're making deals with other nations that were not even, nobody thought it would be even possible.
cues.zh: 我们正在与其他国家达成协议，这些协议甚至连没人认为会成为可能。

cues.en: And the reason is very simple, they respect us again.
cues.zh: 原因很简单，他们再次尊重我们了。

cues.en: They're respecting our country again. That's what you want.
cues.zh: 他们再次尊重我们的国家。这就是你想要的。

cues.en: And everything we do, we are bringing common sense back to America.
cues.zh: 我们所做的一切，都是在把常识带回美国。

cues.en: It's all about common sense.
cues.zh: 这都是关于常识的。

cues.en: We can say we're liberal, we're conservative.
cues.zh: 我们可以说我们是自由派，我们是保守派。

cues.en: The new word is progressive, they don't like using the word liberal anymore.
cues.zh: 新词是进步派，他们不再喜欢使用自由派这个词了。

cues.en: That's why I call them liberal.
cues.zh: 这就是为什么我称他们为自由派。

cues.en: But, but...
cues.zh: 但是，但是...

cues.en: But whatever you are, you know, most importantly, you have to have common sense.
cues.zh: 但无论你是谁，你知道，最重要的是，你必须有常识。

cues.en: Because most of it's general, most of it's about common sense when you get right down to it.
cues.zh: 因为其中大部分是普遍的，归根结底，大部分是关于常识的。

cues.en: And we have a lot of people with a lot of, a lot of very smart people, but they have to have common sense.
cues.zh: 我们有很多有才华的人，很多非常聪明的人，但他们必须有常识。

cues.en: And we've liberated our troops from divisive and demeaning political trainings.
cues.zh: 我们已经让我们的部队摆脱了分裂和有辱人格的政治训练。

cues.en: There will be no more critical race theory or transgender for everybody, forced onto our brave men and women in uniform or on anybody else for that matter in this country.
cues.zh: 我们不会再强迫我们勇敢的男女军人或这个国家的任何其他人接受批判性种族理论或跨性别议题。

cues.en: And we will not have men playing in women's sports, if that's okay.
cues.zh: 而且，如果可以的话，我们不会让男人参加女子体育比赛。

cues.en: I mean, I wouldn't want to have to tackle, as an example, Bryson, as a man.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，我不想不得不去擒抱，举个例子，布赖森，作为一个男人。

cues.en: But I don't think a lot of women want to tackle him.
cues.zh: 但我认为很多女人不想擒抱他。

cues.en: I don't think so.
cues.zh: 我不这么认为。

cues.en: How crazy is it? Men playing in women's sports.
cues.zh: 这有多疯狂？男人参加女子体育比赛。

cues.en: How crazy is it?
cues.zh: 这有多疯狂？

cues.en: So ridiculous.
cues.zh: 太荒谬了。

cues.en: So demeaning, so demeaning to women.
cues.zh: 太有辱人格了，太有辱女性了。

cues.en: And it's over.
cues.zh: 而且这已经结束了。

cues.en: That's over.
cues.zh: 这已经结束了。

cues.en: We've ended it.
cues.zh: 我们已经结束了它。

cues.en: And promotions and appointments will not be based on politics or identity, they'll be based on merit.
cues.zh: 晋升和任命将不再基于政治或身份，而是基于功绩。

cues.en: We won that case in the Supreme Court of the United States, we're allowed to go back to a system of merit.
cues.zh: 我们在美国最高法院赢得了那个案子，我们被允许回到基于功绩的体系。

cues.en: We're a merit-based country again.
cues.zh: 我们又是一个基于功绩的国家了。

cues.en: Today, to go back to a system of merit.
cues.zh: 今天，回到基于功绩的体系。

cues.en: We're a merit-based country again.
cues.zh: 我们又是一个基于功绩的国家了。

cues.en: Morale in the armed forces is soaring to the highest levels in many decades after years of recruiting shortfalls.
cues.zh: 在多年的征兵不足之后，军队士气正飙升至数十年来最高水平。

cues.en: That we had years and years of recruiting shortfalls. And just last year was the worst of all.
cues.zh: 我们曾多年征兵不足。而去年是最糟糕的。

cues.en: The last year of the Biden administration.
cues.zh: 拜登政府的最后一年。

cues.en: We couldn't get anybody to join our military.
cues.zh: 我们无法让任何人加入我们的军队。

cues.en: We couldn't get anybody to join our police or firefighters.
cues.zh: 我们无法让任何人加入我们的警察或消防员队伍。

cues.en: We couldn't get anybody to join anything.
cues.zh: 我们无法让任何人加入任何组织。

cues.en: And right now, just less than a year later, we just set a brand new peacetime recruiting record.
cues.zh: 而现在，不到一年之后，我们刚刚创下了全新的和平时期征兵记录。

cues.en: The most, most people joined.
cues.zh: 最多，最多人加入了。

cues.en: We are brimming with confidence and we're brimming with people. We had the most best recruiting month that we've had in memory. Nobody remembers anything like it.
cues.zh: 我们信心十足，人满为患。我们迎来了有史以来最好的征兵月份。没有人记得有过这样的事。

cues.en: And that's all because they have spirit now. They have spirit. They have a spirit for our country.
cues.zh: 这一切都是因为他们现在有精神。他们有精神。他们对我们的国家有精神。

cues.en: And now everybody wants to be doing what you're doing. Think of that.
cues.zh: 现在每个人都想做你们正在做的事情。想想看。

cues.en: So it's really a great honor, I will say. And I'm pleased to report that
cues.zh: 所以这确实是一个巨大的荣誉，我必须说。我很高兴地报告

cues.en: by next week, the army is expected to surpass its recruiting targets for the entire year. Something that hasn't happened in 28 years where we've had that.
cues.zh: 到下周，军队有望超额完成全年征兵目标。这是我们28年来首次实现这一目标。

cues.en: So that's pretty good.
cues.zh: 所以这相当不错。

cues.en: And it's nice to know that you're doing something that everybody wants to do, isn't it?
cues.zh: 很高兴知道你们在做每个人都想做的事情，不是吗？

cues.en: Really nice. It wasn't, I hated to hear that.
cues.zh: 真的很棒。我讨厌听到这个。

cues.en: During the campaign, I was hearing that that they couldn't get people to enlist. But now we're getting people.
cues.zh: 竞选期间，我听到他们说招不到人。但现在我们招到人了。

cues.en: And it's sad because we're telling so many people, I'm sorry, we can't do it.
cues.zh: 令人难过的是，我们告诉很多人，对不起，我们做不到。

cues.en: My administration is doing everything possible to forge the most powerful military ever built. But ultimately, the task of keeping America strong and safe
cues.zh: 我的政府正在尽一切努力打造有史以来最强大的军队。但最终，让美国保持强大和安全的任务

cues.en: in the years ahead is going to belong to you. Among you are the lieutenants, majors, colonels, and generals
cues.zh: 在未来几年将属于你们。在你们中间有少尉、少校、中校和上校，他们将领导军队

cues.en: who will lead the army for the next 10, 20, 30, and even 40 years.
cues.zh: 在未来10年、20年、30年甚至40年里。

cues.en: So as Commander-in-Chief, let me offer a few words of advice as you begin your army careers.
cues.zh: 因此，作为总司令，在我开始你们的军旅生涯之际，请允许我提供几点建议。

cues.en: And I thought I do this and I can make this to a civilian audience or to a military audience, it's pretty much the same.
cues.zh: 我想我这样做，我可以对平民听众或军事听众说，这几乎是一样的。

cues.en: And I did this recently at Ohio State and they really liked it. I gave them a little advice as to what I see for
cues.zh: 我最近在俄亥俄州立大学做了这件事，他们很喜欢。我给他们提供了一些建议，关于我所看到的

cues.en: what you want to do and some tips.
cues.zh: 你们想做什么以及一些技巧。

cues.en: And first of all, and you've already done it, different from civilians, they're making their decision right now.
cues.zh: 首先，你们已经做到了，这与平民不同，他们现在正在做决定。

cues.en: You've already made your decision. I love your decision.
cues.zh: 你们已经做出了决定。我喜欢你们的决定。

cues.en: You have to do what you love. You have to do what you love.
cues.zh: 你们必须做你们热爱的事情。你们必须做你们热爱的事情。

cues.en: If you don't love it, you'll never be successful at it.
cues.zh: 如果你不热爱它，你永远不会成功。

cues.en: And you've done this and you really, many of you in the audience, many of you that are graduating, you come from military backgrounds
cues.zh: 你们已经做到了，而且你们真的，你们中的许多人在听众席上，你们中的许多即将毕业的人，你们来自军人家庭

cues.en: or you love the military. It's what you want to do. It's what you want to talk about.
cues.zh: 或者你们热爱军队。这就是你们想做的事情。这就是你们想谈论的事情。

cues.en: One thing I see about people that love the military, that's all they want to talk about. I'll be out to dinner and generals
cues.zh: 我看到热爱军队的人，他们只谈论军队。我出去吃饭时，将军们

cues.en: if they, if they love their job, usually the only good ones are the ones that want to talk about it all the time.
cues.zh: 如果他们，如果他们热爱自己的工作，通常只有那些一直谈论它的人才是真正优秀的。

cues.en: But if they talk, that's what they want to talk about.
cues.zh: 但如果他们谈话，那就是他们想谈论的。

cues.en: I rarely, really, very rarely see somebody who's successful that doesn't love what he or she does. You have to love what you do.
cues.zh: 我很少，真的，非常少见成功的人不热爱自己所做的事情。你必须热爱你所做的事情。

cues.en: And in your case, the military is what you chose, and I'll tell you what, you cannot go wrong. You're going to see it too.
cues.zh: 而在你们的情况下，军队是你们的选择，我告诉你，你们不会错的。你们也会看到这一点。

cues.en: You're going to love it more and more with time.
cues.zh: 随着时间的推移，你们会越来越热爱它。

cues.en: You know, I work all the time. That's all I do is I work.
cues.zh: 你知道，我一直工作。我所做的就是工作。

cues.en: Whether it's politically or before that, I did, I was a very good businessman, in case you haven't heard, really good.
cues.zh: 无论是政治上还是在此之前，我都做过，我是一个非常好的商人，如果你还没听说过的话，真的很好。

cues.en: But I was good because I loved it. I loved it.
cues.zh: 但我之所以做得好是因为我热爱它。我热爱它。

cues.en: I learned from my father a little bit. My father was a happy guy and all he did was work.
cues.zh: 我从我父亲那里学到了一点。我父亲是个快乐的人，他所做的就是工作。

cues.en: He'd work Saturdays, Sundays, he'd work all the time. And he was a happy guy. He just loved life.
cues.zh: 他会工作周六、周日，他会一直工作。他是个快乐的人。他热爱生活。

cues.en: And I learned that. I say, you know what makes him happy?
cues.zh: 我学到了这一点。我说，你知道是什么让他快乐吗？

cues.en: I've seen other people that never work and then not happy. If you got to love it, otherwise you won't be successful.
cues.zh: 我见过其他人从不工作，然后也不快乐。你必须热爱它，否则你不会成功。

cues.en: In the army, there are a lot of different paths you can take. So follow your instincts and make sure that you take the path that you love.
cues.zh: 在军队里，有很多不同的道路可以走。所以要跟随你的直觉，确保你选择你热爱的道路。

cues.en: That you're doing something that you love within your military. You will be happier and the army will be far stronger for it.
cues.zh: 你在军队中做你热爱的事情。你将更快乐，军队也将因此变得更强大。

cues.en: Second is to think big. Always think big.
cues.zh: 第二是敢于梦想。永远要敢于梦想。

cues.en: If you're going to do something, you might as well think big, do it big because it's just as tough and sometimes it's a lot easier thinking big than doing a small task that's more difficult.
cues.zh: 如果你要做某件事，不妨就大胆去做，因为这同样艰难，有时大胆去做比做一件更困难的小事要容易得多。

cues.en: One of your greatest graduates, General Eisenhower used to say, whenever I run into a problem that I can't solve, I always like to make it bigger to solve it and solve more of it.
cues.zh: 你最伟大的毕业生之一，艾森豪威尔将军曾说过，每当我遇到一个无法解决的问题时，我总是喜欢把它放大来解决，从而解决更多的问题。

cues.en: If you're going to solve a problem and might as well be a big problem as opposed to a small problem that lots of people can take advantage of and solve.
cues.zh: 如果你要解决一个问题，那最好是一个大问题，而不是一个很多人都能轻易解决的小问题。

cues.en: So you can achieve something really amazing. Think big.
cues.zh: 这样你就能成就非凡。大胆去做。

cues.en: Third though, you got to do this.
cues.zh: 第三，你必须做到这一点。

cues.en: Brain power you have to have. Potential you have to have.
cues.zh: 你必须拥有脑力。你必须拥有潜力。

cues.en: But to be really successful, you're always going to have to work hard.
cues.zh: 但要取得真正的成功，你总是必须努力工作。

cues.en: An example is a great athlete, Gary Player, great golfer.
cues.zh: 一个例子是伟大的运动员，加里·普莱尔，伟大的高尔夫球手。

cues.en: He wasn't as big as the other men that were playing against him, great big strong guys. Gary was a smaller guy.
cues.zh: 他不像和他比赛的其他球员那样高大，那些高大强壮的家伙。加里是个身材较小的球员。

cues.en: I don't want to say too much, he's a friend of mine, he gets a little angry at people because he hits the ball just as far. He said, I hit the ball further than them.
cues.zh: 我不想说太多，他是我的朋友，他会有点生气，因为他击球的距离和他们一样远。他说，我击球比他们远。

cues.en: Why am I small?
cues.zh: 为什么我身材矮小？

cues.en: But he worked very, very hard. He was always doing exercise. He was always, he was well ahead of his time.
cues.zh: 但他非常非常努力。他总是锻炼身体。他总是，他比时代领先很多。

cues.en: He never stopped.
cues.zh: 他从未停止。

cues.en: He won 168 golf tournaments. He won 18 majors, nine regular and nine on the senior tour. 18.
cues.zh: 他赢得了168场高尔夫比赛。他赢得了18个大满贯，9个常规赛和9个老年巡回赛。18个。

cues.en: With 168. That's the most tournaments internationally, the most tournaments anybody's ever won.
cues.zh: 总共168场。这是国际上最多的比赛，是任何人赢得最多的比赛。

cues.en: But he made a statement years ago and I heard it. I heard it.
cues.zh: 但他几年前发表过一个声明，我听到了。我听到了。

cues.en: He's the first one, I think I've heard it a couple of times since, but he was the first.
cues.zh: 他是第一个，我想我后来听过几次，但他确实是第一个。

cues.en: He said, it's funny. The harder I work, the luckier I get.
cues.zh: 他说，这很有趣。我越努力工作，就越幸运。

cues.en: And think of that, the harder I work, the luckier I get. And he worked hard and you're working hard and the harder you work, the luckier you're going to get.
cues.zh: 想想看，我越努力工作，就越幸运。他努力工作，你也努力工作，你越努力工作，就越幸运。

cues.en: Fourth is, don't lose your momentum.
cues.zh: 第四，不要失去你的动力。

cues.en: Momentum's an amazing thing. Keep it going.
cues.zh: 动力是一件很神奇的事情。保持它。

cues.en: I tell a story sometimes about a man who's a great, great real estate man.
cues.zh: 我有时会讲一个关于一个伟大的，非常伟大的房地产商的故事。

cues.en: He was a man who was admired for real estate all over the world, actually, but all over the country.
cues.zh: 他是一位在全世界，实际上是在全国各地都备受赞誉的房地产商。

cues.en: He built Levittowns. He started as a man who built one house.
cues.zh: 他建造了莱维特镇。他最初只是一个建造了一栋房子的人。

cues.en: Then he built two, then he built five, then he built 20, and he built a thousand.
cues.zh: 然后他建了两栋，然后建了五栋，然后建了二十栋，然后建了一千栋。

cues.en: Then he built 2,000 and 3,000 a year.
cues.zh: 然后他一年建了2000栋和3000栋。

cues.en: And he got very big, very big. He was great at what he did.
cues.zh: 他变得非常成功，非常成功。他擅长他所做的事情。

cues.en: You see him all over the country still Levittowns. It was a long time ago, but he was the first of the really, really big home builders.
cues.zh: 你仍然能在全国各地看到莱维特镇。那是在很久以前，但他确实是第一批真正，真正伟大的房屋建造商。

cues.en: And he became very rich.
cues.zh: 他变得非常富有。

cues.en: Okay, but a very rich man.
cues.zh: 好的，一个非常富有的人。

cues.en: And then he decided to sell. He was offered a lot of money by a big conglomerate, Gulf and Western.
cues.zh: 然后他决定出售。一家大型联合企业，海湾西方公司，向他提供了很多钱。

cues.en: Big conglomerate. They didn't do real estate. They didn't know anything about it.
cues.zh: 大型联合企业。他们不做房地产。他们对此一无所知。

cues.en: But they saw the money he was making. They wanted to take it, a public company. And they gave him a lot of money.
cues.zh: 但他们看到了他赚的钱。他们想把它收购，一家上市公司。他们给了他很多钱。

cues.en: Tremendous amount of money, more money than he ever thought he'd get.
cues.zh: 巨额的钱，比他想象中能得到的还要多。

cues.en: And he sold his company.
cues.zh: 然后他卖掉了他的公司。

cues.en: And he had nothing to do.
cues.zh: 他无事可做。

cues.en: He ended up getting a divorce.
cues.zh: 他最终离婚了。

cues.en: Found a new wife.
cues.zh: 找到了新妻子。

cues.en: Could you say a trophy wife? I guess we can say a trophy wife.
cues.zh: 可以说是一个战利品妻子吗？我想我们可以说是一个战利品妻子。

cues.en: It didn't work out too well.
cues.zh: 结果不太好。

cues.en: But it doesn't and that doesn't work out too well, I must tell you.
cues.zh: 但它不会，而且那也不会太顺利，我必须告诉你。

cues.en: A lot of trophy wives, doesn't work out.
cues.zh: 很多战利品妻子，结果都不好。

cues.en: But it made him happy for a little while at least.
cues.zh: 但至少在那段时间里，他感到快乐。

cues.en: But he found a new wife.
cues.zh: 但他找到了新妻子。

cues.en: He sold his little boat and he got a big yacht. He had one of the biggest yachts anywhere in the world.
cues.zh: 他卖掉了他的小船，买了一艘大游艇。他拥有当时世界上最大的一艘游艇之一。

cues.en: He moved for a time to Monte Carlo and he lived the good life.
cues.zh: 他曾一度搬到蒙特卡洛，过着奢侈的生活。

cues.en: And time went by and he got bored.
cues.zh: 时间流逝，他感到厌倦了。

cues.zh: 你必须明白，当比尔·莱维特风光无限、势头正猛时，他每晚都会去工地，捡起每一根松动的钉子。

cues.zh: 他会捡起每一块木头碎片，如果地上有螺栓或螺丝，他都会捡起来。

cues.zh: 但现在他被宠坏了，他很富有，真的非常富有。

cues.en: And they called and they said, this isn't for us, this business, you do other things.
cues.zh: 他们打电话来，说，这个生意不适合我们，你们做别的事情吧。

cues.en: Would you like to buy it back? We'll sell it back to you cheap.
cues.zh: 你想买回去吗？我们会便宜卖给你。

cues.zh: 他们卖了。他买下了。

cues.en: He bought it. He thought he made a great deal.
cues.zh: 他买下了。他认为自己做了一笔大买卖。

cues.zh: 他非常兴奋，但那已经是15年后的事了。

cues.en: It just didn't work.
cues.zh: 就是行不通。

cues.en: He lost everything.
cues.zh: 他失去了一切。

cues.en: And I was sitting at a party on Fifth Avenue one night, a long time ago.
cues.zh: 很久以前，一个晚上，我参加了第五大道的一个派对。

cues.en: And yet the biggest people in New York, the biggest people in the country, all in that party and they were also lauding each other.
cues.zh: 而纽约最重要的人，全国最重要的人，都在那个派对上，他们还在互相吹捧。

cues.en: How great they were, they were all telling each other.

cues.zh: 我比你更伟大。

cues.en: Gets to be really, gives you a headache sometimes.
cues.zh: 这真的会让人头疼，有时候。

cues.en: But they had all these people, they're telling their own stories about how fantastic.
cues.zh: 但他们有这么多人在讲他们自己的故事，有多么棒。

cues.en: A cocktail party and I looked over and I was doing well.
cues.zh: 鸡尾酒会，我看了看，我过得不错。

cues.en: I was, I don't know, I was invited to the party so I had to be doing well.
cues.zh: 我，我不知道，我被邀请参加派对，所以我想我一定过得不错。

cues.zh: 我非常非常年轻。

cues.en: But I made a name in real estate.
cues.zh: 但我已经在房地产领域闯出了名声。

cues.en: And I looked over and at the party, sitting in a corner all by himself, nobody was talking to him was Mr. Levitt.
cues.zh: 我看了看，在派对上，他独自一人坐在角落里，没有人跟他说话，那就是莱维特先生。

cues.zh: 他刚刚破产，失去了一切。失去了一切。

cues.en: His home, everything.
cues.zh: 他的家，一切。

cues.en: And I went over and talked to him because he was in the real estate business and I loved real estate.
cues.zh: 我走过去和他聊了聊，因为他从事房地产行业，而我热爱房地产。

cues.en: And I said, hello Mr. Levitt, how are you?
cues.zh: 我说，你好莱维特先生，你好吗？

cues.en: He said, hello Donald, it's nice to meet you.
cues.zh: 他说，你好唐纳德，很高兴认识你。

cues.en: He knew me from being in the business.
cues.zh: 他认识我，因为我在这个行业。

cues.en: I said, so how's it going?
cues.zh: 我说，那怎么样了？

cues.en: He goes, not well. It's really not going well as you've probably read.
cues.zh: 他说，不太好。正如你可能读到的，真的不太好。

cues.en: It's been a very, very tough period for me, son.
cues.zh: 对我来说，这是一段非常非常艰难的时期，孩子。

cues.en: And I said, so what happened?
cues.zh: 我说，那发生了什么？

cues.en: I said, is there anything you can do?
cues.zh: 我说，有什么你能做的吗？

cues.en: He goes, no, there's not a thing I can do.
cues.zh: 他说，不，没有什么是我能做的。

cues.en: He said, I'll never forget. He said, I've lost my momentum.
cues.zh: 他说，我永远不会忘记。他说，我失去了我的动力。

cues.en: I just didn't have it.
cues.zh: 我就是没有了。

cues.en: I used to have it, but I lost my momentum.
cues.zh: 我曾经有过，但我失去了我的动力。

cues.en: So it's a story I tell and you have to know when you have the momentum, but sometimes you have to also know when you've lost the momentum.
cues.zh: 所以这是一个我讲的故事，你必须知道何时拥有动力，但有时你也必须知道何时失去了动力。

cues.en: And leaving a field, sometimes, leaving what you're doing sometimes is okay.
cues.zh: 有时离开一个领域，有时，离开你正在做的事情，是可以的。

cues.en: But you gotta have momentum, but you have to know if that momentum is gone.
cues.zh: 但你必须有动力，但你必须知道动力是否已经消失。

cues.en: You have to know when to say it's time to get out.
cues.zh: 你必须知道何时该说该退出了。

cues.en: And that's a very sad story. I remember that story so well.
cues.zh: 这是一个非常悲伤的故事。我记得那个故事非常清楚。

cues.en: Like it was yesterday.
cues.zh: 就像昨天一样。

cues.en: Fifth, you have to have the courage to take risks and to do things differently.

cues.en: We're seeing the drones that are coming down at angles and with speed and with with precision.
cues.zh: 我们看到无人机以角度和速度以及精度下降。

cues.en: We've never seen anything like it. We've never seen anything like it.
cues.zh: 我们从未见过这样的事情。我们从未见过这样的事情。

cues.en: And we're learning from it. But your profession changes very rapidly.
cues.zh: 我们正在从中学习。但你的职业变化非常快。

cues.en: You've got to keep, you've got to be at the top of it. You've got to be right at the at the head of the needle.
cues.zh: 你必须保持领先，你必须处于顶端。你必须处于领先地位。

cues.zh: 我们需要有勇气、远见和骨气的爱国者，他们冒着个人风险，确保美国每次都能获胜。

cues.zh: 先生，需要四年才能击败他们，也许五年。也许我们不会，因为他们无处不在。

cues.en: And then I met a man that said we can do it in three weeks. And he did it in three weeks.
cues.zh: 然后我遇到一个人说我们可以在三周内完成。他做到了，在三周内。

cues.en: And I said, "Isn't it amazing? We were the ones that won the war. And we were helped.

cues.en: We were helped. In some cases, we had to help them. But we were helped by some of the nations.

cues.en: And we were strongly helped by a couple of them.

cues.zh: 但他们每个人都在庆祝。他们有胜利日。他们称之为欧洲胜利日，到处都是胜利日。

cues.en: And we weren't even thought about. Nobody had a Victory Day.
cues.zh: 而我们甚至没有被提及。没有人有胜利日。

cues.en: And so I named that special day and another special day from now on as a holiday, but a holiday where we work.
cues.zh: 所以，我将那个特殊的日子和从现在开始的另一个特殊的日子定为假日，但这是一个我们工作的假日。

cues.en: Because we don't have enough dates. We're going to be having so many holidays, we're not going to be able to work anymore.
cues.zh: 因为我们没有足够的日期。我们将有太多的假日，以至于我们无法再工作了。

cues.en: But I named it for World War II and a separate day in November, as you know, for World War I.
cues.zh: 但我将其命名为第二次世界大战，并在十一月设立了一个单独的日子，如你所知，是为了第一次世界大战。

cues.en: I said, you know, all of these countries that participated in the war are celebrating. But the greatest country of them all.
cues.zh: 我说，你知道，所有参与战争的国家都在庆祝。但其中最伟大的国家。

cues.en: And the country that won the war, nobody even talked about. And so we're going to be talking about it too from now on.
cues.zh: 而赢得战争的国家，却无人提及。所以我们从现在开始也要谈论它。

cues.en: And I think you'll appreciate it.
cues.zh: 我想你会欣赏的。

cues.en: We won the first World War. We won the second World War. And you know where we won them from?
cues.zh: 我们赢得了第一次世界大战。我们赢得了第二次世界大战。你知道我们从哪里赢得的吗？

cues.en: Right here at West Point.
cues.zh: 就在西点。

cues.zh: 西点赢得了战争。

cues.en: You won two World Wars.
cues.zh: 你们赢得了两次世界大战。

cues.en: And plenty of other things.
cues.zh: 还有很多其他事情。

cues.en: But you won't think of it.
cues.zh: 但你不会想到它。

cues.en: We don't want to have a third World War.
cues.zh: 我们不希望发生第三次世界大战。

cues.en: But we won the first World War. We won the second World War right here from West Point.
cues.zh: 但我们赢得了第一次世界大战。我们赢得了第二次世界大战，就在西点。

cues.zh: 但他们却在庆祝胜利。不，我们要庆祝胜利，因为我们是赢得那场战争的人。

cues.en: Standing before you today, I know that you will never stop. You will never quit. You will never yield. You will never tire.

cues.zh: 嗯，我挺喜欢这个主意的。

cues.en: I'll just need a credit card.
cues.zh: 我只需要一张信用卡就行了。

cues.en: Please, sir. Not in the matrix.
cues.zh: 求您了，先生。不是在矩阵里。

cues.en: You shouldn't put people in matrixes.
cues.zh: 你不应该把人关进矩阵里。

cues.en: Uh-huh.
cues.zh: 嗯哼。

cues.en: What the... Oh.
cues.zh: 这什么鬼……哦。

cues.en: Matrix my ass!
cues.zh: 矩阵个屁！

cues.en: Wubba Lubba Dub Dub!
cues.zh: 呜巴卢巴杜布！

cues.en: This better be Death Race-related.
cues.zh: 这肯定和死亡竞赛有关。

cues.en: CJ!
cues.zh: 西杰！

cues.en: Hey!
cues.zh: 嘿！

cues.en: CJ! CJ!
cues.zh: 西杰！西杰！

cues.en: She's beautiful. Isn't she?
cues.zh: 她很漂亮，对吧？

cues.en: Morty... I never had a brother.
cues.zh: 莫蒂……我从来没有过兄弟。

cues.en: Until you.
cues.zh: 直到你出现。

cues.en: Death to Chargeria!
cues.zh: 查格瑞亚去死！

cues.en: We got him. Osama Been Chargin is dead.
cues.zh: 我们抓到他了。奥萨马·宾·查金死了。

cues.en: Full hearts, full charge.
cues.zh: 满格能量，全力冲锋。

cues.en: Full hearts, full charge.
cues.zh: 满格能量，全力冲锋。

cues.en: She's coming down!
cues.zh: 她要下来了！

cues.en: Sweet Christ! Power Plant Valley is breached!
cues.zh: 天哪！发电厂谷被攻破了！

cues.en: I repeat, breached!
cues.zh: 我重复一遍，已经被攻破了！

cues.en: He's getting too close!
cues.zh: 他越来越近了！

cues.en: If he reaches the central power plant,
cues.zh: 如果他到达中央发电厂，

cues.en: it'll trigger a chain reaction
cues.zh: 就会引发连锁反应

cues.en: that renders North America uninhabitable,
cues.zh: 那会让北美变得无法居住。

cues.en: but also takes out all cell phones!
cues.zh: 同时还会让所有的手机都失效！

cues.en: Fear not, Guard #2.
cues.zh: 别怕，二号守卫。

cues.en: The moat was installed for this exact scenario.
cues.zh: 建造护城河就是为了应对这种情况。

cues.en: There's not a tank on Earth that can cross that water.
cues.zh: 地球上没有任何坦克能跨过那片水。

cues.en: Oh, shit! It's got a snorkel!
cues.zh: 哦，见鬼！它还有通气管！

cues.en: - Dear God. Run! -
cues.zh: - 天哪，快跑！ -

cues.en: Morty!
cues.zh: 莫蒂！

cues.en: None of this will bring CJ back!
cues.zh: 这些根本无法让CJ复活！

cues.en: Keep his name out of your mouth!
cues.zh: 别把他的名字挂在嘴边！

cues.en: Whose name?
cues.zh: 谁的名字？

cues.en: Christopher James Motorola,
cues.zh: 克里斯托弗·詹姆斯·摩托罗拉。

cues.en: Chargeant First Class?
cues.zh: 头等充电舱？

cues.en: What do you know about CJ?
cues.zh: 你对CJ了解多少？

cues.en: This is all my fault, Morty.
cues.zh: 这都是我的错，莫蒂。

cues.en: You were the only real thing in there,
cues.zh: 你是那里唯一真实的存在，

cues.en: but I didn't treat you like you mattered.
cues.zh: 但我却没把你当回事。

cues.en: You couldn't have known what would happen in that war.
cues.zh: 你不可能预知那场战争里会发生什么。

cues.en: But I did know, Morty. I did know.
cues.zh: 但我知道，莫蒂。我真的知道。

cues.en: Once I understood the rules of the matrix,
cues.zh: 一旦我弄明白了矩阵的规则，

cues.en: taking power was easy.
cues.zh: 获取权力就变得很简单。

cues.en: But making power wasn't.
cues.zh: 但创造权力却并非如此。

cues.en: There was only one way to make the charging science work,
cues.zh: 要让充电技术发挥作用，只有一种方法，

cues.en: all the lithium we could get our hands on.
cues.zh: 就是用上我们能搞到的所有锂。

cues.en: We got it.
cues.zh: 我们搞定了。

cues.en: We can fix it, right? We can fix it?
cues.zh: 我们能解决这个问题，对吧？我们一定能解决，对吧？

cues.en: NO one can know about this.
cues.zh: 绝不能让任何人知道这件事。

cues.en: It was a brutal war, but I knew we'd win it.
cues.zh: 那是一场残酷的战争，但我知道我们一定能赢。

cues.en: Because we had you.
cues.zh: 因为我们有你。

cues.en: An ex-con with no future, no family, no way to die.
cues.zh: 一个没有前途、没有家人、连死法都没有的刑满释放犯。

cues.en: Morty, I never had a brother.
cues.zh: 莫蒂，我以前从来没有过兄弟。

cues.en: Until you.
cues.zh: 直到你出现。

cues.en: You could have had a different life.
cues.zh: 你本可以拥有不一样的生活。

cues.en: I could have given it to you.
cues.zh: 我本可以把它给你。

cues.en: We got him. Osama Been Chargin is dead.
cues.zh: 我们抓到他了。奥萨马·宾·查金死了。

cues.en: Thank you, soldier. Full hearts, full charge.
cues.zh: 谢谢你，战士。满腔热血，全力出击。

cues.en: We're lithium-rich!
cues.zh: 我们体内富含锂元素！

cues.en: You were my greatest asset.
cues.zh: 你曾是我最宝贵的财富。

cues.en: And my darkest shame.
cues.zh: 也是我心中最深的耻辱。

cues.en: I also had your phones bugged, a tracking chip put in your spine,
cues.zh: 我还在你们的手机里安了窃听器，在你们的脊椎里植入了追踪芯片，

cues.en: and those birds you liked to feed
cues.zh: 还有你喜欢喂的那些鸟，

cues.en: were Spy cameras built by the government.
cues.zh: 其实是政府制造的间谍摄像头。

cues.en: - My finches? - I know you lost a brother in there.
cues.zh: - 我的雀鸟？ - 我知道你在那里失去过一个兄弟。

cues.en: Don't make me lose you.
cues.zh: 别让我也失去你。

cues.en: It's like the pain IS all I have left of him!
cues.zh: 那种痛苦仿佛就是我仅存的关于他的记忆！

cues.en: But... But he's gone!
cues.zh: 但是...但他已经不在了！

cues.en: He never existed in the first place!
cues.zh: 他从一开始就不存在！

cues.en: Don't say that! Without you and your friends,
cues.zh: 别这么说！没有你和你的朋友们，

cues.en: we never would have escaped the matrix.
cues.zh: 我们根本不可能从矩阵里逃出来。

cues.en: Rick, he would have woken up and let us out!
cues.zh: 瑞克，他本来会醒来然后放我们出去的！

cues.en: On whose terms?
cues.zh: 按照他的条件吗？

cues.en: He would've wiped us clean before our eyes were open,
cues.zh: 他会在我们还没来得及反应时就把我们彻底消灭掉，

cues.en: and then they'd really be gone, all of them.
cues.zh: 然后他们就真的全都会消失，一个都不剩。

cues.en: CJ, Chop Block...
cues.zh: CJ，切块……

cues.en: Marmaduke, um
cues.zh: 马默杜克，呃……

cues.en: 8-Balll Jesus!
cues.zh: 8号球，天哪！

cues.en: - - I... I'm sorry, Morty.
cues.zh: ——我……我很抱歉，莫蒂。

cues.en: You get to decide now.
cues.zh: 现在由你来做决定。

cues.en: What do you want to do?
cues.zh: 你想怎么做？

cues.en: I wanna go home.
cues.zh: 我想回家。

cues.en: Yeah. Let's go home.
cues.zh: 没错，我们回家吧。

cues.en: It's okay! I'm... I'm all right now!
cues.zh: 没关系的！我……我现在没事了！

cues.en: It's not you we were worried about!
cues.zh: 我们担心的不是你！

cues.en: Yeah, this is exactly why you shouldn't steal
cues.zh: 没错，这正是你不能偷东西的原因

cues.en: your grandpa's inventions!
cues.zh: 你绝不能偷你爷爷的发明！

cues.en: What?
cues.zh: 什么？

cues.en: He said never steal your grandpa's inventions!
cues.zh: 他说绝不能偷你爷爷的发明！

cues.en: - No... - Motherfucker.
Matrix piece of shit!
cues.zh: 该死的矩阵垃圾！

cues.en: Fucking fake lesson-teaching bastard!
cues.zh: 该死的假教书混蛋！

cues.en: - - Stop!
cues.zh: ——停下！

cues.en: Easy, guys! Christ!
cues.zh: 冷静点，大家！天哪！

cues.en: You're not in a matrix! You're not in a matrix!
cues.zh: 你们又不在矩阵里！你们真的不在矩阵里！

cues.en: Rick? What the fuck?
cues.zh: 瑞克？这到底怎么回事？

cues.en: This NPC was trying to teach us a lesson!
cues.zh: 这个NPC是想给我们一个教训！

cues.en: I was just saying not to steal such dangerous technology.
cues.zh: 我只是说别偷这么危险的技术。

cues.en: Your grandpa's obviously a genius.
cues.zh: 你爷爷显然是个天才。

cues.en: - See? - That's an actual guy,
cues.zh: - 看吧？ - 那是个真正的人，

cues.en: making several obvious and valid statements.
cues.zh: 说着好几句明显又合理的話。

cues.en: - Beer later? - I think my nose is broken.
cues.zh: - 稍后喝啤酒？ - 我觉得我的鼻子断了。

cues.en: - Oh, come on! - Oh, come on!
cues.zh: - 哦，得了吧！ - 哦，得了吧！

cues.en: - Chernobyl! We're Chernobyl-tog! -
cues.zh: - 切尔诺贝利！我们正在去切尔诺贝利！ -

cues.en: Rick! Are you gonna...
cues.zh: 瑞克！你打算……

cues.en: Yes.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.en: - Ew! What the hell? -
cues.zh: - 呃！这到底是什么？ -

cues.en: It's anti-radiation gel.
cues.zh: 这是防辐射凝胶。

cues.en: Your tits and bits will thank me later.
cues.zh: 等会儿你的胸部和私处就会感谢我的。

cues.en: - Ew. - "What the hell?"
cues.zh: - 呃。 - "这到底是什么？"

cues.en: So... nuclear reactor, huh?
cues.zh: 所以……是核反应堆，对吧？

cues.en: I had PTSD!
cues.zh: 我得了创伤后应激障碍！

cues.en: Thank you for your service.
cues.zh: 感谢你的服务。

cues.en: Oh! Oh, my God! You saved us from the...
cues.zh: 哦！天哪！你把我们从……

cues.en: The worst meltdown In American history? Yeah.
cues.zh: 美国历史上最严重的核泄漏事故中救了出来？没错。

cues.en: I'm gonna leave this with you. Sign here.
cues.zh: 我把这个交给你。在这里签字。

cues.en: Tip? Uh, I don't see an option lower than 20%.
cues.zh: 小费？呃，我没看到低于20%的选项。

cues.en: There isn't one.
cues.zh: 确实没有。

cues.en: Aah.
cues.zh: 啊。

cues.en: Might wanna keep that gel on for a little while.
cues.zh: 或许最好让那层凝胶再敷一会儿。

cues.en: All right. Is there anything else we need to do?
cues.zh: 好吧，我们还有别的需要做的吗？

cues.en: Owl! Ow! Ow! Owww/!
cues.zh: 猫头鹰！疼！疼！好痛啊！

cues.en: I'm gonna remember him, but I'm gonna miss you.
cues.zh: 我会记住他的，但也会想念你。

cues.en: You won't have to.
cues.zh: 你不必这样。

cues.en: I have a feeling things are gonna be different now.
cues.zh: 我有种感觉，现在一切都会不一样了。

cues.en: Ready to be kids again?
cues.zh: 准备好再次当孩子了吗？

cues.en: More than you know.
cues.zh: 比你想象的要更想。

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.en: What'd you do to us?
cues.zh: 你对我们做了什么？

cues.en: What the fuck is on my arm, Rick?
cues.zh: 瑞克，我胳膊上到底是什么东西？

cues.en: Beats me. You asked for it.
cues.zh: 我也不清楚。这是你自找的。

cues.en: What? Why?
cues.zh: 什么？为什么？

cues.en: Whatever. I'm meeting friends to throw shopping carts into the quarry.
cues.zh: 随便吧。我要去跟朋友一起把购物车扔进采石场。

cues.en: Oh, geez. Oh, no, Rick! You gotta get this off of me!
cues.zh: 哦，天哪。不行啊，瑞克！你得把这个从我身上拿掉！

cues.en: It makes me uncomfortable!
cues.zh: 这让我很不舒服！

cues.en: No can do, pal. Made a promise to an old friend.
cues.zh: 没得商量，伙计。我已经跟一个老朋友许过诺了。

cues.en: What the hell?
cues.zh: 这到底怎么回事？

cues.en: Hi. Summer.
cues.zh: 嗨，桑美。

cues.en: You probably won't remember making this,
cues.zh: 你可能不记得自己说过这话，

cues.en: but I just wanted to say,
cues.zh: 但我只是想说，

cues.en: I love you and you should love yourself.
cues.zh: 我爱你，你也应该爱自己。

cues.en: The first thing your peers will try to take from you.
cues.zh: 这是你的同龄人会首先试图从你身上夺走的东西。

cues.en: IS your adult empathy.
cues.zh: 这就是你作为成年人的共情能力吗？

cues.en: It's your greatest gift and the one thing that they...
cues.zh: 这是你最宝贵的礼物，也是他们……

cues.en: Ugh. Send a text.
cues.zh: 呃，发条短信吧。

cues.en: Yo, Tricia! What are we huffing tonight, bitch?
cues.zh: 喂，特里西娅！今晚咱们要吸什么，贱人？

cues.en: Can I... help you?
cues.zh: 我能……帮你吗？

cues.en: Beth, it's time to come clean.
cues.zh: 贝丝，是时候说实话了。

cues.en: We lost women
cues.zh: 我们失去了女性们

cues.en: feast on the young to stay middle-aged.
cues.zh: 靠吸食年轻人的血来维持中年状态。

cues.en: So, you're vampires?
cues.zh: 所以，你们是吸血鬼？

cues.en: Why not feed till you're young?
cues.zh: 为什么不趁年轻的时候就吸血呢？

cues.en: 'Cause not everyone has your fucked-up values, Beth!
cues.zh: 因为不是每个人都像你一样价值观扭曲，贝丝！

cues.en: And it's unfortunately drink or be drank!
cues.zh: 可惜啊，不喝血就会被别人吸干！

cues.en: Oh, come on! I thought that was Wine Mom talk!
cues.zh: 哦，得了吧！我还以为那是‘葡萄酒妈妈’的说话方式呢！

cues.en: The sun turns you to dust, and you picked Santa Fe?
cues.zh: 太阳会把人晒成尘土，你就选了圣达菲？

cues.en: That's on you.
cues.zh: 那是你自己的选择。
