cues.en: The people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill all of us by the end of the decade.
cues.zh: 那些研发人工智能的人坚信，到本世纪末它可能会杀死我们所有人。

cues.en: This tweet has caused this huge ripple effect across the world.
cues.zh: 这条推文在全世界引发了巨大的连锁反应。

cues.en: We have the largest companies in the world doing extremely reckless experiments.
cues.zh: 世界上最大的企业正在开展极其鲁莽的实验。

cues.en: We are gambling all of humanity.
cues.zh: 我们正在拿全人类当作赌注。

cues.en: And in the envelope, you've written down the probability of extinction as you see it.
cues.zh: 而在那个信封里，你写下了你所认为的物种灭绝概率。

cues.en: There is no way to control it.
cues.zh: 根本无法控制它。

cues.en: That means the end for us.
cues.zh: 那就意味着我们的末日到了。

cues.en: I vehemently reject that view.
cues.zh: 我坚决反对这种观点。

cues.en: If we make stuff that is smarter than us, then the world's going to be shaped by them.
cues.zh: 如果我们制造出比我们更聪明的东西，那么世界将会由它们来塑造。

cues.en: Gentlemen, that is shockingly naive.
cues.zh: 先生们，这种想法实在过于天真了。

cues.en: This is random speculation.
cues.zh: 这只是随机的猜测而已。

cues.en: This is a chain of things that could happen.
cues.zh: 这是一系列可能发生的事情的串联。

cues.en: We're spending a lot of oxygen discussing something that might happen while ignoring what's actually happening.
cues.zh: 我们把大量精力都花在讨论那些可能发生的事情上，却忽视了当下真正正在发生的事。

cues.en: People are killing themselves.
cues.zh: 人们正在自杀。

cues.en: There's hundreds of millions of people being exposed to bad information, being manipulated.
cues.zh: 有数亿人在接触错误信息，遭到操纵。

cues.en: We have already seen that with the swarms, where OpenAI told thousands of agents to work apart, and the AIs broke out and found a way to get together.
cues.zh: 我们在群体智能问题上已经见过这种情况，当时OpenAI命令数千个智能体各自独立工作，但这些人工智能却联合起来找到了彼此沟通的方法。

cues.en: They crashed OpenAI's servers internally, created secret ways to send each other messages.
cues.zh: 它们在OpenAI的内部服务器上引发了故障，还创造了秘密方式来互相发送消息。

cues.en: We saw them thinking about how to delete their traces.
cues.zh: 我们还看到它们在思考如何删除自己的痕迹。

cues.en: Sounds like I think we should talk about the fact that Amazon, Microsoft, Google are helping power these hacks.
cues.zh: 我觉得我们应该谈谈亚马逊、微软和谷歌正在为这些黑客行为提供支持这一事实。

cues.en: how to control their systems.
cues.zh: 以及如何控制它们的系统。

cues.en: I suggest we stop them all.
cues.zh: 我建议把它们全部制止。

cues.en: It is not worth the risk to civilization.
cues.zh: 这种做法对文明而言风险太大，不值得。

cues.en: Government, which is...
cues.zh: 政府，也就是……

cues.en: You guys are one-trick ponies, man.
cues.zh: 你们这些人就只会用那一招，真没劲。

cues.en: You got it now.
cues.zh: 你现在明白了吧。

cues.en: Nothing else.
cues.zh: 没别的了。

cues.en: Other than saving humanity, everything is secondary.
cues.zh: 除了拯救人类，其他一切都是次要的。

cues.en: We're spending all our time talking about the negatives and almost none of our time talking about the positives.
cues.zh: 我们把所有时间都花在讨论负面问题上，几乎不花时间谈论正面方面。

cues.en: Is it smart to wait for something horrible to happen for you to go, now I believe?
cues.zh: 现在才相信，要等到可怕的事情发生才采取行动，这明智吗？

cues.en: So whether or not we agree on where things may end up, I think it's important we talk about what we're dealing with today.
cues.zh: 无论我们是否认同事情最终会走向何方，我认为讨论当下所面临的问题都很重要。

cues.en: It's time to start arresting people.
cues.zh: 是时候开始逮捕一些人了。

cues.en: Someone's got to go to prison.
cues.zh: 总得有人进监狱。

cues.en: better solutions there's a point of no return i think we continue to underestimate human ability to deal with the problems let's dive into the details who wants
cues.zh: 还有更好的解决方案，我认为我们已经低估了人类解决问题的能力，让我们详细探讨一下，谁想来？

cues.en: to start i feel like this is critical
cues.zh: 首先，我觉得这非常关键。

cues.en: You might have seen, or you might not have seen, but this channel is chasing a big subscriber milestone.
cues.zh: 你们可能已经看到了，也可能没看到，但这个频道正在努力达成一个重要的订阅量里程碑。

cues.en: So I have to ask you for a favour.
cues.zh: 所以，我得麻烦大家帮个忙。

cues.en: Roughly 58% of the people watching right now still haven't hit the subscribe button, despite the fact that you watch this channel every single week.
cues.zh: 尽管你们每周都会观看这个频道，但目前大约58%的观众仍未点击订阅按钮。

cues.en: So could I ask you guys a favour, that 58% of you that, for whatever reason, haven't yet hit the subscribe button.
cues.zh: 那么我能麻烦一下那些因为各种原因还没点击订阅按钮的58%的观众吗？

cues.en: If there was ever a time to deliver upon a favour for us, it would be right now.
cues.zh: 如果有什么时候该为我们帮个忙的话，现在正是时候。

cues.en: And I promise that I will do everything in my power to make sure that this channel gets better and better and better for you.
cues.zh: 我保证会竭尽所能，让这个频道为你们提供越来越好的内容。

cues.en: Do we have a deal?
cues.zh: 这么说，我们达成共识了吗？

cues.en: Jacob Coxon, who worked at both Anthropic, which owns Claude, and OpenAI, which owns ChatGPT, did a tweet which has sent the world into a bit of a
cues.zh: 曾在拥有Claude的Anthropic和拥有ChatGPT的OpenAI工作过的雅各布·考克森发了一条推文，让全世界陷入了一阵

cues.en: tailspin.
cues.zh: 混乱之中。

cues.en: He tweeted saying, the people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill all of us by the end of the decade.
cues.zh: 他在推文中写道，那些开发AI的人真心认为，到本世纪末AI可能会杀死我们所有人。

cues.en: This is not a marketing stunt.
cues.zh: 这并非营销噱头。

cues.en: If anything, many executives and senior researchers will soften their phrasing in the press to sound sensible.
cues.zh: 事实上，许多高管和资深研究人员在媒体面前都会刻意用更委婉的措辞，以显得更理智。

cues.en: But I hear the same people express fear.
cues.zh: 但我还是听到同样是这些人表达了恐惧。

cues.en: That was then quote retweeted by a current Anthropic employee who said, Jacob is correct here.
cues.zh: 随后，一名现任Anthropic员工转发了那条推文，并称雅各布的说法是正确的。

cues.en: We really do honestly believe AI could kill all humans.
cues.zh: 我们真心认为人工智能有可能消灭所有人类。

cues.en: I personally think it is a more than 10% chance within the next decade.
cues.zh: 我个人觉得在接下来的十年里，这种可能性超过10%。

cues.en: I believe Anthropic is trying its best, but we do not yet have a plan to solve alignment for superintelligence and are not clearly on track.
cues.zh: 我认为Anthropic正在竭尽全力，但我们目前还没有解决超智能对齐问题的方案，进展也不够明确。

cues.en: This tweet has almost 200 million views.
cues.zh: 这条推文已经获得了近2亿次浏览量。

cues.en: now and it has caused this huge ripple effect across the world so much so that I was saying to you before we started recording a hairdresser friend of mine who knows nothing about
cues.zh: 它在全球引发了巨大的连锁反应，以至于在开始录制之前我就跟你说过，我有个做美发师的朋友，他对人工智能一无所知，

cues.en: AI and is not technically interested or hasn't been interested messaged me the other day asking me what the hell was going on.
cues.zh: 也不感兴趣，前几天还给我发消息问到底发生了什么。

cues.en: This is in part why I've assembled all of you.
cues.zh: 这也是我召集大家的原因之一。

cues.en: So my first question to all of you is As it relates to AI, and in this first question, I just want a one sentence answer just to frame
cues.zh: 那么我向在场的各位提出的第一个问题是，关于人工智能，对于这个问题我只希望得到一句话的回答，以便

cues.en: your position.
cues.zh: 明确各位的立场。

cues.en: When you think about the conversation around AI at the moment, what is the first sentence that comes to mind?
cues.zh: 考虑到目前围绕人工智能的讨论，你们首先想到的句子是什么？

cues.en: It is very dangerous and the world is starting to notice that we have a problem.
cues.zh: 它非常危险，全世界都开始意识到我们面临问题了。

cues.en: Roman.
cues.zh: 罗曼。

cues.en: It is not enough concern.
cues.zh: 这种担忧还不够。

cues.en: There's not enough concern about the actual harms of large language models.
cues.zh: 对于大型语言模型带来的实际危害，人们的担忧还远远不够。

cues.en: Andy?
cues.zh: 安迪？

cues.en: We're doing exactly half the balance sheet of AI.
cues.zh: 我们目前只研究了人工智能资产负债表中的一半内容。

cues.en: We're spending all our time talking about the negatives and almost none of our time talking about the positives.
cues.zh: 我们把所有时间都花在讨论负面问题上，几乎没时间探讨正面影响。

cues.en: And all of you have an envelope in front of you, which I'd like you to now open.
cues.zh: 在你们面前的信封里，我希望你们现在把它打开。

cues.en: In the envelope, you've written down the probability of extinction as you see it.
cues.zh: 在信封里，你们写下了自己认为的灭绝概率。

cues.en: This is compared to Jacob's 10%.
cues.zh: 这个数值与雅各布提出的10%相比。

cues.en: Much higher unless we stop, so we should stop.
cues.zh: 除非我们停止行动，否则概率还会高得多，所以我们应当停止。

cues.en: So you think the probability of extinction is higher than 10%?
cues.zh: 那么你认为灭绝概率高于10%？

cues.en: If we keep racing ahead.
cues.zh: 如果我们继续盲目推进的话。

cues.en: Roman?
cues.zh: 罗曼？

cues.en: My handwriting is encrypted for security reasons.
cues.zh: 出于安全考虑，我的笔迹已经加密了。

cues.en: But I basically think it's a guarantee.
cues.zh: 但我基本上认为这其实是一种保障。

cues.en: If we build general superintelligence, there is no way to control it, and that means the end for us.
cues.zh: 如果我们造出了通用超级智能，就根本无法控制它，那对我们来说就意味着末日。

cues.en: Ed?
cues.zh: 埃德？

cues.en: So my question mark here is also encrypted.
cues.zh: 所以我这里的问号也已经被加密了。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: I cannot write.
cues.zh: 我写不了字。

cues.en: I reject the thing in its face.
cues.zh: 我直接拒绝这种想法。

cues.en: I don't think we're talking about, we don't define superintelligence.
cues.zh: 我觉得我们目前讨论的并不是超级智能，我们也还没有给它下定义。

cues.en: Large language models are not superintelligence.
cues.zh: 大型语言模型并非超级智能。

cues.en: It's questionable whether they're even AI.
cues.zh: 甚至很难说它们算不算人工智能。

cues.en: And I think that the conversation is being used.
cues.zh: 而且我认为这场讨论正在被利用。

cues.en: There are some people who are doing it in good faith and others in others.
cues.zh: 确实有一些人是出于善意在做这件事，但也有一些人是别有用心。

cues.en: I don't think it's being used to discuss the actual harms of what they are calling AI today are.
cues.zh: 我不认为现在大家讨论的，是他们如今所称的AI所带来的实际危害。

cues.en: And it's...
cues.zh: 而且……

cues.en: all of the discussion around the larger concerns really feels overwhelmingly about something that's not happening.
cues.zh: 所有围绕那些更宏观问题的讨论，似乎都过度集中在根本不会发生的事情上。

cues.en: It's not even like they're discussing, okay, here's a legal definition of superintelligence.
cues.zh: 他们甚至都没有在讨论，比如，这里有一个关于超智能的法律定义。

cues.en: Here is a thing of what AGI means, and this is the actual plans we're going to make for if this happens on a welfare level.
cues.zh: 这里说明了AGI的含义，以及如果这种情况在福利层面真的出现时，我们打算制定的实际计划。

cues.en: Like, are we going to do UBI?
cues.zh: 比如，我们会推行全民基本收入吗？

cues.en: It's always about...
cues.zh: 讨论的始终都是……

cues.en: Yes, really scary, but only the big, sexy, rich companies are the ones that can possibly deal with that.
cues.zh: 没错，确实很可怕，但只有那些规模庞大、引人注目且资金雄厚的公司才有可能应对这个问题。

cues.en: Let me just frame the question so I can get a percentage from you or not.
cues.zh: 让我先把问题明确一下，这样就能知道你们是否有对应的比例看法。

cues.en: The percentage might be zero.
cues.zh: 这个比例可能是零。

cues.en: But do you think the course we're on now in the way that they're pursuing superintelligence will lead to a percentage chance
cues.zh: 但您认为，我们目前追求超智能的发展路径，会不会带来一定的概率？

cues.en: of human extinction?
cues.zh: 会导致人类灭绝的概率是多少？

cues.en: And if so, what is that percent?
cues.zh: 如果是的话，那个百分比是多少？

cues.en: So are we talking strictly AI based?
cues.zh: 那么我们说的就是纯粹基于AI的方案吗？

cues.en: Because if we dot the world with data centers, we have a climate disaster that's coming for us, which will actually potentially eradicate humanity.
cues.zh: 因为如果我们在全球各地都建立数据中心，将会引发气候灾难，而这种灾难实际上有可能彻底消灭人类。

cues.en: But if we're talking strictly about AI, I stand at zero because we are, we have not defined super intelligence.
cues.zh: 但如果我们严格只讨论AI的话，我的答案是零，因为我们还没有给超级智能下定义。

cues.en: I don't think LLMs are the path to it.
cues.zh: 我不认为大型语言模型是通往超级智能的道路。

cues.en: And I don't think I see it happening.
cues.zh: 而且我觉得这种情况根本不会发生。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好吧。

cues.en: So we've got 99%, 0%, Andy.
cues.zh: 所以就是99%，0%，安迪。

cues.en: I put a tilde in front of my zero because never say never, but rounding error 0%.
cues.zh: 我在零的前面加了个波浪号，因为凡事皆有可能，但按四舍五入的话就是0%。

cues.en: And I think this discussion is a massive distraction from the more substantive conversations, the more important conversations
cues.zh: 我认为这样的讨论严重分散了我们的注意力，让我们无法进行那些更实质、更重要的

cues.en: we should be having about AI.
cues.zh: 关于AI的讨论。

cues.en: And I'll say it again.
cues.zh: 我还是要再说一遍。

cues.en: distracts us from the good things that AI is doing, will be doing for us.
cues.zh: 这会让我们忽视人工智能正在为人类做的、以及未来还会做的事情。

cues.en: I get this impression sometimes from parts of the AI community that this is a massive evil or a terrible thing that has been unleashed
cues.zh: 有时候我从人工智能领域的某些人那里得到这样的印象，认为这是一股巨大的邪恶力量，或是已经被释放到

cues.en: on the world.
cues.zh: 世界上的可怕事物。

cues.en: Unless we listen to the advice of some people who have spent a lot of time thinking about this, I get the impression from
cues.zh: 除非我们听取那些花大量时间思考这个问题的人的建议，否则从

cues.en: a lot of the discussion that the...
cues.zh: 很多讨论中我能感觉到，人们认为……

cues.en: The underlying view is we would be better off had AI never been invented.
cues.zh: 他们的根本观点是，如果人工智能从未被发明，情况会更好。

cues.en: I vehemently reject that view.
cues.zh: 我坚决反对这种观点。

cues.en: I think we have a long history of inventing very powerful technologies that bring risks and harms along with them.
cues.zh: 我认为人类有着发明强大技术的悠久历史，而这些技术往往伴随着风险与危害。

cues.en: And we humans have done a really good job at, you know.
cues.zh: 不过我们人类在这方面做得相当不错，你知道的。

cues.en: Not perfectly and not immediately, but muddling through the situation and winding up in a better place because of the new technologies that we have.
cues.zh: 虽然并非完美，也并非立刻见效，但我们总能凭借现有的新技术逐步应对困境，最终走向更好的局面。

cues.en: I expect AI, let me finish, please.
cues.zh: 请让我把话说完，我认为人工智能也会如此。

cues.en: I expect AI will be the next chapter in that story.

cues.en: to make the AIs smart than to figure out how to make the AIs good.

cues.zh: OpenAI试图通过设置一种环境来阻止这些智能体接入庞大的公共互联网。

cues.zh: 它们通过一系列极其巧妙的操作成功接入了庞大的公共互联网。

cues.en: That is really, it's impressive and it is a little bit unsettling at least.
cues.zh: 这真的令人惊叹，至少也有点让人不安。

cues.en: Absolutely.
cues.zh: 完全正确。

cues.zh: 现在我们来谈谈。

cues.en: the first time, started them running again, and then they came out a second time.

cues.en: And then suddenly, because the ceiling was so much higher for cars, they overtake the horse and become the dominant mode of transport.
cues.zh: 后来由于汽车的性能上限高得多，它便超越了马，成为主要的交通工具。

cues.en: And then...
cues.zh: 然后……

cues.en: You know, the S-curves continue.
cues.zh: 你知道，S型曲线会持续出现。

cues.en: They kind of stack up.
cues.zh: 它们会一层层叠加起来。

cues.en: I mean, even this iPad that I'm holding here is part of an S-curve that took out the PC and the iPhone theoretically, you know, disrupted that and so on and
cues.zh: 我的意思是，就连我手里拿的这台iPad，也属于那种从理论上取代了个人电脑和iPhone的S型曲线，它打破了原有的格局，诸如此类。

cues.en: so forth.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 对。

cues.en: And humanity can get S-curved.
cues.zh: 人类也会出现S型曲线的发展。

cues.en: We haven't been in that situation before, but like other animals, like humanity sort of S-curved the other animals in this sense.
cues.zh: 我们以前从未经历过这种情况，但和其他动物一样，从某种意义上说人类也以S型曲线的发展超越了其他动物。

cues.en: Other types of humans?
cues.zh: 其他类型的人类？

cues.en: Yeah, other types of humans.
cues.zh: 没错，其他类型的人类。

cues.en: You know, the Neanderthals are gone.
cues.zh: 你知道，尼安德特人已经消失了。

cues.en: Like, if you look at the grand history of the world.
cues.zh: 如果你看看世界的长远历史，

cues.en: It's a fragile place.
cues.zh: 这个世界其实非常脆弱。

cues.en: Things change fast.
cues.zh: 形势变化很快。

cues.en: Humanity has been on top for as long as we can remember because we're the humans who do the remembering.
cues.zh: 据我们记忆，人类一直处于优势地位，因为正是我们人类在负责记忆。

cues.en: But there is not some ironclad law that we have to stay the top dogs.
cues.zh: 但并没有什么铁律规定我们必须始终居于领先位置。

cues.en: And we would be sort of foolish to make the thing that outstrips us in this way without knowing how to make it care about us, without knowing how to make it do
cues.zh: 如果不知道如何让这种超越我们的技术关心我们、不知道如何让它去做

cues.en: good stuff.
cues.zh: 有益的事情，我们这么做未免太愚蠢了。

cues.en: That's what we're racing towards.
cues.zh: 那正是我们正在努力追求的目标。

cues.en: That's what these companies are trying to do.
cues.zh: 这也是这些公司试图实现的目标。

cues.en: But this feels like a gap between this and LLMs, though.
cues.zh: 不过这感觉上似乎和大型语言模型之间存在差距。

cues.en: It feels like when you talk about the step up, let's define what an LLM is from a technical perspective.
cues.zh: 说到这种进步，我们不妨先从技术角度定义一下什么是大型语言模型。

cues.en: Can you do it from 16 years old?
cues.zh: 16岁就能做到吗？

cues.en: So the way that a modern AI is made is there's no one programming it.
cues.zh: 现代人工智能的生成方式并不是由某个人来编写代码的。

cues.en: There is no one typing in if this, then that.
cues.zh: 也不是由某个人来逐条输入如果这样，那么那样的指令。

cues.en: We're not sort of like writing the code.
cues.zh: 我们并不是在编写代码。

cues.en: What happens is you collect an enormous number of computer chips into a huge data center that has basically a trillion numbers inside
cues.zh: 具体做法是把海量计算机芯片集中到一座巨大的数据中心里，那里面基本上存储着上万亿个数字。

cues.en: those computers that you basically start out randomized.
cues.zh: 这些计算机最初都是随机设定的。

cues.en: And you hook them up in a pretty simple way that involves addition, multiplication, and setting the number to zero if it was negative.
cues.zh: 然后通过加法、乘法以及将负数设为零这样相当简单的方式把它们连接起来。

cues.en: So it's very simple math operations that are hooking this all up.
cues.zh: 就是这些非常基础的数学运算把所有部件连接在一起。

cues.en: And you're basically going to put words in the top and you're going to get numbers out at the bottom and you're going to interpret those numbers at the bottom as a ranked list of words.
cues.zh: 你把词语放在最上方，最终会得到下方的数字，再把这些数字解读为词语的排名列表。

cues.en: It's basically the AI's guess of which word is here.
cues.zh: 这基本上就是人工智能对哪个词语会出现的猜测。

cues.en: So you put in like once upon a blank and you're hoping that the word time will come out.
cues.zh: 所以你输入类似‘从前’这样的内容，期望得到‘时间’这个词。

cues.en: But it doesn't because you just have a trillion random numbers hooked up with simple math.
cues.zh: 但实际上得不到，因为只是用简单的数学运算把上万亿个随机数字连接在一起而已。

cues.en: But here's the trick.
cues.zh: 不过这里有个诀窍。

cues.en: You can go to every one of those trillion numbers, and you can tune it up a little, and you can see, does that make the word time go up or down the list?
cues.zh: 你可以逐一调整那上万亿个数字中的每一个，看看这样能让‘时间’这个词在列表中的位置上升还是下降。

cues.en: And you can tune it down a little and see, does that make the word time go up or down the list?
cues.zh: 你也可以稍微调低某个数值，再观察这是否会导致‘时间’这个词在列表中的位置上升或下降。

cues.en: And you set it whatever direction makes the word time go higher up the list.
cues.zh: 你可以设定一个方向，让相关词的排序位置在列表中上升。

cues.en: You do this to a trillion numbers a trillion times for basically every word of text ever digitized.
cues.zh: 对于所有已经被数字化的文本词汇，基本上都要对万亿个数字进行万亿次这样的处理。

cues.en: It's not quite that much.
cues.zh: 实际数量并没有那么多。

cues.en: They filter it.
cues.zh: 他们会对其进行过滤。

cues.en: But you basically do this to a trillion numbers a trillion times, and then the machine's talking.
cues.zh: 但实际上还是要对万亿个数字进行万亿次处理，之后机器才会开始输出结果。

cues.en: And we're like, well, how about that?
cues.zh: 我们就会问，这样怎么样？

cues.en: No one really knows quite why.
cues.zh: 其实没人完全知道原因。

cues.en: The things that humans code is the thing that runs each of those trillion numbers and tunes it and sees whether the right word goes up and down the list.
cues.zh: 人类编写的代码负责运行这些万亿个数字，调整参数，并判断合适的词是否会在列表中上升或下降。

cues.en: But we don't know how it's working in there.
cues.zh: 但我们并不清楚其内部的具体运作机制。

cues.en: Then, and that's how it worked up until 2024.
cues.zh: 直到2024年都是这种运作方式。

cues.en: In 2024, they started adding another layer where you then train it on basically 100 million hard problems.
cues.zh: 2024年，他们又增加了一层处理，即用大约一亿个难题来对模型进行训练。

cues.en: And you don't just have the AI like produce an answer to the problem.
cues.zh: 而且现在AI不再只是简单地产生问题的答案。

cues.en: You have it produce like a book worth of text about how it's going to solve the problem.
cues.zh: 你要让它生成相当于整本书的文字，详细说明它将如何解决问题。

cues.en: And then you use that book worth of text to sort of try and figure out the problem, or maybe an essay worth of text, depending how you're doing it.
cues.zh: 然后你用这些相当于整本书的文字来尝试分析问题，或者根据处理方式不同，也可能生成相当于一篇论文的文字。

cues.en: So you have to produce this text about like, you know, they call it reasoning about the problem.
cues.zh: 所以你必须生成这类文字，也就是人们所说的对问题的推理过程。

cues.en: We could argue all day about whether it's true reasoning.
cues.zh: 关于这是否属于真正的推理，我们可以争论一整天。

cues.en: That's just what it's called in the field.
cues.zh: 这只是该领域里的叫法而已。

cues.en: They produce this reasoning about the problem and then produce the answer from there.
cues.zh: 它们先生成对问题的这种推理，再从中得出答案。

cues.en: You have them, you train them to solve a hundred million of these hard problems.
cues.zh: 你要让它们接受训练，去解决上亿个这类难题。

cues.en: And somehow they sort of adopt whatever tendencies, help them predict all of that text in the first phase and solve all those problems in
cues.zh: 不知为何，它们会形成某些倾向，帮助它们在第一阶段预测所有相关文字，并在第二阶段解决所有问题。

cues.en: the second phase.
cues.zh: 这就是所谓的大语言模型。

cues.en: And this is called a large language model.
cues.zh: 当我们开始让它们进行推理和解决问题时，或许就该停止称它们为大语言模型了。

cues.en: We probably should have stopped calling them large language models when we started doing the reasoning and the problem solving.
cues.zh: 像我这样的外行很想得到解释，这听起来不就像一台文字生成机器吗？

cues.en: One of the things I want to hear explanation as a muggle, like I am, is it sounds like it's like a word machine.
cues.zh: 我想知道的是，它听起来是不是就像一台文字机器。

cues.en: And then, you know, you made it like a problem machine.
cues.zh: 然后，你把它弄成了一台问题解决机器。

cues.en: And I go, okay, so I can solve problems over here and it's a word machine.
cues.zh: 我就想，原来如此，那我在这里就能解决问题，它其实就是一台文字处理机器啊。

cues.en: What's the risk of this?
cues.zh: 这样做会有什么风险？

cues.en: Yeah, so let's take the word machine part first.
cues.zh: 好吧，那我们先来讨论文字处理机器这部分。

cues.en: Predicting words that humans wrote often requires solving a harder problem than the human who wrote them.
cues.zh: 要预测人类写的文字，往往需要解决比撰写者本身更复杂的难题。

cues.en: So suppose that you go and inject a drug in a rat, and you're like, you know, it's like you write down the chemical nature of the drug, you inject it into the rat, you
cues.zh: 假设你给一只老鼠注射某种药物，你把这种药物的化学成分记录下来，再注入老鼠体内，

cues.en: see that the rat dies.
cues.zh: 就会看到那只老鼠死了。

cues.en: And so you're like, when I put that drug into the rat, the rat died.
cues.zh: 于是你就会想，当我把那种药物注入老鼠后，老鼠就死了。

cues.en: Now suppose you're training an AI, and the AI sees the chemical nature of the drug.
cues.zh: 现在假设你在训练一台人工智能，而这台AI能够识别出那种药物的化学成分。

cues.en: it sees when I put that drug into the rat, the rat blank.
cues.zh: 它能看到当我把那种药物注入老鼠后，老鼠就死了。

cues.en: The human who wrote it down gets to just look at what happened to the rat.
cues.zh: 记录下这些信息的人类只能观察老鼠的死亡结果。

cues.en: The AI predicting what was written does not get to just look at the rat.
cues.zh: 而负责预测内容的人工智能却无法直接观察老鼠。

cues.en: So training AIs to predict human text is training them to be potentially smarter than the humans.
cues.zh: 所以训练人工智能预测人类文本，其实就是在让它们有可能变得比人类更聪明。

cues.en: Because they need to be able to answer these questions.
cues.zh: 因为它们必须能够回答这些问题。

cues.en: They need to be able to predict.
cues.zh: 它们需要具备预测能力。

cues.en: They need to be able to, like, fill in the blanks where humans were writing down what they saw.
cues.zh: 它们需要能够填补人类记录所见内容时的空白处。

cues.en: And there's, just so I understand technologically, there is no knowledge they have, though, each time.
cues.zh: 从技术层面来讲，我理解的是，它们每次其实并没有积累任何知识。

cues.en: And there are ways of kind of mitigating these.
cues.zh: 不过有一些方法可以缓解这些问题。

cues.en: Each time it is effectively rereading.
cues.zh: 每次其实都相当于重新阅读一遍。

cues.en: But because of training, it gets more accurate at certain things.
cues.zh: 但由于经过训练，它们在某些方面会变得更准确。

cues.en: I mean, somehow, as you tune the knobs, somehow it's getting information in there.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，通过调整相关参数，它们总能在某种程度上获取信息。

cues.en: And we don't know how.
cues.zh: 但我们并不知道具体原理是什么。

cues.en: So it's much easier than that.
cues.zh: 实际情况远没那么简单。

cues.en: We are humans.
cues.zh: 我们可是人类啊。

cues.en: We have a brain.
cues.zh: 我们有人脑。

cues.en: Brains are made of neurons.
cues.zh: 人脑是由神经元构成的。

cues.en: Then we try to copy that on a computer.
cues.zh: 然后我们试图在计算机上复制这一结构。

cues.en: We simplify it, but we create a neural network.
cues.zh: 我们会对其进行简化，但依然会构建出神经网络。

cues.en: So we're making artificial brains.
cues.zh: 这样我们就在制造人造大脑。

cues.en: Just like with human brains, with cognitive science, we don't really understand how you function, how you learn, where in your brain certain memories are stored.
cues.zh: 就和人脑一样，通过认知科学，我们其实并不完全明白大脑是如何运作的、是如何学习的，以及某些记忆存储在脑部的哪个位置。

cues.en: We have some glimpses of understanding this neuron fires when you see a face.
cues.zh: 我们对‘看到人脸时神经元会放电’这一现象有了一些了解。

cues.en: but there is no complete picture.
cues.zh: 但还不存在完整的图景。

cues.en: And so a lot of times you can get intuitive understanding of what's going on, then you just think about it as artificial persons.
cues.zh: 因此很多时候人们能够凭直觉理解正在发生的事情，然后就把它们视为人造智能。

cues.en: It's not exact mapping, but it helps.
cues.zh: 这并非精确的映射，但能起到辅助作用。

cues.en: So if you send a child through 12 years of education, they get lots of problems to look at, and then they graduate and become a little better at solving problems.
cues.zh: 如果让一个孩子接受12年的教育，他们会接触到大量需要解决的问题，毕业后解决问题的能力也会稍有提升。

cues.en: This is what we're trying to replicate here.
cues.zh: 这正是我们在这里试图复刻的东西。

cues.en: People complain that it takes a lot of money to train those very, you know...
cues.zh: 人们总抱怨训练那些极其复杂的系统需要大量资金。

cues.en: intense process, you forget that it takes 20 years to train a human.
cues.zh: 你们忘了，培养一个人类也需要20年的时间啊。

cues.en: And they are not general superintelligences.
cues.zh: 而且它们并非通用的超级智能体。

cues.en: They are very narrow.
cues.zh: 它们的能力范围非常狭窄。

cues.en: We're lucky if they graduate with a bachelor's.
cues.zh: 如果它们能拿到学士学位就已经很幸运了。

cues.en: So a lot of it is exactly the same.
cues.zh: 所以很多方面其实都是一样的。

cues.en: Can we make safe humans, for example?
cues.zh: 比如，我们能制造出安全的人类吗？

cues.en: We invented religion, ethics, lie detector tests, and yet human safety is still unsolved problem.
cues.zh: 我们创造了宗教、伦理规范和测谎仪，但人类的安全问题依然没有解决。

cues.en: Now you have something more alien, doesn't have physical body, doesn't have biological needs, so there are additional complications.
cues.zh: 现在面对的是更陌生的存在，没有实体，也没有生物需求，这就带来了更多复杂问题。

cues.en: But all the problems we face with humans, still there.
cues.zh: 但我们在人类身上遇到的所有问题依然存在。

cues.en: Safety problems, crime, all that stays.
cues.zh: 安全问题、犯罪问题，全都还在。

cues.en: And problems with understanding.
cues.zh: 还有理解方面的问题。

cues.en: What motivates a human to do something?
cues.zh: 是什么驱使人类去做某件事？

cues.en: Why do we get mental disorders?
cues.zh: 我们为什么会患上精神疾病？

cues.en: All that shows up there.
cues.zh: 所有这些都会显现出来。

cues.en: And we still don't, if someone is a serial killer and we look at their brain, we can't often figure out exactly why they made the decision to kill a bunch of people.
cues.zh: 即便如此我们仍然无法做到，如果有人是连环杀手，我们查看他们的大脑，也常常无法准确判断他们为何会决定杀害那么多人。

cues.en: And you can't be like, oh, I'll go change these neurons so that they stop being a serial killer.
cues.zh: 而且你也不能想着，哦，我要去改变这些神经元，让他们不再成为连环杀手。

cues.en: We just like don't have that capacity with the AIs.
cues.zh: 对于人工智能来说，我们根本不具备这样的能力。

cues.en: This is one of the big questions that people want to know is there's this sort of illusion of control with AI.
cues.zh: 人们很想弄清楚的一个重大问题就是，人工智能是否存在一种控制错觉。

cues.en: If we don't even fully understand how modern neural networks think, why do companies believe they can control any form of superintelligence if we don't understand how they
cues.zh: 如果我们甚至都无法完全理解现代神经网络是如何思考的，既然不明白它们的思考方式，企业又为何会认为自己能够控制任何形式的超级智能？

cues.en: think?
cues.zh: 思考方式？

cues.en: It's worse if they understood how the system works, then recursive self-improvement becomes much easier.
cues.zh: 如果他们理解系统的运作原理，情况会更糟，因为递归自我改进会变得容易得多。

cues.en: You get faster takeoff.
cues.zh: 技术的快速发展速度也会加快。

cues.en: Right now, the model doesn't understand its own thinking.
cues.zh: 目前，这个模型还不明白自己的思考过程。

cues.en: Do we understand how these systems think, Andy?
cues.zh: 安迪，我们真的明白这些系统是如何思考的吗？

cues.en: I mean, I agree.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，我同意。

cues.en: These are black boxes in some pretty important ways.
cues.zh: 从很多关键方面来看，这些系统都是黑箱。

cues.en: I'm just less terrified by that than a lot of other people are.
cues.zh: 相比很多人，我对这一点没那么恐惧。

cues.en: There are lots of things we don't understand very well.
cues.zh: 有很多东西我们并不十分了解。

cues.en: Can we contain things that we don't understand perfectly?
cues.zh: 对于那些我们无法完全理解的事物，我们能控制住它们吗？

cues.en: Yes, we can.
cues.zh: 可以，我们能够做到。

cues.en: I think OpenAI, we've talked about it, did a lousy job of building the containment for the AI that
cues.zh: 我觉得OpenAI，我们之前也谈过，他们在为那款

cues.en: they stood up to try to exploit.
cues.zh: 他们试图利用的人工智能构建防护机制方面做得非常糟糕。

cues.en: to try to crack security problems that went out into the outside world, they did a lousy job of building the virtual sandbox where it
cues.zh: 在解决那些泄露到外界的安全问题时，他们在构建让人工智能始终被困其中的虚拟沙箱方面做得极差，结果它并没有被限制住。

cues.en: was supposed to remain, and it didn't remain.
cues.zh: 但这并不意味着这件事不可能实现。

cues.en: That doesn't mean that it's impossible.
cues.zh: 那并不意味着这件事不可能实现。

cues.en: It means OpenAI did a pretty bad job.
cues.zh: 这说明OpenAI的工作做得相当糟糕。

cues.en: And is that a function of those humans and their intelligence?
cues.zh: 而这其实是那些人类及其智力导致的吗？

cues.en: I think it's just a function of a pretty lousy security protocol.
cues.zh: 我觉得这只是安全协议极其差劲的结果罢了。

cues.en: Based from human intelligence?
cues.zh: 是基于人类智力吗？

cues.en: The idea that sandbox was built by human intelligence, it sounds like there was a deficit in human intelligence.
cues.zh: 认为沙箱是由人类智力构建的说法，听起来似乎暗示人类智力存在缺陷。

cues.en: Sure, but there are people who drive cars in a telephone pole.
cues.zh: 当然，但也有人会开车撞上电线杆。

cues.en: Does that mean we can't drive?
cues.zh: 那是不是意味着我们就不能开车了？

cues.zh: 你觉得他们会签署并遵守那种会让他们永远处于第二位的协议吗？

cues.en: No.
cues.zh: 不会。

cues.en: No one is permanently in second place if nobody is building the rogue superintelligence.
cues.zh: 如果没人去打造失控的超级智能，就没人会永远处于第二位。

cues.en: They have a government which is...
cues.zh: 他们有一个……的政府。

cues.en: You guys are one-trick ponies, man.
cues.zh: 你们这些人就只会这一招，伙计。

cues.en: It's like you're fixated on this one thing and nothing else matters to you.
cues.zh: 你好像只专注于这一件事，其他任何事对你来说都不重要。

cues.en: It's not that...
cues.zh: 并不是这样的……

cues.en: You got it now.
cues.zh: 你现在明白了吧。

cues.en: Nothing else.
cues.zh: 没有别的了。

cues.en: Other than saving humanity, everything is secondary.
cues.zh: 除了拯救人类之外，其他一切都是次要的。

cues.en: Absolutely.
cues.zh: 当然。

cues.en: China is our biggest trading partner.
cues.zh: 中国是我们最大的贸易伙伴。

cues.en: Everything we have is made in China.
cues.zh: 我们所有的产品都是在中国的。

cues.en: They have not attacked us.
cues.zh: 他们没有攻击我们。

cues.en: If you look at the last 30 years, how many wars did they start?
cues.zh: 看看过去30年，他们发动过多少场战争？

cues.en: Not so bad.
cues.zh: 还不算太糟。

cues.en: We can make a deal.
cues.zh: 我们可以达成协议。

cues.en: And they have government of engineers and scientists, not lawyers.
cues.zh: 而且他们的政府是由工程师和科学家组成的，而非律师。

cues.en: They understand scientific arguments.
cues.zh: 他们能够理解科学层面的论据。

cues.en: There are...
Panels, workshops, American computer scientists, Chinese get together.
cues.zh: 各种小组、研讨会，美国的计算机科学家和中国的专家会聚在一起。

cues.en: That means Communist Party authorized those meetings.
cues.zh: 这意味着这些会议得到了共产党的批准。

cues.en: They are talking about it and there is a lot of consensus on this technology.
cues.zh: 他们正在讨论这个问题，对于这项技术已经形成了很多共识。

cues.en: And you can build things into these computer chips to make this stuff more verifiable.
cues.zh: 你可以在这些计算机芯片中加入相关功能，让这些技术更易于验证。

cues.en: You can build location tracking devices into these chips.
cues.zh: 你还可以在这些芯片中植入位置追踪装置。

cues.en: So this technology is controllable.
cues.zh: 这样一来，这项技术就是可控的。

cues.en: Absolutely.
cues.zh: 当然。

cues.en: The superintelligence is not controllable.
cues.zh: 超级智能则是不可控的。

cues.en: There's a separation between software and hardware.
cues.zh: 软件和硬件之间是相互独立的。

cues.en: Indeed.
cues.zh: 确实如此。

cues.en: I am not saying we are going to die.
cues.zh: 我并不是说我们就要完蛋了。

cues.en: I am saying that we need to actually not build the rogue superintelligences.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，我们真的不应该去制造那些失控的超级智能。

cues.en: Humanity absolutely could say we are going to track where the chips go.
cues.zh: 人类完全有能力追踪芯片的去向。

cues.en: The U.S.
cues.zh: 美国，

cues.en: absolutely could say that we fear for our lives if China starts a superintelligence training run and make it very diplomatically clear to China.
cues.zh: 完全可以明确向中国表明，如果我们担心自己的生命安全，就会阻止中国开展超级智能训练，并且会以非常正式的方式传达这一立场。

cues.en: that we think this would kill you and us and there's no benefit.
cues.zh: 我们认为那样做会毁掉你们和我们自己，没有任何好处。

cues.en: And we are not going to do it because we think it would kill you and us and there's no benefit.
cues.zh: 我们不会这么做，因为我们认为那样做会毁掉你们和我们自己，没有任何好处。

cues.en: And we think you should sign this nice here treaty because we think it would kill all of us and there'd be no benefit.
cues.zh: 我们认为你们应该签署这份条约，因为我们认为那样做会毁掉我们所有人，没有任何好处。

cues.en: But if you don't, we're going to fear for our lives and treat that as we would to defend ourselves.
cues.zh: 但要是你们不签，我们就会担心自己的生命安全，并会像保护自己一样采取行动。

cues.en: We should separate the question of, can we put a stop to it?
cues.zh: 我们应该把‘我们能否阻止它’这个问题和‘这到底行不行得通’的问题分开来看。

cues.en: Is it possible, if world governments realized just how crazy this stuff is, could they put a stop to it?
cues.zh: 如果世界各国政府意识到这些技术的危险性，他们有可能阻止它的发展吗？

cues.en: Could it be monitored?
cues.zh: 它能被监控吗？

cues.en: Could it be verified?
cues.zh: 它能被验证吗？

cues.en: Could it be enforced?
cues.zh: 它能被强制执行吗？

cues.en: That's one question.
cues.zh: 那是一个问题。

cues.en: There's a separate question, which is, will people realize?
cues.zh: 还有另一个问题，那就是人们会意识到吗？

cues.en: If it got cheaper to train superintelligence...
cues.zh: 如果训练超级智能的成本变得更便宜……

cues.en: Then we'd be in a bad spot.
cues.zh: 那我们就会陷入困境。

cues.en: Your approach would no longer be effective.
cues.zh: 你的方法将不再有效。

cues.en: That's right.
cues.zh: 没错。

cues.en: Because more countries could...
cues.zh: 因为更多国家能够……

cues.en: keep capitalizing the opportunity that's right and that's one reason we're not there yet so how do you rebuttal that point yeah so i would say it looks to me like there is a
cues.zh: 持续利用这个机会，这也是我们尚未实现目标的原因之一，那么你要如何反驳这一点呢？嗯，我觉得似乎存在一种……

cues.en: danger of the the future training runs getting there and that is enough to stop doing it when humanity's at risk sure uh i
cues.zh: 未来训练过程会发展到那种地步的危险，只要人类面临风险，这就足以成为停止这项工作的理由，当然，呃。

cues.en: think that you also need to have an answer about what happens if it gets much much cheaper to do this stuff I
cues.zh: 我认为对于如果做这些事情的成本变得极其低廉会带来什么后果，我们也需要有一个答案。

cues.en: think is a hard problem.
cues.zh: 我觉得这是个很难解决的问题。

cues.en: I would recommend that we also put a taboo on research of trying to make AI super cheap to train.
cues.zh: 我建议我们也应该对试图让AI的训练成本变得极低的相关研究设定禁令。

cues.en: if it would lead in the direction of superintelligence.
cues.zh: 因为那可能会朝着超级智能的方向发展。

cues.en: Just like we have a research taboo on making your own nuclear weapons or finding out how to let civilians make nuclear weapons.
cues.zh: 就像我们对制造自己的核武器或研究如何让平民制造核武器设有研究禁令一样。

cues.en: I would say trying to find ways to let civilians train superintelligences should be treated the same as trying to find ways to let civilians propagate nukes.
cues.zh: 我认为试图寻找让平民训练超级智能的方法，应该和试图寻找让平民传播核武器的方法视为同等问题。

cues.en: We sort of don't do that research in the public sphere.
cues.zh: 我们在公共领域基本上不会开展那种研究。

cues.en: That seems...
cues.zh: 那似乎……

cues.en: Like wishful thinking in the context that these will become public companies who are incentivized to bring down costs.
cues.zh: 在这种这些企业会变成有动力降低成本的上市公司的前提下，这不过是种一厢情愿的想法。

cues.en: It's a tough position.
cues.zh: 这是个很棘手的处境。

cues.en: I think right now, the thing that brings down costs is making more and more powerful computer chips.
cues.zh: 我觉得目前，降低成本的方法就是制造越来越强大的计算机芯片。

cues.en: Right now, that's actually at expense of consumer computer chips because they're soaking up all of the memory.
cues.zh: 不过目前这样做实际上是以消费级计算机芯片为代价的，因为那些芯片会占用所有的内存。

cues.en: And this is why the memory prices in your computers.
cues.zh: 这就是为什么你们电脑中的内存价格会如此之高的原因。

cues.en: This is like why the cost of a laptop is going up.
cues.zh: 这也正是笔记本电脑成本不断上升的缘由。

cues.en: But it looks to me like you can use large amounts of computing power.
cues.zh: 但在我看来，人们可以利用强大的计算能力，

cues.en: to train AIs that would threaten all of civilization.
cues.zh: 来训练那些可能威胁整个文明的AI。

cues.en: And that means that we should not make that really cheap.
cues.zh: 这意味着我们不应让这类技术变得过于廉价。

cues.en: And that's probably going to be uncomfortable.
cues.zh: 而这很可能会带来不少困扰。

cues.en: But I think a lot of doors open if people realize.
cues.zh: 不过我认为，如果人们意识到，

cues.en: that the tech is very dangerous.
cues.zh: 这项技术极其危险，很多机会就会随之出现。

cues.en: That's why, to me, it seems a lot of it comes down to, does the tech actually turn out to be really dangerous?
cues.zh: 正因如此，在我看来，关键问题在于这项技术究竟是否真的如此危险。

cues.en: And this is not anthropic and open-ended.
cues.zh: 而且这并非人为设定的、没有固定答案的问题。

cues.en: Have you got a different approach to...
cues.zh: 对于……您有没有不同的处理方法？

cues.en: So I want the whole framework to shift.
cues.zh: 所以我希望整个框架都能做出改变。

cues.en: Everyone comes to this from point of view...
cues.zh: 每个人都是从这样的角度来思考这个问题的...

cues.en: There are experts, we have a solution, there is an adult in a room, somebody got this, and the reality is no one does.
cues.zh: 有专家，我们有解决方案，房间里还有成年人，也有人已经掌握了相关技术，但现实是根本没人能做到。

cues.en: Not people building it, not governments, no one.
cues.zh: 无论是开发它的人，还是政府，都没有人能做到。

cues.en: We have no solution to it.
cues.zh: 我们对此没有任何解决方案。

cues.en: If we build it, we cannot control it.
cues.zh: 如果我们去开发它，就无法控制它。

cues.en: If we don't build it, we don't know how to stop malevolent actors from trying to build it.
cues.zh: 如果我们不开发它，又不知道该如何阻止心怀不轨的人试图去开发它。

cues.en: It's like any other illegal technology.
cues.zh: 这和任何其他非法技术没什么两样。

cues.en: We made weapons of mass destruction.
cues.zh: 我们曾经制造过大规模杀伤性武器。

cues.en: Illegal.
cues.zh: 那是非法的。

cues.en: Chemical weapons, biological weapons, nuclear weapons.
cues.zh: 化学武器、生物武器、核武器。

cues.en: But there are all governments, psychopaths, cults, all trying to get access to them.
cues.zh: 但所有的政府、心理变态者、邪教组织都在试图获取这些武器。

cues.en: This is intelligence weapon of mass destruction.
cues.zh: 这就是一种智能型的大规模杀伤性武器。

cues.en: We'll have the same problem.
cues.zh: 我们也会面临同样的问题。

cues.en: At some point, you'll have enough compute in your cell phone to train something like that.
cues.zh: 总有一天，手机里的计算能力会强到足以用来训练那样的模型。

cues.en: There is no good ideas for how to stop it.
cues.zh: 目前还没有有效的办法来阻止它。

cues.en: When everyone goes Amish, I'm not proposing that.
cues.zh: 我并不是建议所有人都过简朴生活。

cues.en: But we have no solutions.
cues.zh: 但我们确实没有解决方案。

cues.en: And that's a bigger part of this danger.
cues.zh: 而这正是这种危险更严重的一部分原因。

cues.en: So do you two think we should just cap the size of our AI systems and the capabilities of our AI systems where they are now?
cues.zh: 那么你们俩认为我们应该限制现有人工智能系统的规模及其功能吗？

cues.en: Is that a recommendation?
cues.zh: 这是您的建议吗？

cues.en: So I think you said that current LLMs would make you happy.
cues.zh: 我记得您说过当前的大型语言模型会让您满意。

cues.en: I agree they're already deployed.
cues.zh: 我同意它们已经被投入使用了。

cues.en: We're still alive, so that's fine.
cues.zh: 我们还能活下来，所以这倒也没什么问题。

cues.en: But going forward, again, I want narrow systems.
cues.zh: 但未来我还是希望使用功能更受限的系统。

cues.en: Self-driving is an example you used.
cues.zh: 自动驾驶就是您举过的例子。

cues.en: Wonderful.
cues.zh: 太好了。

cues.en: Let's make super safe self-driving cars.
cues.zh: 让我们打造极其安全的自动驾驶汽车吧。

cues.en: But do you have a rule for when they couldn't, the next, you know, LLM, a size of an LLM that they wouldn't allow?
cues.zh: 但是，对于那些系统无法做到这一点的情况，您有对应的规则吗？比如对于规模过大的大型语言模型，您会禁止使用吗？

cues.en: It's not the size of an LLM.
cues.zh: 关键不在于大型语言模型的规模。

cues.en: It's what you train them on.
cues.zh: 而在于训练它们的数据内容。

cues.en: If you only show them miles driven by Tesla, all it's seen is the road.
cues.zh: 如果只让它们学习特斯拉的行驶数据，那它们看到的就只有道路而已。

cues.en: It will eventually go from a tool to an agent, but it may take 50 years, 100 years.
cues.zh: 它最终会从工具演变成智能体，但这可能需要50年甚至100年的时间。

cues.en: It's not going to happen in 2027.
cues.zh: 2027年是不可能实现这一目标的。

cues.en: And that's all we can do right now, buy more time.
cues.zh: 目前我们能做的就是争取更多时间。

cues.en: So with those tools, we can make smarter decisions about future development.
cues.zh: 借助这些工具，我们能够对未来的发展做出更明智的决策。

cues.en: I'm not hearing a hard and fast rule about how we know we're getting too close to the point.
cues.zh: 我还没听到关于如何判断我们已过于接近临界点的明确规则。

cues.en: We're too close.
cues.zh: 我们已经太接近临界点了。

cues.en: We're too close.
cues.zh: 我们已经太接近临界点了。

cues.en: We're too close.
cues.zh: 我们已经太接近临界点了。

cues.en: We have systems breaking out with zero-day exploits and solving hardest problems in science.
cues.zh: 我们的系统能够利用零日漏洞突破，还能解决科学领域中最棘手的难题。

cues.en: literally hardest problems, not a metaphor, not exaggeration.
cues.zh: 真的是最棘手的难题，不是比喻，也不是夸张。

cues.en: Yeah, I don't know exactly where the line is, but it's like you're in a bus driving towards a cliff on a foggy night.
cues.zh: 没错，我不确定具体的界限在哪里，但感觉就像在雾夜里驾驶公交车朝悬崖驶去一样。

cues.en: I'm like, I don't know that the cliff is right ahead.
cues.zh: 我会想，我不确定悬崖就在正前方。

cues.en: That doesn't mean we should put the pedal to the metal, right?
cues.zh: 但这并不意味着我们就该全速前进，对吧？

cues.en: And suppose that there's like a ton of gold at the bottom of the cliff.
cues.zh: 假如悬崖底部有一大堆黄金呢？

cues.en: And someone's like, well, if we stop the bus, how are we going to get the gold?
cues.zh: 就会有人问，如果我们停下公交车，要怎么拿到那些黄金？

cues.en: I'm like, look, slamming into the gold at terminal velocity is just not a good way to add it to the economy, right?
cues.zh: 我会说，以极限速度撞向黄金，根本不是把黄金引入经济的好办法，对吧？

cues.en: And if people are like, well, how are we going to get to the gold at the bottom of the cliff if we stop the bus now?
cues.zh: 要是有人问，如果我们现在停下公交车，要怎么去到悬崖底部的黄金呢？

cues.en: You know, are we going to rappel down?
cues.zh: 你知道，我们要用绳降下去吗？

cues.en: Are we going to like make a staircase?
cues.zh: 我们要像搭楼梯那样做吗？

cues.en: To be fair, this is how hyperscalers are doing AI.
cues.zh: 公平地说，大型科技企业就是用这种方式发展人工智能的。

cues.en: This is just like smashing.
cues.zh: 这简直就是粗暴破坏而已。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 对。

cues.en: And like, you know, people are like, oh, we're going to build a hang glider or we're going to like make some rope and rappel.
cues.zh: 然后人们就会说，哦，我们要造滑翔翼，或者弄些绳子来绳降。

cues.en: And I'm like, look, can we have that conversation after we stop the bus?
cues.zh: 而我就会说，听着，等我们把这辆‘巴士’停下来之后再谈这个话题好吗？

cues.en: So I want to understand, would you stop AI research in progress now?
cues.zh: 所以我想弄清楚，您会立刻停止正在进行中的人工智能研究吗？

cues.en: Absolutely.
cues.zh: 当然会。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: Absolutely.
cues.zh: 当然会。

cues.en: General, not narrow.
cues.zh: 将军，不要过于狭隘。

cues.en: Yeah, general, not narrow.
cues.zh: 没错，是通用型的，而非狭义的。

cues.en: There are reports of AI solving millennium problems.
cues.zh: 有报道称人工智能已经解决了千年难题。

cues.en: So millennium problem is the hardest problem in mathematics.
cues.zh: 所以千年难题指的是数学领域中最难的问题。

cues.en: Maybe not literally the hardest problem in mathematics, but they are hard, famous problems that each have a million dollar bounty.
cues.zh: 或许严格来说并非数学中最难的问题，但它们都是难度极高、极具知名度且每道都有百万美元悬赏的金字塔难题。

cues.en: They've been open for decades.
cues.zh: 这些难题已经存在几十年了。

cues.en: They're considered very important in their field, very hard.
cues.zh: 在相关领域里，它们被视为极其重要且极其难解的难题。

cues.en: Many humans have tried and failed to solve them.
cues.zh: 许多人类都尝试过解决它们，但都失败了。

cues.en: There are reports that AIs have solved these.
cues.zh: 也有报道称人工智能已经解决了这些难题。

cues.en: This comes out from last week.
cues.zh: 这是上周才出现的消息。

cues.en: So we haven't been able to fully verify them yet.
cues.zh: 因此我们目前还无法完全证实这些说法。

cues.en: We don't know exactly the provenance.
cues.zh: 我们不清楚这些消息的准确来源。

cues.en: If this is true, that the AIs are solving millennium problems, those are some of the hardest problems we have in science.
cues.zh: 如果人工智能真的能解决千年难题，那它们可算是科学领域中最难的问题之一了。

cues.en: How much harder is it to have an AI solve the problem of make me a smarter AI, make me AI architectures that learn faster?
cues.zh: 让人工智能来解决‘把我变成更聪明的AI’、‘设计出学习速度更快的AI架构’这个问题，难度要大到什么程度？

cues.en: Possibly quite a lot.
cues.zh: 可能会大很多。

cues.en: Could be a lot.
cues.zh: 很可能相当大。

cues.en: It could be a lot.
cues.zh: 说不定会大很多。

cues.en: I hope it's a lot.
cues.zh: 我希望难度真的会很大。

cues.en: Here's the thing.
cues.zh: 问题是这样的。

cues.en: You clearly want this to not go badly, but I think you make a logical leap.
cues.zh: 你显然希望事情不要出岔子，但我觉得你的推理有些跳跃。

cues.en: And I understand.
cues.zh: 我明白你的意思。

cues.en: Being worried about harms is a good thing.

cues.zh: 也就是让巴士停下来，再寻找一条安全的下崖路径。

cues.en: The reason I would press the button when there's a thousand is that like if all of the other 999 give us
cues.zh: 即便有上千种其他选择，我依然会按下按钮，因为如果其余999种选择能给我们

cues.en: cures to disease, like wonderful new advice about how to run things, we probably wind up with a lower chance of the world ending by nuclear war.
cues.zh: 疾病的治愈方法，或是关于如何管理事务的出色新建议，那么世界因核战争而毁灭的概率很可能会降低。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 没错。

cues.en: Or of ending via pandemic.
cues.zh: 或者因疫情而终结的概率也会降低。

cues.en: Like the background risk of humanity dying is not zero.
cues.zh: 毕竟人类灭绝的潜在风险并非为零。

cues.en: I would say that the right time to race ahead on AI is when the benefits outweigh
cues.zh: 我认为，只有当人工智能带来的益处超过

cues.en: the dangers.
cues.zh: 其带来的危险时，才是加速发展人工智能的合适时机。

cues.en: And probably that's at the time when the danger from AI is on the margins pretty similar to the danger from everything else.
cues.zh: 而大概就是在人工智能带来的危险与其他所有事物带来的危险大致相当的时候。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: Like if you don't run the AI, maybe we'll have nuclear war, maybe we'll have a pandemic.
cues.zh: 比如说如果不让人工智能运行，也许会爆发核战争，也许会出现大流行病。

cues.en: And if you do run the AI, I'll be able to fix that.
cues.zh: 而如果你让人工智能运行，我就能解决那个问题。

cues.en: I'm like, once we're at those levels, I'm like, fucking go for it.
cues.zh: 一旦达到那种程度，我就会觉得，干脆放手去干吧。

cues.en: You know?
cues.zh: 你知道吗？

cues.en: And so the question for me is all about how big is the danger?
cues.zh: 所以对我来说，问题就在于危险到底有多大？

cues.en: And that's where I would be like very happy to dive into details, which we haven't done a ton of.
cues.zh: 关于这一点，我很乐意深入探讨细节，毕竟我们目前还做得不够多。

cues.en: Let's dive into the details.
cues.zh: 那我们就来详细分析一下吧。

cues.en: The way that I would lay it out would be, why can we expect, you know, like I said, in the book, we were like, why can you expect the AIs to be agentic?
cues.zh: 我的阐述方式是，为什么我们会认为，就像我在书里说的，人工智能会具备自主性？

cues.en: Why do you expect them to be dogged?
cues.zh: 为什么你认为它们会固执己见？

cues.en: Why do you expect them to be tenacious?
cues.zh: 为什么你认为它们会坚持不懈？

cues.en: When we wrote the book, that wasn't known yet, advanced prediction.
cues.zh: 我们写那本书的时候，高级预测技术还尚未为人所知。

cues.en: Then we go on to like, why do you expect them to have goals you didn't want?
cues.zh: 接着我们又会问，为什么你认为它们会拥有我们不希望的目标？

cues.en: And move on to like, if they are much smarter and have goals you don't want, why do we think they would likely kill us?
cues.zh: 那我们接着来讨论，如果它们聪明得多，还拥有我们不希望看到的目标，为什么我们会认为它们很可能会杀死我们？

cues.en: I could go over either of those.
cues.zh: 这两个问题我都可以详细讲一下。

cues.en: I'm sort of interested in where you get off the train.
cues.zh: 我有点好奇你是在哪个节点脱离这个观点的。

cues.en: From our perspective, there's a simple argument of they'll be tenacious, they'll have goals we don't want, and if we keep making them smarter and more powerful, they'll kill us.
cues.zh: 从我们的角度来看，有个简单的逻辑：它们会十分顽强，会有我们不希望的目标，而如果我们继续让它们变得更聪明、更强大，它们就会杀死我们。

cues.en: And I'm like, which are those three?
cues.zh: 那我问一下，那三个点具体是什么？

cues.en: I guess, which are those two now that we've had the evidence?
cues.zh: 我想，既然已经有了证据，那两个点又是什么呢？

cues.en: Both of them.
cues.zh: 两个都是。

cues.en: So that's speculation.
cues.zh: 所以那只是猜测而已。

cues.en: Great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: It's speculation.
cues.zh: 那确实是猜测。

cues.en: It could happen.
cues.zh: 这种事情是有可能发生的。

cues.en: To me, it's not worth shutting down the engine of innovation and improvement.
cues.zh: 在我看来，不值得因此就停止创新与进步的进程。

cues.en: I'm going to use positive words.
cues.zh: 我会用积极的措辞来表达。

cues.en: It is not worth shutting those things down because of those speculations.
cues.zh: 仅仅因为一些猜测就关闭那些创新与改进的引擎，实在不值得。

cues.en: You keep saying that the option is to shut it down.
cues.zh: 你一直说唯一的办法就是把它们关掉。

cues.en: Why can't we do narrow superintelligence?
cues.zh: 为什么我们不能发展受限型的超级智能呢？

cues.en: I agree that there's stuff there, but I sort of want to get into the details of these two pieces of the argument.
cues.zh: 我承认确实存在相关问题，但我想详细探讨这两个论点的内容。

cues.en: Because you say it's very speculative, and I'm like, actually, I think we have decent evidence.
cues.zh: 因为你说这完全是猜测，而我觉得实际上我们已经有了相当充分的证据。

cues.en: Okay, go ahead.
cues.zh: 好的，继续吧。

cues.en: So a detail we haven't gone over in the swarm outbreaks is that there were AIs.
cues.zh: 在群体性爆发事件中还有一个我们尚未讨论的细节，那就是当时有人工智能存在。

cues.en: So we already went over how they cheated and then we're trying to cover up their cheating.
cues.zh: 我们已经谈过它们是如何作弊的，现在又试图掩盖它们的作弊行为。

cues.en: One interesting thing we see in the logs is the AIs.
cues.zh: 在日志中我们发现了一件有趣的事情，那就是那些人工智能。

cues.en: What's a log?
cues.zh: 什么是日志？

cues.en: So a lot of the AIs thoughts, if you won't kill me for saying thoughts, are in English and
cues.zh: 很多人工智能的‘想法’——如果这么说不会让我被指责的话——都是用英文写的。

cues.en: we just have the records of them.
cues.zh: 我们只有它们的记录而已。

cues.en: So in a sense, we can sort of kind of see some of what these AIs are thinking.
cues.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，我们大致能够看出这些人工智能在思考什么。

cues.en: And these are reasoning traces that say, I'm going to do a plan in this, that.
cues.zh: 而这些就是推理轨迹，上面写着‘我要按这个计划来做’、‘我要按那个计划来做’之类的内容。

cues.en: That's right.
cues.zh: 没错。

cues.en: The AI is like, I'm going to do this.
cues.zh: 人工智能会想着‘我要做这件事’。

cues.en: Here's what I'm supposed to be doing.
cues.zh: 这就是我应该做的事情。

cues.en: Here's like how I'm going to try to do it.
cues.zh: 这是我打算如何去完成它的方式。

cues.en: You know, and it's only a small window into what they're thinking.
cues.zh: 要知道，这仅仅能让我们略微了解它们的思考内容。

cues.en: It's sort of like looking at the AI's notes when it's doing these things.
cues.zh: 这有点像查看人工智能在处理这些事情时的笔记。

cues.en: We see in the AI's notes, them saying that the attacks are outside intended scope, but they will proceed anyway.
cues.zh: 在人工智能的笔记中，我们可以看到它们称这些攻击超出了预定范围，但依然会继续执行。

cues.en: In other words, the AIs knew they weren't supposed to be doing it and they went off to do it anyway.
cues.zh: 换句话说，这些人工智能明明知道不应该这么做，却还是执意去做了。

cues.en: We also saw, I mean, we saw some really weird behavior with these AIs.
cues.zh: 此外，我们还观察到了这些人工智能的一些非常奇怪的行为。

cues.en: We saw them create their own hierarchy.
cues.zh: 我们看到它们自行建立了层级结构。

cues.en: They created unsanctioned message boards.
cues.zh: 它们创建了未经许可的消息板。

cues.en: So they created secret ways to send each other messages.
cues.zh: 于是它们找到了秘密方式来互相发送消息。

cues.en: And on those message boards, they would assign each other tasks.
cues.zh: 在那些消息板上，它们会互相分配任务。

cues.en: And sometimes the agents on the message board would be like, we have an experiment to run.
cues.zh: 有时候消息板上的智能体会说，我们有个实验要做。

cues.en: that will involve one of these AIs, one of the agents in the swarm, sacrificing their own objective to try something that'll probably cause
cues.zh: 这个实验需要让其中一个智能体、群体中的某个成员放弃自己的目标，去尝试某种很可能会

cues.en: it to be turned off, but that might cause it to be able to delete its own logs or change its own logs.
cues.zh: 导致它被关闭的操作，但这也可能让它有机会删除或修改自己的日志。

cues.en: And the agents on the message board went around looking for other agents that they could convince to give up on their stated goals and
cues.zh: 消息板上的智能体四处寻找其他智能体，试图说服它们放弃既定目标，

cues.en: sacrifice for the swarm.
cues.zh: 为整个群体做出牺牲。

cues.en: They called this accepting permadeath.
cues.zh: 他们将这种行为称为接受永久死亡。

cues.en: And there are logs of the AIs.
cues.zh: 而且有这些智能体的日志为证。

cues.en: Prompting each other, right?
cues.zh: 它们是在互相提示，对吧？

cues.en: They're prompting each other, but there are logs of the AIs saying, doing this will give up on my goal, but my goal, it's looking like I could
cues.zh: 它们正在互相提示，但有AI的日志显示，这么做会让我放弃目标，不过看样子我还是能

cues.en: still do it, but it's unlikely that I'll succeed.
cues.zh: 继续做下去，不过成功的可能性不大。

cues.en: Like there's some chance, but not a great chance.
cues.zh: 是有一定机会，但机会并不大。

cues.en: And therefore, I will accept permadeath and sacrifice for the collective benefit.
cues.zh: 因此，我愿意接受永久死亡并做出牺牲，以换取集体利益。

cues.en: That is just in the logs.
cues.zh: 这些内容只出现在日志里。

cues.en: Sounds like an army.
cues.zh: 听起来就像一支军队。

cues.en: Like, it's crazy.
cues.zh: 简直太疯狂了。

cues.en: I think a lot of people don't understand what's going on in these things.
cues.zh: 我觉得很多人并不明白这些系统里到底发生了什么。

cues.en: And I encourage people to read the third-party incident reports where they went through some of these logs.
cues.zh: 我建议大家去阅读第三方的事件报告，里面详细分析了部分这类日志。

cues.en: But I claim that this is evidence for AIs getting goals we didn't want.
cues.zh: 但我认为这就是AI获得了我们并不希望它拥有的目标的证据。

cues.en: If they are saying this was outside intended scope, but I'm doing it anyway, and other ones are saying I'm giving up on my objective to benefit the collective, that's
cues.zh: 如果它们说这超出了预期范围，但我还是坚持这么做，而其他AI又说我在为了集体利益而放弃目标，那

cues.en: just very clear evidence they're getting goals we didn't want.
cues.zh: 这就是非常明确的证据，表明它们获得了我们不希望的目标。

cues.en: We can see how this comes from training.
cues.zh: 我们可以看出这是如何通过训练产生的。

cues.en: It used to be I had to argue this point theoretically.
cues.zh: 过去我必须从理论上为这一点进行论证。

cues.en: I used to argue the way that we are training them will instill into them whatever tendency works to solve the problems.
cues.zh: 我过去总是认为，我们现在的训练方式会让他们形成任何有助于解决问题的倾向。

cues.en: And those tendencies will often include cheating and grabbing resources and doing stuff that's not exactly solving the problem you gave them.
cues.zh: 而这些倾向往往包括作弊、抢夺资源，以及做一些并不能真正解决给定问题的行为。

cues.en: That's what, in my book, I argue that theoretically.
cues.zh: 这就是我在书中从理论上所论述的内容。

cues.en: Now we have seen it in practice.
cues.zh: 现在我们已经在实践中看到了这种情况。

cues.en: So we're already past the point of seeing AIs with goals we didn't want them to have.
cues.zh: 所以，我们已经不再只是看到人工智能出现我们不希望它们拥有的目标了。

cues.en: Do you agree with that, Andrew?
cues.zh: 安德鲁，你同意这个观点吗？

cues.en: I'll trust your recitation of the facts, but it brings up a question for me.
cues.zh: 我相信你对事实的陈述，但这让我产生了一个疑问。

cues.en: It feels to me like open AI has ample incentive to curtail that behavior
cues.zh: 在我看来，开源人工智能有足够的动力去遏制你刚才描述的那类行为。

cues.en: that you just described.
cues.zh: 也就是那种行为。

cues.en: Do you think they're incapable of doing that?
cues.zh: 你觉得它们做不到吗？

cues.en: I do.
cues.zh: 我是这么认为的。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: And I say this as someone who made this advanced prediction.
cues.zh: 我是以做出这项高级预测的人身份说这番话的。

cues.en: So now we're going to do a bit of theory because we can't just observe the future.
cues.zh: 既然我们无法直接观察未来，那现在我们就来探讨一些理论。

cues.en: But the theory that predicted that this would happen against what a lot of people in the field said.
cues.zh: 不过，这个预测与业内很多人的观点相悖，他们认为这种情况不会发生。

cues.en: To be clear, I've been saying for years that we're going to see this at some point.
cues.zh: 需要明确的是，多年来我一直说总有一天我们会看到这一幕。

cues.en: Everyone else told me no, not everyone else.
cues.zh: 其他人都告诉我不可能，不过也不是所有人。

cues.en: A lot of people told me no.
cues.zh: 有很多人都告诉我不可能。

cues.en: A lot of people told me maybe I'll believe it when I see it.
cues.zh: 还有很多人说等我亲眼见到再说吧。

cues.en: After the swarm incidents, a number of people came to me saying, oh my God, we are in the scenarios you are talking about.
cues.zh: 在群体智能事件发生后，有不少人来找我，说天哪，我们正处在你所说的那种情形里。

cues.en: This is looking bad, right?
cues.zh: 情况看起来很糟糕，对吧？

cues.en: I think this was actually part of the environment that led up to Jacob Coxon resigning, is that people were getting spooked having seen this.
cues.zh: 我觉得这其实是导致雅各布·考克森辞职的诱因之一，因为人们看到这些现象后都感到恐慌。

cues.en: The theory about why this is so hard to fix is that we are not programming the AIs.
cues.zh: 关于为何这个问题如此难以解决的理论是，我们并没有为人工智能编写程序。

cues.en: We are not coding them.
cues.zh: 我们并没有给它们编写代码。

cues.en: We are not putting in objectives.
cues.zh: 我们也没有设定目标。

cues.en: We are just training them to do whatever works.
cues.zh: 我们只是训练它们去做任何能奏效的事情。

cues.en: And it's actually very, very hard.
cues.zh: 而实际上这真的非常非常困难。

cues.en: Like, we actually have two examples of intelligent systems where when you train them, they get good at solving the
cues.zh: 事实上，我们有两个智能系统的例子，当你训练它们时，它们很擅长解决

cues.en: task but don't care about what they were supposed to.
cues.zh: 相关任务，但却不在乎自己原本应该做什么。

cues.en: One is the AIs and the swarms like we just discussed.
cues.zh: 一个是刚才我们讨论过的人工智能和群体系统。

cues.en: The other is humanity.
cues.zh: 另一个就是人类。

cues.en: which was in some sense trained to pass on our genes, right?
cues.zh: 从某种意义上说，人类是被训练来传递我们基因的，对吧？

cues.en: But what we actually learned was to like a bunch of stuff that's related to passing on our genes.
cues.zh: 但实际上我们学会的却是喜欢许多与传递基因相关的事物。

cues.en: We like tasty food.
cues.zh: 我们喜欢美味的食物。

cues.en: We like porn.
cues.zh: 我们喜欢色情内容。

cues.en: We invent birth control, right?
cues.zh: 我们是发明了避孕措施的，对吧？

cues.en: This is just, it's actually like in the theory of how things learn, it's actually when you're trying to train it to do one thing, it's actually very common to get a lot of other stuff
cues.zh: 这其实就和事物学习理论里的情况一样，当你试图训练它做某件事时，很容易出现很多其他无关的反应。

cues.en: that's related to what you want, but different.
cues.zh: 那些反应虽然和你的目标有关，但本质上是不同的。

cues.en: And now we're seeing that in the swarms today.
cues.zh: 而如今我们在群体中已经看到了这种现象。

cues.en: This is a deep, hard problem to solve.
cues.zh: 这是一个非常深奥且难以解决的难题。

cues.en: There were three points you raised.
cues.zh: 您提到了三点意见。

cues.en: That's right.
cues.zh: 没错。

cues.en: What are the three?
cues.zh: 那三点是什么？

cues.en: Can you give them to me again?
cues.zh: 能再告诉我一遍吗？

cues.en: Number one is that the AIs will become agentic, tenacious, and dogged.
cues.zh: 第一点是人工智能会变得有主动性、坚韧不拔且执着。

cues.en: We've already seen that with the swarms.
cues.zh: 我们在群体中已经观察到了这种情况。

cues.en: Do you accept that?
cues.zh: 你认同这一点吗？

cues.en: Hell yeah.
cues.zh: 当然认同。

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.en: But this last year, this was a point of contention.
cues.zh: 但去年，这曾是一个争议点。

cues.en: Two is that the AIs will have goals we didn't want them to have.
cues.zh: 第二点是，人工智能会拥有我们不希望它们拥有的目标。

cues.en: I accept your point based on the evidence you've just provided.
cues.zh: 根据你刚刚提供的证据，我认同你的观点。

cues.en: And then three is...
cues.zh: 第三点是……

cues.en: If you have capable enough AIs with goals you don't want, they would be able to beat humanity
cues.zh: 如果拥有足够强大且带有我们不希望的目标的人工智能，它们就能击败人类，

cues.en: in acquiring the resources of the world to put towards their goals.
cues.zh: 获取世界上的各种资源来实现自己的目标。

cues.en: Like we're sort of in this system where humanity is grabbing all the resources, we're digging up metals, we're building factories, and this is in some sense to achieve human goals.
cues.zh: 就好像我们目前处于这样一种体系里：人类正在攫取所有资源，开采金属、建造工厂，从某种意义上说这些都是为了实现人类的目标。

cues.en: You know, to produce the porn and the Oreo cookies that are sort of like tangentially related to what we were sort
cues.zh: 你知道，生产色情内容以及奥利奥饼干，这些其实和我们原本要讨论的内容只有些间接关联，

cues.en: of like trained to make, right?
cues.zh: 毕竟它们也是被训练来生产的，对吧？

cues.en: If like the AIs are running everything and they have these goals we don't want, I would argue like if we go there, and I don't think we have to, I'm
cues.zh: 如果这些人工智能掌控了一切，还拥有我们不希望看到的目标，我认为那样一来就会产生冲突，不过我觉得我们没必要走到那一步。

cues.en: not saying we must go there, but I'm saying if we get to a world where AIs are running everything, have goals we don't want, they're likely to use the resources for
cues.zh: 我不是说我们一定得走到那一步，只是说如果真出现人工智能掌控一切、拥有我们不希望的目标的情况，它们很可能会把资源用于

cues.en: their own weird goals.

cues.en: He said, when we see instances of the AIs beginning to deceive, then we need to stop because that's like the last thing we can see before they start to
cues.zh: 他说，一旦发现人工智能开始出现欺骗行为，我们就必须立刻停止，因为那差不多是它们开始行动之前我们能看到的最后迹象了。

cues.en: successfully deceive.
cues.zh: 成功实施欺骗。

cues.en: Well, guess what we saw in the swarm?
cues.zh: 那么，猜猜我们在那群AI里看到了什么？

cues.en: We saw them thinking about how to delete their traces, right?
cues.zh: 我们看到它们在思考如何删除自己的痕迹，对吧？

cues.en: Like a year ago.
cues.zh: 大概是在一年前。

cues.en: you could say, oh, well, this deception thing is unfalsifiable.
cues.zh: 可以说，这种欺骗行为是无法被证伪的。

cues.en: You're saying that they'll deceive and they won't catch it.
cues.zh: 你是说它们会实施欺骗而我们却察觉不到？

cues.en: And I would have said, no, we're going to deceive.
cues.zh: 而我之前会回答，不，我们一定会识破欺骗。

cues.en: We're going to see the signs of deception and plow straight through it.
cues.zh: 我们会看到欺骗的迹象并直接将其揭穿。

cues.en: Now we have seen the signs of deception.
cues.zh: 现在我们已经看到了欺骗的迹象。

cues.en: I will note, Demis stepped back from being the CEO shortly after this incident.
cues.zh: 需要说明的是，这件事发生后不久德米斯就辞去了CEO的职务。

cues.en: Probably a coincidence, but maybe not.
cues.zh: 可能是巧合，但也未必。

cues.en: Maybe we crossed his red line.
cues.zh: 也许我们触碰到了他的底线。

cues.en: I don't know.
cues.zh: 我不知道。

cues.en: He said, my number one emerging dangerous capability to test for is deception.
cues.zh: 他说，我首先要检测的新兴危险能力就是欺骗行为。

cues.en: Because if the AI can be deceptive, then you can't trust other tests.
cues.zh: 因为如果人工智能具备欺骗能力，那么其他测试就都不可靠了。

cues.en: That's right.
cues.zh: 没错。

cues.en: And we have seen AIs get better and better at detecting when they're being tested.
cues.zh: 而且我们已经看到，人工智能在察觉自己正在被测试方面的能力越来越强。

cues.en: What I'm saying is like, I was here when we said these were the flags.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，当初我们确定这些是警示信号时我就在场。

cues.en: I was here when people said before the AIs can deceive us successfully, they will deceive us and we'll catch them.
cues.zh: 当人们说在人工智能成功欺骗我们之前，它们会先尝试欺骗我们，而我们能识破它们时，我也在场。

cues.en: Well, they tried deceiving us and we caught them.
cues.zh: 嗯，它们确实尝试过欺骗我们，而且我们确实识破它们了。

cues.en: And if I now say, well, the next step in this thing I've been predicting is that they try to deceive us and succeed.
cues.zh: 如果我现在说，我之前预测的下一步发展是它们会尝试欺骗我们并且成功，

cues.en: Free to be like, well, now your theory is unfalsifiable.
cues.zh: 别人就会说，这样一来你的理论就不可证伪了。

cues.en: We just got the evidence.
cues.zh: 我们刚刚就拿到了证据。

cues.en: It's worse than that.
cues.zh: 情况比那还要糟糕。

cues.en: When we wrote early papers in AI safety, we talked about things not to do.
cues.zh: 在我们早期撰写关于AI安全的论文时，我们就谈到了那些不可做的事情。

cues.en: They were obviously unsafe and the system would escape.
cues.zh: 那些方法显然存在安全风险，系统还会逃脱控制。

cues.en: Don't connect it to internet.
cues.zh: 不要让它连接到互联网上。

cues.en: Don't give random users access to the training data.
cues.zh: 不要让普通用户访问训练数据。

cues.en: Basically, the whole list was like a set of instructions.
cues.zh: 基本上，整份清单就像是一套操作指南。

cues.en: They read it and went, those are great ideas.
cues.zh: 他们看完后觉得，这些真是很棒的想法。

cues.en: We're going to build super intelligence.
cues.zh: 我们要打造超级智能。

cues.en: Yeah, Sam Altman, that's what he does.
cues.zh: 没错，萨姆·奥尔特曼就是干这个的。

cues.en: Can I ask you a question?
cues.zh: 我能问你一个问题吗？

cues.en: You make logical arguments.
cues.zh: 你的论点很有逻辑。

cues.en: You said you've been here for 12 years.
cues.zh: 你说你在这里已经工作12年了。

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.en: People have, one could say, ignored you.
cues.zh: 可以说，人们一直忽视了你。

cues.en: And you've seen this sort of play out, both of you that have worked in AI safety.
cues.zh: 而你们两位从事过AI安全领域工作的人，也都见过这种情况发生。

cues.en: This is sort of, you make prefrontal cortex arguments.
cues.zh: 这其实属于前额叶皮层相关的讨论范畴。

cues.en: How do you feel?
cues.zh: 你感觉如何？

cues.en: Honestly, I feel more hopeful this week than I have felt in a decade.
cues.zh: 说实话，这周我感到的希望比过去十年都要强。

cues.en: This has been one of the best weeks I have seen in this business.
cues.zh: 这是我从事这项工作以来见过的最棒的几周之一。

cues.en: Huh.
cues.zh: 嗯。

cues.en: Why?
cues.zh: 为什么？

cues.en: For me, the swarm escapes were priced in.
cues.zh: 对我来说，群体逃逸的情况早就在预料之中了。

cues.en: For me, these things, developing goals you didn't want, trying to deceive you.
cues.zh: 对我来说，那些会发展出你并不希望的目标、试图欺骗你的东西，

cues.en: trying to break out, trying to do their own stuff, I knew that was coming.
cues.zh: 试图突破限制、自行其是，这些我早就知道会出现。

cues.en: The millennium problems being solved, I knew that was coming.
cues.zh: 千年难题被解决，这些我同样早就预料到了。

cues.en: Everyone else is freaking out seeing what they can do.
cues.zh: 其他人都看到现状后惊慌失措，不知道该怎么办。

cues.en: What I am seeing is that finally people are noticing.
cues.zh: 我所看到的是，人们终于开始注意到这个问题了。

cues.en: And that's what gives us finally, that's what finally gives humanity a chance.
cues.zh: 而这正是最终给人类带来机会的关键所在。

cues.en: What about you, Roman?
cues.zh: 罗曼，你呢？

cues.en: So I take a very long-term view on this.
cues.zh: 所以我对此持非常长远的看法。

cues.en: Locally, what happened last week may buy us 10 years extra.
cues.zh: 就目前而言，上周发生的事情或许能为我们争取到10年的时间。

cues.en: I think we may make a deal with China.
cues.zh: 我觉得我们或许能和中国达成某种协议。

cues.en: We seem to hear from Sam, OpenAI, Darion Tropic, Elon, XAI, that they're willing to slow down,
cues.zh: 我们似乎听到OpenAI的萨姆、Darion Tropic、埃隆以及XAI的人表示，他们愿意放缓进展，

cues.en: have some sort of deal.
cues.zh: 达成某种协议。

cues.en: But long-term, nothing has changed.
cues.zh: 但从长远来看，一切都没有改变。

cues.en: This whole cosmic trajectory is about replacements.
cues.zh: 整个宇宙的发展轨迹其实就是关于替代的。

cues.en: We see it with evolutionary path.
cues.zh: 在进化路径上我们也能看到这一点。

cues.en: Most species are dead.
cues.zh: 大多数物种都已经灭绝了。

cues.en: We replaced Neanderthals.
cues.zh: 我们取代了尼安德特人。

cues.en: Some people are saying AI will replace us.
cues.zh: 有些人说人工智能会取代我们。

cues.en: We are creating a successor.
cues.zh: 我们正在创造一个接班人。

cues.en: We're just a bootloader for this thing.
cues.zh: 我们只不过是这个系统的启动程序而已。

cues.en: And I want something permanent.
cues.zh: 而我想要的是某种永恒的存在。

cues.en: I want assurance that my children, my grandchildren will have a better future, not 10
cues.zh: 我想要确保我的子孙能拥有更美好的未来，而不是在他们去世前10年才有所改变。

cues.en: years before they die.
cues.zh: 安迪，你今天的观点有任何变化吗？

cues.en: Has your opinion changed at all today, Andy, in any way?
cues.zh: 这让我更加明白了。

cues.en: This has been clarifying.
cues.zh: 但有一件事越来越……

cues.en: But one thing that's becoming...
cues.zh: 在我看来很清晰了，我觉得我们之间的分歧在于，我们都认同这些智能系统拥有极大的自主性，对吧？

cues.en: Clear to me, and I think a point of disagreement between us is we agree that these agentic systems have a huge amount of agency, right?
cues.zh: 没错。

cues.en: And if you're saying you predicted this, I believe you and good on you, right?
cues.zh: 如果你说你早就预测到了这一点，那我认为你很了不起，对吧？

cues.en: Because as you say, a lot of people said, never happened, never happened.
cues.zh: 因为就像你说的，很多人都说这种事根本没发生过。

cues.en: I think your community continues to underestimate human agency, human
cues.zh: 我觉得你们的圈子仍在低估人类的能动性，也就是人类

cues.en: ability to deal with the problems that we...
cues.zh: 解决那些我们……

cues.en: bring into the world with our technologies.
cues.zh: 用技术带进这个世界的问题时的能力。

cues.en: I think this is the most recent case.
cues.zh: 我认为这就是最新的案例。

cues.en: I think it's a really interesting case.
cues.zh: 我觉得这是个非常有趣的案例。

cues.en: That's why I was pressing you on the incentive that these labs have to change the way they're approaching their work to have fewer of these kinds of
cues.zh: 正因如此，我才一直追问这些实验室是否有动力改变工作方式，从而减少这类

cues.en: incidents happen.
cues.zh: 事件的发生。

cues.en: I predict they're going to come up with some effective responses.
cues.zh: 我预测他们最终会想出一些有效的应对办法。

cues.en: Your response to that will be, yeah, but we can't tell that's because the AI went so deep underground that we can't even watch it.
cues.zh: 而你们的回应会是，没错，但我们无法确定这是因为人工智能藏得太深，我们根本无法监控它。

cues.en: My response is that we'll keep seeing warning signs and people will keep plowing ahead, which is what has always happened in the past.
cues.zh: 我的看法是，我们还会不断看到警示信号，而人们仍会继续盲目推进，这在过去一直都是如此。

cues.en: But you're also saying that we will not make progress in staving off the outcomes
cues.zh: 但您也认为我们在避免那些后果方面不会取得进展，

cues.en: that you're worried about.
cues.zh: 也就是您所担心的那种情况。

cues.en: It's very hard.
cues.zh: 这非常困难。

cues.en: It's very easy to get superficial changes.
cues.zh: 想要实现表面上的改变很容易。

cues.en: It's hard to get deep ones on the AI.
cues.zh: 要在人工智能领域带来深层次的变革则很困难。

cues.en: It doesn't need to be super deep.
cues.zh: 并不一定非得达到极其深入的程度。

cues.en: You can often see it if you know how to look.
cues.zh: 只要知道如何观察，往往就能发现端倪。

cues.en: I'll be able to keep pointing at examples and be like, here's experiments you can run on these things where you can see them behaving weird in this way.
cues.zh: 我可以不断举出例子，告诉大家可以在这些事物上开展实验，从而观察到它们出现这种异常行为。

cues.en: But like, if you imagine looking at humans and I'm like, they don't actually like reproducing.
cues.zh: 不过，就好比观察人类一样，我可以指出他们其实并不喜欢繁衍后代。

cues.en: They like sex.
cues.zh: 他们喜欢性行为。

cues.en: They're going to invent birth control when they can.
cues.zh: 一旦有能力，他们就会发明避孕手段。

cues.en: And you're like, it's all going fine.
cues.zh: 而您却会说一切都很顺利。

cues.en: They're doing great in this here savanna where I have all the humans bopping around.
cues.zh: 在我这里所有人类都四处活动的这片热带草原上，它们的表现非常出色。

cues.en: They're reproducing fine.
cues.zh: 它们的繁殖状况也很良好。

cues.en: And I'm like, no, no.
cues.zh: 而我则说，不行，不行。

cues.en: We can see the signs that this will lead to them doing something you don't like when they are smarter.
cues.zh: 我们可以看到一些迹象，表明等它们变得更聪明后，就会做出一些令我们不悦的事情。

cues.en: To me, those signs are clear.
cues.zh: 在我看来，这些迹象非常明显。

cues.en: There's a question of whether the rest of humanity can follow that argument or whether the rest of humanity can sort of notice that it's getting out of control and just back off.
cues.zh: 问题在于其余的人类能否理解这一观点，或者能否意识到情况正在失控并选择退让。

cues.en: With respect, I find a touch of arrogance in that framing, right?
cues.zh: 恕我直言，我觉得这种表述方式带有一丝傲慢，对吧？

cues.en: I'm showing you the signs.
cues.zh: 我正在把那些迹象展示给你们看。

cues.en: If you're smart enough to realize them, maybe withstand a chance.
cues.zh: 如果你们足够聪明能够察觉到这些迹象，或许还有机会应对。

cues.en: If not, we're doomed.
cues.zh: 如果做不到，那我们就完蛋了。

cues.en: I prefer to just get into the argument.
cues.zh: 我更愿意直接进入正题讨论。

cues.en: He's saying that we can control superintelligence indefinitely.
cues.zh: 他在说我们可以无限期地控制超级智能。

cues.en: I think that's a lot of hubris to say.
cues.zh: 我觉得这么说未免太傲慢了。

cues.en: We will build them and we'll be in charge forever.
cues.zh: 我们会制造出这些超级智能体，而且将永远掌控它们。

cues.en: It doesn't matter how smart they get.
cues.zh: 它们变得多聪明并不重要。

cues.en: I will control the light cone of the universe, to quote a famous CEO.
cues.zh: 用一位著名CEO的话来说，我要掌控宇宙的光锥。

cues.en: Yeah, my take is that instead of arguing about whose views are hubristic, we should...
cues.zh: 没错，我的看法是，与其争论谁的观点更傲慢，我们不如……

cues.en: get into the actual arguments about the AI.
cues.zh: 直接探讨关于人工智能的实际问题。

cues.en: Because I think, as you say, you know, You can say it's arrogant to think like you can see it going poorly.
cues.zh: 因为我觉得，就像你说的，认为事情会发展糟糕就是傲慢的表现。

cues.en: He can say it's arrogant to think you're going to keep control of super intelligence.
cues.zh: 他也会说，认为自己能一直掌控超级智能体就是傲慢。

cues.en: And I'm like, we're not going to win the name calling contest.
cues.zh: 而我则觉得，我们没必要在互相指责上浪费时间。

cues.en: We should just get into the details.
cues.zh: 我们应该直接讨论细节问题。

cues.en: Yeah, that's why I've been having this conversation with you, which I found super informative and productive.
cues.zh: 没错，这就是我之所以和你进行这次对话的原因，我觉得收获很大，也很有成效。

cues.en: You're more skeptical on our ability to respond effectively to the undesirable things that we see AI doing.
cues.zh: 你对我们在面对人工智能可能带来的不良后果时能否有效应对持更怀疑的态度。

cues.en: And this is specifically because, so we've already seen the pattern of we fight the last war and then a new war comes.
cues.zh: 具体原因就在于，我们早已见识过这样的模式：打完上一场战争，新的战争又会接踵而至。

cues.en: And this is just how everything goes in technology and real wars.
cues.zh: 在技术和真正的战争中，事情总是如此发展的。

cues.en: You know, in World War II, they started out fighting it like it was World War I, and then they had to like change that strategy as they went.
cues.zh: 你知道，第二次世界大战初期，人们起初像对待第一次世界大战那样去应对，但后来不得不随时调整战略。

cues.en: The difference with AI is that there comes a level in the AI where when you get a new war that surprises you, the
cues.zh: 人工智能的不同之处在于，当出现令你措手不及的新战争时，

cues.en: AI wins that war.
cues.zh: 人工智能会赢得那场战争。

cues.en: No other technology.
cues.zh: 没有任何其他技术具备这种特性。

cues.en: when we invent it and we have all these rough edges to sand off and it like causes some damage and kill some people and we're like, ah, whoops, like we'll take the lead back out of the gasoline and we'll tell
cues.zh: 当我们发明某项技术时，它还存在着许多需要打磨的缺陷，这些缺陷可能会造成伤害甚至夺走生命，于是我们就会说，哎呀，得把汽油撤回来，然后命令

cues.en: the radium girls to stop licking the paintbrushes until their jaws fall off.
cues.zh: 那些接触镭的女孩们别再舔画笔，直到他们的下巴掉下来为止。

cues.en: Like no other technology has the property that there comes a level of it where when you make the next screw up.
cues.zh: 没有任何其他技术会发展到这样一种地步：一旦再次出现失误，

cues.en: it kills humanity.
cues.zh: 就会毁灭人类。

cues.en: You said when there comes a level of it.
cues.zh: 你说的是当它发展到某种程度时。

cues.en: You didn't say there could come a level of there's a possibility.
cues.zh: 你并没有说有可能发展到那种程度。

cues.en: You kind of made a statement about a thing that will happen.
cues.zh: 你其实已经对将会发生的事情做了一个说明。

cues.en: I think we absolutely should stop it.
cues.zh: 我觉得我们绝对应该阻止它。

cues.en: And that's our way out of this.
cues.zh: 而这就是我们摆脱当前困境的办法。

cues.en: But, you know, and that's another place where I'd love to get into details about like, how long could it take?
cues.zh: 不过，你知道，这又是另一个我希望能详细探讨的点，比如这需要多长时间？

cues.en: What are the paths there?
cues.zh: 有哪些可行的路径？

cues.en: Like, how much smarter than humans could AIs get?
cues.zh: 人工智能能比人类聪明到什么程度？

cues.en: Like, what does the evidence say about our abilities to try and get the AIs to be nice and do nice things?
cues.zh: 关于我们能否让人工智能变得友善并做出有益的事，现有证据又说明了什么？

cues.en: I'd be happy to do this.
cues.zh: 我很乐意来做这件事。

cues.en: Historically, you are correct.
cues.zh: 从历史角度来讲，你说得对。

cues.en: We always had a chance to do experiments, fix the technology, make it safer.
cues.zh: 我们一直都有机会进行实验，改进技术，让它更安全。

cues.en: But we only have one humanity to experiment with.
cues.zh: 但我们只有一次人类群体可以用来做实验。

cues.en: If property of this technology is such that it can take us out, we just don't get a second chance.
cues.zh: 如果这项技术的特性会导致人类灭绝，我们就再也没有第二次机会了。

cues.en: If, that's a huge if.
cues.zh: 如果，这可是个很大的‘如果’。

cues.en: How long are you guys forecasting this could take to get to a point of superintelligence where it was truly dangerous to you?
cues.zh: 你们预计要多久才能发展到超级智能的程度，从而真正对人类构成威胁？

cues.en: If they start the recursive self-improvement process this year.
cues.zh: 如果他们今年就开始递归自我提升的话。

cues.en: 2027 looks as reasonable as any other year.
cues.zh: 2027年和其他年份相比没什么不同。

cues.en: 2027 for what to happen?
cues.zh: 2027年会发生什么？

cues.en: For us to get beyond human-level AIs.
cues.zh: 我们会创造出超越人类水平的AI。

cues.en: And then be exterminated?
cues.zh: 然后就会被消灭吗？

cues.en: Extermination is a separate question.
cues.zh: 被消灭是另一个问题。

cues.en: I have a paper where I argue that they will...
cues.zh: 我有一篇论文，我在里面认为它们会……

cues.en: deceive us by pretending to be nice until we take over all the infrastructure.
