cues.zh: 她说，追逐金钱就如同追逐酷炫的东西一样。

cues.en: You're cool.
cues.zh: 你很酷。

cues.en: You're just like that.
cues.zh: 你就是这样的人。

cues.en: I don't think you're working too hard on doing it.
cues.zh: 我觉得你并没有为此付出太多努力。

cues.en: Thank you so much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢你。

cues.en: You don't like putting on shoes.
cues.zh: 你不喜欢穿鞋。

cues.en: I don't like putting on shoes.
cues.zh: 我也不喜欢穿鞋。

cues.en: It's all good.
cues.zh: 没关系的。

cues.en: So she said, you're chasing money.
cues.zh: 于是她说，你在追逐金钱。

cues.en: It doesn't work like that.
cues.zh: 事情不是那样的。

cues.en: It's also like chasing a girl.
cues.zh: 这也就像追求女孩一样。

cues.en: You really want someone.
cues.zh: 你是真的想要某个人。

cues.en: You have to take a deep breath.
cues.zh: 你得深呼吸一下。

cues.en: But she said to me, even if you were to get money the way you're chasing it, it not only will not fulfill you, it will be negative for you.
cues.zh: 但她对我说，就算你用现在这种方式去筹钱，那不仅无法让你满足，反而会对你产生负面影响。

cues.en: So I said, well, what should I do?
cues.zh: 于是我问，那我该怎么做呢？

cues.en: She said, well, you're a very talented individual.
cues.zh: 她说，你是个极具天赋的人。

cues.en: You should figure out what your superpower is.
cues.zh: 你应该找出自己的超能力是什么。

cues.en: It's the first time I've heard anyone use the word superpower.
cues.zh: 这是我第一次听到有人用‘超能力’这个词。

cues.en: She goes, you need to take your superpower.
cues.zh: 她说，你得发挥自己的超能力。

cues.en: You need to connect it to something that's really meaningful for the world.
cues.zh: 你要把它和对世界有真正意义的事情结合起来。

cues.en: Something you're passionate about, but something that can make a difference.
cues.zh: 要选一件你热爱的，同时又能带来改变的事情。

cues.en: You need to bring those two things together.
cues.zh: 你需要把这两者结合起来。

cues.en: You need to only focus on making that a reality.
cues.zh: 你只需要专注于把这件事变成现实。

cues.en: Employees will want to work with a company that's doing that.
cues.zh: 员工们会愿意为这样的公司工作。

cues.en: Investors want to invest in a company that's doing that.
cues.zh: 投资者愿意把钱投到能做到这点的企业里。

cues.en: And consumers want to buy from a company that's doing that.
cues.zh: 消费者也愿意从能做到这点的企业购买产品。

cues.en: The rest will follow.
cues.zh: 其他方面的人也会随之跟进。

cues.en: Then she said, success, the way you define it then, that money success you think is there, will fall on you from the sky more than you can ever imagine.
cues.zh: 然后她说，按照你定义的成功标准，那种你认为存在的金钱上的成功，会以超出你想象的速度从天而降落到你身上。

cues.en: I was like, I want to marry this woman.
cues.zh: 我当时就想，我一定要娶这个女人。

cues.en: I proposed three months after we met.
cues.zh: 我们见面三个月后我就向她求婚了。

cues.en: And the idea of we was central to this drawing that I have in front of me, which is...
cues.zh: 而我面前这张图的核心理念就是‘我们’，它就是……

cues.en: A drawing you did on a whiteboard when you were 31 years old, 2010, with your partner, Miguel, after selling your company, I think it was called Green Desk?
cues.zh: 那是你2010年31岁时，和你的搭档米格尔在卖掉公司之后，在白板上画的图，我记得那家公司叫Green Desk吧？

cues.en: Green Desk.
cues.zh: 绿色办公桌。

cues.en: You sold it for how much?
cues.zh: 你当时是以多少价格卖掉它的？

cues.en: It wasn't like a...
cues.zh: 那并不是那种……

cues.en: 1.5 million.
Okay, nice.
cues.zh: 好的，不错。

cues.en: There were three partners.
cues.zh: 当时有三位合伙人。

cues.en: So we each got half a million, half a million, half a million.
cues.zh: 所以我们每人分到了五十万，五十万，五十万。

cues.en: But our partner didn't want to pay us the whole amount up front.
cues.zh: 但我们的合伙人不想一次性把全部款项付给我们。

cues.en: So he only gave us $300,000.
cues.zh: 所以他只给了我们30万美元。

cues.en: The rest was installment over four years for Miguel and I.
cues.zh: 剩下的部分由我和米格尔在四年内分期支付。

cues.en: And I remember telling Miguel, Miguel, you keep the money because I'll waste it.
cues.zh: 我记得当时对米格尔说，钱你留着吧，我会把钱花掉的。

cues.en: First time I ever made money.
cues.zh: 那是我第一次赚到钱。

cues.en: You keep the money because I will waste it and we'll keep it for our next business.
cues.zh: 钱你留着，我会浪费的，我们把它留下来用于下一项业务。

cues.en: And the way the universe works, by the way, the universe speaks to us, these signs start happening and you sort of, one thing leads to another.
cues.zh: 顺便说一下，宇宙的运行方式就是它会向我们传递信号，各种迹象接连出现，一件事接着另一件事发生。

cues.en: It's almost serendipity.
cues.zh: 这几乎就像是机缘巧合。

cues.en: Our first WeWork building, to get the building, the landlord wouldn't give it to us unless we gave a check of exactly $300,000.
cues.zh: 我们的第一座WeWork办公大楼，为了拿下那栋楼，房东除非我们开一张恰好30万美元的支票，否则不会把楼给我们。

cues.en: The same $300,000 that was sitting in Miguel's account.
cues.zh: 就是米格尔账户里那30万美元。

cues.en: It went from there to there and WeWork was created.
cues.zh: 这笔钱从那里转到了另一处，WeWork就这样诞生了。

cues.en: So tell me what that is.
cues.zh: 那么请告诉我那是什么。

cues.en: Okay, we're in Green Desk.
cues.zh: 好的，我们现在在Green Desk。

cues.en: Just to remind everybody what Green Desk is, Green Desk was created in May of 2008.
cues.zh: 简单提醒一下大家，Green Desk创建于2008年5月。

cues.en: The world was crashing.
cues.zh: 当时全球经济正在崩溃。

cues.en: That was the downturn.
cues.zh: 那是一段经济低迷的时期。

cues.en: And before it started, Miguel and I got to know each other.
cues.zh: 在这一切开始之前，米格尔和我就已经认识了。

cues.en: He was an architect, and I had a baby clothing company.
cues.zh: 他是建筑师，而我经营着一家婴儿服装公司。

cues.en: And we're in the same building.
cues.zh: 我们住在同一栋楼里。

cues.en: My roommate introduced us, and we would just talk about doing great things.
cues.zh: 我的室友把我们介绍给了彼此，我们会经常聊聊一起创造伟大事业的事。

cues.en: And there was a landlord there.
cues.zh: 那里还有一位房东。

cues.en: And every day he would see me and go, Adam, your baby clothing company sucks.
cues.zh: 每天他都会见到我，然后说：亚当，你的婴儿服装公司太差劲了。

cues.en: And I said, Mr.
cues.zh: 我说：先生，

cues.en: Gottman, why do you say that?
cues.zh: 戈特曼，您为什么这么说？

cues.en: He said, well, my wife, we have eight kids.
cues.zh: 他说：嗯，我妻子，我们一共有八个孩子。

cues.en: She loves buying baby clothes.
cues.zh: 她很喜欢买婴儿服装。

cues.en: She didn't once buy from you.
cues.zh: 可她一次都没在你那儿买过东西。

cues.en: I don't know how you pay me rent.
cues.zh: 我真不明白您怎么能付我房租。

cues.en: Your baby clothes suck.
cues.zh: 您的婴儿服装实在糟糕。

cues.en: And I would say, well, Mr.
cues.zh: 我会说：嗯，先生，

cues.en: Gottman, you own all this real estate around here.
cues.zh: 戈特曼，您拥有这附近的全部房产啊。

cues.en: He goes, yes, I do.
cues.zh: 他说：没错，确实如此。

cues.en: I said, your real estate sucks.
cues.zh: 我说：您的房产也太差劲了。

cues.en: He goes, why do you say that?
cues.zh: 他问，你为什么这么说？

cues.en: I said, it's all empty.
cues.zh: 我说，那里全是空的。

cues.en: And we would do that for four months, back and forth.
cues.zh: 我们就这样来回讨论了四个月。

cues.en: One day he looks at me and goes, Adam.
cues.zh: 有一天他看着我说，亚当。

cues.en: if I gave you one of my buildings, you keep saying that it sucks, what would you do with it?
cues.zh: 如果我把我的一栋楼给你，而你一直说它很差，你会怎么利用它？

cues.en: So he takes me upstairs and he shows me this beautiful floor plate.
cues.zh: 于是他带我上楼，给我看了那张漂亮的楼层平面图。

cues.en: And I said to him, how much do you get in rent?
cues.zh: 我问他自己能收多少租金？

cues.en: He goes, $5,000 a month.
cues.zh: 他说，每月5000美元。

cues.en: I said, well, it's empty, but let's say you would get $5,000.
cues.zh: 我说，虽然那里是空的，但就算你能收5000美元吧。

cues.en: I said, look, I'm a small business.
cues.zh: 我说，听着，我只是一家小企业。

cues.en: I don't need this much.
cues.zh: 我不需要这么多。

cues.en: Let's divide it to 15 small places, spaces.
cues.zh: 咱们把它分成15个小空间吧。

cues.en: We'll charge $1,000 each.
cues.zh: 我们每处将收取1000美元。

cues.en: We'll put a receptionist.
cues.zh: 我们会安排一名前台接待。

cues.en: We'll pay the receptionist $2,500.
cues.zh: 我们需要支付给这名前台2500美元。

cues.en: We'll get $15,000.
cues.zh: 这样我们就能获得15000美元。

cues.en: That will leave us with 12,500.
cues.zh: 这样一来，我们还能剩下12500美元。

cues.en: You will get 7,500 and we'll get the difference.
cues.zh: 你会得到7500美元，剩下的差价归我们。

cues.en: And he was like, let me think about it.
cues.zh: 他当时说，让我考虑一下。

cues.en: He calls me the next day.
cues.zh: 第二天他给我打了电话。

cues.en: He goes, I love it.
cues.zh: 他说，我非常喜欢这个方案。

cues.en: But instead of one floor, take the whole building.
cues.zh: 不过不要只租一层，干脆把整栋楼都租下来。

cues.en: It had five floors.
cues.zh: 那栋楼共有五层。

cues.en: We'll put the receptionist downstairs so we can share the expenses.
cues.zh: 我们会把前台安排在楼下，这样就能分摊费用。

cues.en: It will be even better.
cues.zh: 情况会变得更好。

cues.en: And we put five ads on Craigslist.
cues.zh: 我们在Craigslist上投放了五则广告。

cues.en: We launched Green Desk.
cues.zh: 我们推出了Green Desk。

cues.en: It was 92% full within a week.
cues.zh: 一周之内它的入住率就达到了92%。

cues.en: Started cash flowing positive, which was a new thing for me because this was my fourth business.
cues.zh: 现金流开始转为正数，这对我来说是件新鲜事，因为这是我的第四家企业。

cues.en: Never had cash flow positive.
cues.zh: 我以前从未有过正的现金流。

cues.en: Cash flowing positive within a month and became very successful very fast.
cues.zh: 一个月内现金流就转为正数，公司很快便取得了巨大成功。

cues.en: After about six, maybe 12 months, we started thinking bigger.
cues.zh: 大约六个月，或许十二个月后，我们开始考虑更大的目标。

cues.en: Miguel and I said, we'll take Green Disk National.
cues.zh: 米格尔和我商量说，我们要把Green Desk扩展到全国范围。

cues.en: We went to our landlord, said, I'm not interested.
cues.zh: 我们去找房东，表示没有兴趣。

cues.en: We asked for $20 million.
cues.zh: 我们提出了2000万美元的要求。

cues.en: We said, we'll split the business 50-50.
cues.zh: 我们说会以五五的比例分割这家企业。

cues.en: He wasn't interested.
cues.zh: 他对此不感兴趣。

cues.en: So we started, and very soon after, he said, I'll buy it from you.
cues.zh: 于是我们开始了项目，没过多久他就说，我要从你这儿买下它。

cues.en: And we started planning this.
cues.zh: 接着我们就开始规划这件事。

cues.en: And you drew this on a whiteboard.
cues.zh: 你把设计图画在白板上。

cues.en: Miguel drew this on the wall, not even a whiteboard.
cues.zh: 米格尔把设计图画在墙上，甚至都不是白板。

cues.en: The walls were made of glass.
cues.zh: 那些墙是玻璃做的。

cues.en: This was drawn on the glass.
cues.zh: 设计图就画在玻璃上。

cues.en: So all of our walls in Green Disk were also whiteboards.
cues.zh: 所以Green Disk里的所有墙面也都是白板。

cues.en: And because everybody was about creating and inventing.
cues.zh: 因为大家都热衷于创造与发明。

cues.en: And what you see here is that social life, commercial, friends is here.
cues.zh: 而你在这里看到的，就是社交生活、商业活动以及朋友间的往来。

cues.en: This proves the fact Ben Horowitz in the interview that you saw, he did with me in the podcast.
cues.zh: 这印证了你在采访中看到的本·霍洛维茨在播客里跟我说的那句话。

cues.en: He says to me, Adam, you've always had one idea.
cues.zh: 他对我说，亚当，你一直只有一个想法。

cues.en: And then at the end, the apologist said, Adam, I didn't mean to say you only have one idea.
cues.zh: 最后，那个辩解者说道：亚当，我并不是说你只有一个想法。

cues.en: Of course you have all these ideas.
cues.zh: 你当然有很多想法啊。

cues.en: I said, Ben, you're right.
cues.zh: 我说，本，你说得对。

cues.en: This is not that different from what flow is.
cues.zh: 这和‘心流’的状态并没有太大区别。

cues.en: This is all about the friends and all about the living and all about the working, life essentials.
cues.zh: 这一切都与朋友、生活以及工作这些生活必需品有关。

cues.en: Wow, I haven't seen this for a long time.
cues.zh: 哇，我好久没见到这个了。

cues.en: FinTech, travel, everything in between.
cues.zh: 金融科技、旅游，还有介于两者之间的各种领域。

cues.en: So for anyone that's watching, listening and can't see, it's a circle that has lots of circles in it.
cues.zh: 所以对于正在观看、聆听却看不见的人来说，它就是一个里面包含许多小圆圈的圆圈。

cues.en: And it says all the little circles are like travel, health, social life, friends, co-work, co-workers, supporters, life
cues.zh: 上面写着，所有这些小圆圈分别代表旅游、健康、社交生活、朋友、协作办公、同事、支持者以及生活必需品。

cues.en: essentials, work rituals.
cues.zh: 还有工作惯例。

cues.en: Work rituals.
cues.zh: 工作惯例。

cues.en: Again, you can read it better than me, but that makes sense.
cues.zh: 再说一次，你们读起来应该比我更清楚，但这确实很有道理。

cues.en: And this was the idea for WeWork.
cues.zh: 而这，就是WeWork的诞生理念。

cues.en: This is the idea for WeWork.
cues.zh: 这就是WeWork的创立构想。

cues.en: So sometimes people said, oh, you grew out of desks and chairs.
cues.zh: 所以有时候人们会说，哦，你们已经不再局限于桌椅了。

cues.en: You shouldn't have gone to all these categories.
cues.zh: 你们本不该涉足这么多的业务领域。

cues.en: The idea started, this was before there was one desk.
cues.zh: 这个想法最初出现时，还根本没有固定的办公桌。

cues.en: What is the essence of this?
cues.zh: 它的核心究竟是什么？

cues.en: We wanted to make a world, at least in our opinion, that really needed community.
cues.zh: 在我们看来，我们想要打造一个真正需要社群支撑的世界。

cues.en: This was to deliver on a mission of create a world where people make a life and not just a living.
cues.zh: 我们的使命是创造一个让人们能够过上有意义的生活而非仅仅谋生的世界。

cues.en: This was a full lifestyle, life circle.
cues.zh: 这是一种完整的生活方式，一个完整的生活圈。

cues.en: And it was very aspirational.
cues.zh: 而且它充满了远大愿景。

cues.en: And it's how, by the way, for any one of our listeners or your listeners that is starting a business, start with a vision.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，对于我们或你们的任何一位正在创业的听众来说，都应该从明确的愿景开始。

cues.en: Dream as high as you can.
cues.zh: 把梦想定得尽可能高远。

cues.en: Go all the way to the stars, because if you don't shoot for the stars, you're never going to get to the moon.
cues.zh: 要直奔星辰，因为如果不以星辰为目标，就永远到不了月球。

cues.en: Go far.
cues.zh: 要走得更远。

cues.en: Then take a deep breath and go back to basics.
cues.zh: 然后深呼吸，回归基础。

cues.en: What do I need to do first?
cues.zh: 我首先需要做什么？

cues.en: What do I need to do second?
cues.zh: 我其次需要做什么？

cues.en: What do I need to do third?
cues.zh: 我第三需要做什么？

cues.en: The secret of life and entrepreneurship is to be able to be in both places at the same time.
cues.zh: 生活与创业的秘诀在于能够同时身处两个地方。

cues.en: On the one hand, I'm going to go so far.
cues.zh: 一方面，我要走得非常远。

cues.en: On the other hand, I'm just starting, so I better roll up my sleeves and get the broom and start brooming.
cues.zh: 另一方面，我才刚刚起步，最好立刻动手，拿起扫帚开始打扫。

cues.en: It's both of them.
cues.zh: 就是这两者兼备。

cues.en: I need to go knock on doors.
cues.zh: 我需要去敲门拜访。

cues.en: I need to go meet people.
cues.zh: 我需要去结识人脉。

cues.en: I need to do whatever work needs to be done at the beginning to get the business started.
cues.zh: 我得先完成所有启动业务所需的准备工作。

cues.en: Let's talk about both then.
cues.zh: 那我们就两方面的内容都谈一谈吧。

cues.en: So you've got the trenches and then you've got, let's say, the clouds or the moon, as you refer to it.
cues.zh: 也就是说，有眼前的实际工作，还有你所说的那些远大的目标，比如云端或月球之类的。

cues.en: Why is it important to dream big?
cues.zh: 为什么要有远大的梦想呢？

cues.en: Why is the scale and the size of the dream important?
cues.zh: 为什么梦想的规模和程度如此重要？

cues.en: So I believe it's the secret of manifestation.
cues.zh: 我认为这就是实现目标的秘诀。

cues.en: So when people ask me, Adam, what is the secret of manifestation?
cues.zh: 所以当人们问我，亚当，实现目标的秘诀是什么？

cues.en: How do you make something out of nothing?
cues.zh: 要如何无中生有地创造出东西？

cues.en: I think the order is, first you have to believe.
cues.zh: 我觉得顺序是，首先必须要有信念。

cues.en: If you and I have a big idea, first we have to believe it.
cues.zh: 如果你我都有一个伟大的想法，首先就得相信它。

cues.en: Then, that takes time to believe.
cues.zh: 然后，建立这种信念需要时间。

cues.en: True belief, by the way, do you know when belief is measured?
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，真正的信念，你知道信念是如何被衡量的吗？

cues.en: No.
cues.zh: 不。

cues.en: When it's really tough.
cues.zh: 在情况极其艰难的时候。

cues.en: Belief is not measured on everything.
cues.zh: 并非所有事情都要用信念来衡量。

cues.en: So I remember this, this is, and I've shared this story before, but your audience is so wide that I'm sure a lot of them haven't heard it.
cues.zh: 我记得这个故事，之前也讲过，但你们的受众范围如此之广，我敢肯定很多人还没听过。

cues.en: when right after the whole explosion of WeWork occurred and it was like five days in and the whole thing was crashing on us and there's a million articles and
cues.zh: 就在WeWork遭遇巨大危机后的五天左右，各种问题接连袭来，还有无数篇文章出现，

cues.en: the whole thing is happening, my spiritual teacher, who I haven't spoken at this point almost for two years after I studied with him for eight years, calls me, said,
cues.zh: 就在这一切发生的时候，我那位灵性导师——我跟他学习过八年，之后几乎有两年没联系过他——给我打了电话，说道，

cues.en: Adam, how are you doing?
cues.zh: 亚当，你最近怎么样？

cues.en: I said, I'm not doing so well right now.
cues.zh: 我说，我现在状况不太好。

cues.en: It's crazy.
cues.zh: 简直太疯狂了。

cues.en: He said, oh, great.
cues.zh: 他说，哦，那挺好。

cues.en: That's why I called you.
cues.zh: 所以我才给你打电话的。

cues.en: I said, why did you call me?
cues.zh: 我说，你为什么给我打电话？

cues.en: His name is Eitan.
cues.zh: 他叫埃坦。

cues.en: I said, Eitan, why didn't you call me?
cues.zh: 我说，埃坦，你为什么没给我打电话？

cues.en: He said, I called you to make sure that you remember the two things we learned for eight years.
cues.zh: 他说，我打电话是为了确保你记得我们八年来学过的两件事。

cues.en: I said, Eitan, we didn't learn two things for eight years.
cues.zh: 我说，埃坦，我们又不是八年来只学了两件事。

cues.en: We studied twice a week.
cues.zh: 我们每周学习两次。

cues.en: We learned endless things.
cues.zh: 我们学过无数东西。

cues.en: He goes, no, you missed it.
cues.zh: 他说，不，你搞错了。

cues.en: We learned two things.
cues.zh: 我们确实学了两件事。

cues.en: I said, please remind me.
cues.zh: 我说，请提醒我一下。

cues.en: He goes, one was love thy neighbor as yourself, and the rest is commentary.
cues.zh: 他说，其一是要爱人如己，其余的都是附带的说明。

cues.en: It took a second for it to say, let's talk about this for a second.
cues.zh: 过了一会儿他才说，我们先花点时间聊聊这个。

cues.en: What does love the neighbors yourself mean to you?
cues.zh: 对你来说，爱人如己是什么意思？

cues.en: Such a famous saying, we've heard it so many times.
cues.zh: 这是一句非常有名的谚语，我们听过太多次了。

cues.en: When I think about it, the way that I understand it is to have empathy and compassion for all of the complexities, both
cues.zh: 仔细想想，我理解它的含义是对所有复杂的情况都怀有同理心与同情心，

cues.en: the good, the bad, the indifferent, and that which you don't understand, which is like how I would treat myself.
cues.zh: 无论是好的、坏的、漠不关心的，还是那些你无法理解的，就如同我会对待自己一样。

cues.en: Like I understand.
cues.zh: 我明白这个意思。

cues.en: or that I'm a complex person and that I'm multifaceted and imperfect and that I have strengths and weaknesses and I'm okay with all of it.
cues.zh: 也就是说，我是一个复杂的人，有着多面性且并不完美，我有优点也有缺点，但我能接受这一切。

cues.en: And in others, we're less okay with all of it.
cues.zh: 而对于别人，我们却不太能接受他们的一切。

cues.en: Beautiful.
cues.zh: 真美。

cues.en: Let's say it a little bit in different words, but that was right on.
cues.zh: 用不同的方式来说说吧，但刚才说得完全正确。

cues.en: Love thy neighbor as yourself means that you first have to love yourself.
cues.zh: 爱邻如己意味着你首先必须爱自己。

cues.en: To love yourself, you have to acknowledge not only the great strength that you have that you love, you must acknowledge your weaknesses, your failures, your mistakes.
cues.zh: 要爱自己，你不仅要承认自己所拥有的、令你喜爱的强大优势，还必须正视自己的弱点、失败与错误。

cues.en: And the only way you can love yourself after all of those is if you're able to forgive yourself.
cues.zh: 在经历了这一切之后，唯有能够原谅自己，你才能真正做到爱自己。

cues.en: So the true secret of loving oneself is to forgive yourself, to not carry guilt, to really be able to know that all of these are lessons for you to grow
cues.zh: 所以，真正爱自己的秘诀就是原谅自己，不要背负愧疚感，要真正明白这一切都是帮助你成长的教训。

cues.en: and change and go to your next level from.
cues.zh: 而实现自我爱的真正秘诀，就是原谅自己、不再背负愧疚，真正明白这一切都是帮助你成长的教训。

cues.en: Back to the sword analogy.
cues.zh: 再回到剑的比喻。

cues.en: You're a sword and you're getting forged and every single time you get hit, you just get stronger.
cues.zh: 你就像一把剑，正在被不断锻造，每次受到冲击后都会变得更加强大。

cues.en: Once you feel that and you're able to love yourself, then you're able to love everybody else.
cues.zh: 一旦你有了这样的体会并能够爱自己，就能去爱身边的每一个人。

cues.en: That was the first thing he told me we learned.
cues.zh: 那是他告诉我的我们学到的第一件事。

cues.en: The second thing he said to me, which we said before, is I want to remind you that the darkest moment of the night is the second before dawn.
cues.zh: 他告诉我的第二件事，也就是我们之前说过的，我想提醒大家，夜晚最黑暗的时刻就是黎明前的那一秒。

cues.en: Belief is not measured on everything is going up and everybody's telling you what a genius you are and everybody wants to be your friend and everybody wants to be your investor.
cues.zh: 信念并非体现在一切都在向好发展、所有人都称赞你是天才、每个人都想和你做朋友、每个人都想成为你的投资人的时候。

cues.en: Belief is measured when it's all crashing.
cues.zh: 信念的真谛体现在一切都在崩溃的时候。

cues.en: when even your friends are questioning you, when the phone is not ringing.
cues.zh: 当连你的朋友都在质疑你，电话也不再响的时候。

cues.en: And if a person is able to have true belief then, then he says to me, if you're going to be able to take this experience and really hold your belief,
cues.zh: 如果一个人能够拥有真正的信念，那么他就会对我说，如果你能接纳这段经历并坚守自己的信念，

cues.en: hold your positivity, hold your happiness, be the person I know you can be, you can't imagine what the future stores for you.
cues.zh: 保持积极的心态，保持快乐，做出我深知你能够做到的那个人，你就无法想象未来会为你带来什么。

cues.en: What did you believe in, in your hardest moment?
cues.zh: 在你最艰难的时刻，你坚信的是什么？

cues.en: In God and in myself.
cues.zh: 我相信上帝，也相信自己。

cues.en: in my wife, in my kids, and in the fact that even though I don't know at this moment why this thing happened, I am going
cues.zh: 我相信我的妻子、我的孩子们，还有这样一点：虽然此刻我还不知道为何会发生这种事，但我一定会

cues.en: to be stronger for it.
cues.zh: 因此变得更加坚强。

cues.en: And I remember that morning, this phone call was late at night.
cues.zh: 我记得那个早晨，那通电话是在深夜打来的。

cues.en: The next morning at 6 a.m., I walked down to my three...
cues.zh: 第二天早上6点，我走下楼去见那三个人……

cues.en: I went from 13,000 employees to three employees in one week.
cues.zh: 短短一周内，我的员工从13000人减少到了3人。

cues.en: I walked down to the three employees who were my partners in the family office, not even employees, partners.
cues.zh: 我走下楼去见那三位在家族办公室里与我共事的人，他们甚至算不上员工，而是合伙人。

cues.en: I walked down to them, and I'm smiling.
cues.zh: 我走到他们面前，脸上带着微笑。

cues.en: And they're stressed out.
cues.zh: 而他们则显得压力极大。

cues.en: We would meet every day at 6 a.m.
cues.zh: 我们每天早上6点都会见面。

cues.en: They were done.
cues.zh: 他们已经筋疲力尽了。

cues.en: We're bankrupt.
cues.zh: 我们破产了。

cues.en: It's finished.
cues.zh: 一切都结束了。

cues.en: They only joined me three months before they came to manage what they thought was a $5 to $10 billion family office.
cues.zh: 他们在三个月前才加入我，随后负责管理他们认为价值50亿到100亿美元的家族办公室。

cues.en: And they're dealing with negative $400 million compounding interest, full bankruptcy situation.
cues.zh: 而他们当时正面临着4亿美元的负复利，处于彻底破产的境地。

cues.en: And I thought about them all my, not all, a lot of friends that I had that were really there with me and enjoyed with me and grew with me and made money
cues.zh: 我想起了那些曾经真正陪伴在我身边、与我共度欢乐时光、与我共同成长并一起赚钱的朋友们，

cues.en: with me.
cues.zh: 就是那些和我一起的人。

cues.en: When I really needed that one small moment, a lot of them weren't there.
cues.zh: 就在我真正需要那一点点支持的时候，他们很多人却不在我身边。

cues.en: And these three almost strangers, who I didn't really know, were standing right there by my side.
cues.zh: 而这三个我几乎不认识的陌生人，就站在我身旁。

cues.en: And they see me smiling and say, Adam, why are you smiling?
cues.zh: 他们看到我在微笑，便问：亚当，你为什么在笑？

cues.en: They're like, they thought I really lost my mind.
cues.zh: 他们觉得我一定是疯了。

cues.en: It was done.
cues.zh: 事情已经解决了。

cues.en: And I said, I'm smiling because I remember that the darkest moment of the night is a second before dawn.
cues.zh: 我说，我笑是因为我记得夜晚最黑暗的时刻就是黎明前的那一秒。

cues.en: And I remember that belief is actually measured when things are difficult, not when everything is working.
cues.zh: 我也记得，这种信念其实是在困难时刻才能体现的，而不是在一切顺利的时候。

cues.en: And I believe, and I know it's going to work out, and I don't know how, and I don't know why, but this is all going to work out for the best.
cues.zh: 我相信事情最终会好起来的，虽然我不知道具体怎么做，也不明白原因，但一切都会朝着最好的方向发展。

cues.en: And we're going to learn a lot from this, and it will actually prepare us when a real difficulty happens.
cues.zh: 我们会从这次经历中学到很多，这实际上也能让我们在真正遇到困难时做好准备。

cues.en: So we're ready to go and deal with it.
cues.zh: 所以我们已经准备好去应对它了。

cues.en: And about 10 days later, we started coming out of it in a very positive way.
cues.zh: 大约10天后，我们的状况开始以非常积极的方式好转。

cues.en: I want to go to the top of the story, because I really want to walk through some of the key moments.
cues.zh: 我想从故事的开头讲起，因为我真的很想回顾其中的一些关键时刻。

cues.en: But I noticed your energy shift a little bit when you started describing those three people.
cues.zh: 不过当你开始描述那三个人的时候，我注意到你的情绪有了一点变化。

cues.en: Here's another thing that I've learned.
cues.zh: 这是我学到的另一件事。

cues.en: If you now haven't, you're facing this as we speak right now.
cues.zh: 如果你现在还没有意识到，那说明此刻你正面临着同样的情况。

cues.en: I bet you have lots of friends.
cues.zh: 我敢打赌你有很多朋友。

cues.en: I bet you have lots.
cues.zh: 我敢肯定你的朋友非常多。

cues.en: That's how you define friends.
cues.zh: 这就是你对朋友的定义。

cues.en: Exactly.
cues.zh: 没错。

cues.en: Well, I'll tell you a secret about them, and I'm sorry to say that.
cues.zh: 好吧，我告诉你们一个关于他们的秘密，很遗憾地讲。

cues.en: We're only going to know which one of them are your friend and which ones are not, if, God forbid, you crash and you actually need
cues.zh: 只有在你万幸没有出事、却真的需要他们的帮助时，我们才能知道他们当中谁是你的朋友、谁不是。

cues.en: them.
cues.zh: 到那时我也能告诉你你是否会出现危机。

cues.en: And then I can also tell you if you're going to crash or not.
cues.zh: 如果你发展的规模足够大，真的非常大，那你就一定会出事。

cues.en: If you go big enough, really, really big, you crash.
cues.zh: 每当圣诞老人说‘哦，亚当，这种事绝不会发生在我身上’的时候，

cues.en: Whenever Santa says, oh, Adam, it's never going to happen to me.
cues.zh: 我就会想，我的自负绝不会让我失控。

cues.en: My ego is never going to get the best of me.
cues.zh: 我永远、永远都会掌控局面。

cues.en: I'm never, I'm always going to stay in control.
cues.zh: 那些年轻又成功的人总爱对我说这种话。

cues.en: Young, successful people like to say that to me.
cues.zh: 而我会回应，哦，你们的规模还不够大。

cues.en: I say, oh, you haven't gone big enough.
cues.zh: 因为如果真的达到那种程度，那本身就是规模极大的定义之一。

cues.en: Because if you really, really, that's part of the definition of going really, really big.
cues.zh: 人生关键不在于我们是否会跌倒。

cues.en: Life is not about if we fall down.
cues.zh: 人生重要的不是是否会跌倒。

cues.en: We're supposed to fall down.
cues.zh: 我们难免会跌倒。

cues.en: Life is about how we get up.
cues.zh: 人生关键在于我们如何重新站起。

cues.en: And the more times we fall down, the more times we get to get up.
cues.zh: 跌倒的次数越多，站起来的机会也就越多。

cues.en: And if you practice getting up enough times, then you might not fall.
cues.zh: 只要不断练习站起，或许就不会再跌倒。

cues.en: Then you get very good at it, and then you can go and really go for the stars.
cues.zh: 如此一来就会变得非常熟练，进而能够真正去追逐梦想。

cues.en: So with the friends, the reason my energy changed about those three, I didn't know them that well, and they stuck by me.
cues.zh: 至于那三位朋友，我状态发生变化的原因是，我之前并不太了解他们，但他们一直支持着我。

cues.en: I have a weakness with loyalty.
cues.zh: 我在忠诚方面有个弱点。

cues.en: I'm very loyal.
cues.zh: 我非常忠诚。

cues.en: So if you were there for me when things were tough, I'm a sucker for that.
cues.zh: 所以如果在艰难时刻有人陪伴在我身边，我就会特别受用。

cues.en: I'll be there for you, even if you mess up, to a fault almost.
cues.zh: 即使你犯错，甚至近乎犯大错，我也会在你身边支持你。

cues.en: A lot of founders who start businesses have this thing that pop culture is called imposter syndrome, where they kind of do doubt themselves.
cues.zh: 很多创业的创始人都会出现流行文化中所说的冒名顶替综合症，总是怀疑自己。

cues.en: And this sort of sits in contrast to this idea of having belief, because sometimes they don't believe.
cues.zh: 这种情况与拥有信念的理念形成对比，因为他们有时根本不相信自己。

cues.en: And they are plagued with insecurities and doubts, and they kind of go back and forward, and they think, really, am I the person to do this?
cues.zh: 他们饱受不安与疑虑的困扰，总是在犹豫不决之间徘徊，心里想着：我真的适合做这件事吗？

cues.en: I've never done it before.
cues.zh: 我以前从未做过这件事。

cues.en: Which is, that comes with pursuing something great.
cues.zh: 追求伟大的事业本来就会伴随这样的状况。

cues.en: You had never done it before.
cues.zh: 你之前确实没做过。

cues.en: So what do you say to those people who are struggling with doubt?
cues.zh: 那么，你要对那些被疑虑困扰的人说些什么呢？

cues.en: Because they're hearing, listen, you have to believe.
cues.zh: 因为他们总会听到‘你得有信念’这样的话。

cues.en: Did you have doubt when you drew this?
cues.zh: 你画这个的时候有过疑虑吗？

cues.en: Fascinating question.
cues.zh: 很有意思的问题。

cues.en: My level of certainty was so high when I was doing WeWork.
cues.zh: 当时我在经营WeWork时，我的确非常确定。

cues.en: I was sure it was going to work.
cues.zh: 我确信它一定会成功。

cues.en: A lot of times I think people confused my certainty as a different word.
cues.zh: 很多时候我觉得人们把我的那种确定感误解成了别的词。

cues.en: I was that sure that the product is needed for the world.
cues.zh: 我当时非常确信这个世界需要这款产品。

cues.en: When I started Flow...
cues.zh: 当我创立Flow的时候……

cues.en: which was different and came after everything and after also we had a family.
cues.zh: 那是个与众不同的阶段，是在所有事情之后，也是在我们组建家庭之后的事。

cues.en: When I started WeWork, I had no kids.
cues.zh: 当初创办WeWork时，我还没有孩子，只有我和丽贝卡两个人。

cues.en: It was just Rebecca and I.
cues.zh: 那时我很容易全身心投入某项工作，每周七天、每天工作18到20小时，而且乐在其中。

cues.en: It was very easy to throw myself into something and work 18 to 20-hour days, seven days a week, and love every second.
cues.zh: 除此之外，我别无他求。

cues.en: There was nothing else.
cues.zh: WeWork的发展速度快得惊人。

cues.en: WeWork grew astronomically quickly.
cues.zh: 增速实在异常之快，尤其是对那种类型的公司而言。

cues.en: Really atypically quickly, especially for that type of company.
cues.zh: 因此我想直接从您那里了解原因，为什么？

cues.en: And I wanted to hear directly from you, why?
cues.zh: 到底发生了什么？

cues.en: What happened?
cues.zh: 有哪些因素促成了它的迅猛崛起？

cues.en: What were the factors that contributed to this meteoric rise?
cues.zh: 我记得在您创立公司几年后，我成为了它的客户，不仅在纽约，还在伦敦。

cues.en: I think a couple of years after you founded the company, I became a customer of it, both in New York, but also in London.
cues.zh: 我记得在你们创办公司几年后，我成为了该公司的客户，不仅在纽约，还在伦敦。

cues.en: What didn't I see?
cues.zh: 我到底漏看了什么？

cues.en: What was it?
cues.zh: 那是什么？

cues.en: So WeWork started in February of 2010.
cues.zh: 所以WeWork是在2010年2月成立的。

cues.en: And for anybody listening, I think this is the way that it should and could work.
cues.zh: 对于正在聆听的各位来说，我认为这才是它应该且能够运转的方式。

cues.en: I think from the first day we were so clear, as you pointed out with the circle, on the fact that this mission is bigger than us.
cues.zh: 我觉得从第一天起，正如你用那个圆圈所指出的那样，我们就很明确：这个使命比我们自身更重要。

cues.en: And when you're part of a mission that's greater than yourself, urgency doesn't just become something like, oh, we have to do it now because I said so, or because
cues.zh: 当你投身于一个比自我更伟大的使命时，紧迫感就不会变成那种‘因为我这么说了，所以我们必须马上做’之类的理由，

cues.en: we said so.
cues.zh: 也不是因为我们这么说了。

cues.en: When you feel that your mission really needs to come out to the world, then you have to do it now because there's no time to waste.
cues.zh: 当你觉得自己的使命真的需要向全世界展现时，你就必须立刻行动，因为没有时间可以浪费。

cues.en: Because it's really important.
cues.zh: 因为这真的非常重要。

cues.en: And we just started with our first, and part of my energy is I bring people together.
cues.zh: 我们首先从第一个项目开始，而我投入精力的一部分就是把人们聚在一起。

cues.en: I really like creating community.
cues.zh: 我非常喜欢打造社群。

cues.en: But I also, I love to move fast.
cues.zh: 不过我也喜欢快速行动。

cues.en: when we're clear on the direction that we're moving, and I don't believe anything is impossible.
cues.zh: 当我们明确了前进的方向，我就认为没有什么是不可能的。

cues.en: So when you connect that mission of something being greater than yourself, speed, and not accepting a no, you put those things together, then real
cues.zh: 把‘追求比自身更伟大的目标’、‘快速行动’以及‘绝不接受拒绝’这些要素结合起来，真正的

cues.en: magic happens.
cues.zh: 奇迹就会发生。

cues.en: I think that's one.
cues.zh: 我认为这就是第一点。

cues.en: Two.
cues.zh: 第二点。

cues.en: I want an example of that.
cues.zh: 我想要一个相关的例子。

cues.en: I'll give you one.
cues.zh: 我来举一个例子。

cues.en: Many examples, but let's start early WeWork, because I think this all started weird.
cues.zh: 其实有很多例子，但我们从WeWork的早期阶段说起吧，因为我觉得这一切都是从一些奇怪的情况开始的。

cues.en: But before the example, one more thing I was going to say that made WeWork, to answer your question, it's the team.
cues.zh: 在举例子之前，还有一点我想说，为了回答你的问题，让WeWork取得成功的因素就是团队。

cues.en: The team was so dedicated.
cues.zh: 那个团队极其专注。

cues.en: The team believed so much.
cues.zh: 那个团队充满信念。

cues.en: It was their essence.
cues.zh: 这正是他们的核心所在。

cues.en: It was their experience of being part of something greater than themselves.
cues.zh: 那是他们身处比自身更宏大事物之中的经历所带来的成果。

cues.en: And when you can bring a group of people together to all run in the same direction, you almost can't stop anything.
cues.zh: 而当你能把一群人团结起来，让大家都朝着同一个方向前进时，几乎没有什么事情能够阻挡他们。

cues.en: I'll give you an example.
cues.zh: 我给你们举个例子。

cues.en: It's our second WeWork building.
cues.zh: 这是我们的第二座WeWork大楼。

cues.en: We need to do the floor.
cues.zh: 我们需要铺设楼层地面。

cues.en: We only had $90,000.
cues.zh: 我们只有9万美元。

cues.en: We didn't have any more money.
cues.zh: 我们再也没有别的钱了。

cues.en: And all the quotes were $200,000 a floor, whatever the number was.
cues.zh: 而所有的报价都是每层20万美元，不管具体数字是多少。

cues.en: And I said to Miguel and to the few people there, we have to do it for this price.
cues.zh: 于是我对米格尔以及在那儿的几个人说，我们必须以这个价格把工程做完。

cues.en: I said, you can't.
cues.zh: 我说，那是不可能的。

cues.en: We got five quotes.
cues.zh: 我们收到了五份报价。

cues.en: It's not the price.
cues.zh: 问题不在于价格。

cues.en: I said, well, how much is the floor?
cues.zh: 我说，那么，地板的价格是多少？

cues.en: And everybody's like, the floor is between $30,000 to $45,000 with these wood floors.
cues.zh: 大家都说，铺这种木地板的话，地板费用在30,000美元到45,000美元之间。

cues.en: It was an important part of the design.
cues.zh: 这是设计中非常重要的一部分。

cues.en: I said, why?
cues.zh: 我问，为什么？

cues.en: I said, what do you mean white?
cues.zh: 我又问，你说的白色是什么意思？

cues.en: These are the quotes.
cues.zh: 这些是报价单。

cues.en: He said, well, can you break down the quote for me?
cues.zh: 他说，你能把报价明细给我拆开看看吗？

cues.en: I said, what do you mean?
cues.zh: 我问，你什么意思？

cues.en: He said, well, how many pieces of floor?
cues.zh: 他说，比如地板要多少块？

cues.en: How many nails?
cues.zh: 需要多少颗钉子？

cues.en: How much glue?
cues.zh: 要用多少胶水？

cues.en: How much rubber?
cues.zh: 还要用多少橡胶？

cues.en: How many hours of work per person?
cues.zh: 每个人需要工作多少小时？

cues.en: How much does each person cost?
cues.zh: 每个人的成本是多少？

cues.en: No one could answer.
cues.zh: 没人能答上来。

cues.en: I said, okay, I have an idea of how we can negotiate this differently.
cues.zh: 我说，好吧，我知道该怎么用不同的方式来协商这件事了。

cues.en: I called the top three guys and said, I would like you to earn 15% above the cost.
cues.zh: 我给排名靠前的三个人打了电话，告诉他们我希望他们的报酬能在成本基础上高出15%。

cues.en: I think that's a fair margin, 15%.
cues.zh: 我觉得15%是个合理的利润空间。

cues.en: Do you agree?
cues.zh: 你们同意吗？

cues.en: So of course I agree.
cues.zh: 我当然同意了。

cues.en: It's like, great.
cues.zh: 他们都说太好了。

cues.en: And all three of them, by the way, said yes.
cues.zh: 顺便说一下，这三个人全都答应了。

cues.en: I said, great.
cues.zh: 我说，太好了。

cues.en: Well, I'm going to need to see the cost of each piece.
cues.zh: 嗯，我得先看看每项的成本是多少。

cues.en: I'm going to go quote it myself.
cues.zh: 我打算亲自去询价。

cues.en: I'm going to get to 15% very quickly.
cues.zh: 我的成本很快就能降到15%。

cues.en: The cost went down to that first floor instead of 30 to 45,000 was 12,000.
cues.zh: 成本降到了那一层，从3万到4.5万变成了1.2万。

cues.en: The guy says to me, Adam, no one's ever worked with me that way.
cues.zh: 那人对我说，亚当，从来没人用那种方式和我合作过。

cues.en: Before you know it, they joined us and we had our own internal construction company.
cues.zh: 不知不觉间，他们就加入了我们，我们还成立了自己的内部建筑公司。

cues.en: And we realized that only by controlling it could we get the right price and we're fast enough.
cues.zh: 我们意识到，只有通过掌控流程，才能拿到合适的价格，同时还能保证速度。

cues.en: So it's not taking no for an answer, but also using logic to really look into it.
cues.zh: 所以这不是直接接受拒绝，而是运用逻辑来深入分析问题。

cues.en: Now, it could be that if I looked into it, I wouldn't have been able to get a better price.
cues.zh: 也许如果我不去调查，就没办法拿到更低的报价。

cues.en: But what I'm describing is the challenge in construction in general and globally.
cues.zh: 但我所描述的是整个建筑行业乃至全球范围内都存在的挑战。

cues.en: And it's part of the things that Flow is solving today.
cues.zh: 这也是Flow如今正在解决的课题之一。

cues.en: Elon would call that like reasoning from first principles.
cues.zh: 埃隆会把这称作从第一性原理进行推理。

cues.en: I had a similar story.
cues.zh: 我也有过类似的经历。

cues.en: He would.
cues.zh: 他会的。

cues.en: He would call it like that.
cues.zh: 他会这么称呼它。

cues.en: And from what I know...
cues.zh: 据我所知……

cues.en: In Flow, we look up to Elon as an entrepreneur.
cues.zh: 在Flow公司，我们将埃隆视为一位企业家而敬仰他。

cues.en: We think he's unbelievable.
cues.zh: 我们认为他简直不可思议。

cues.en: And whenever someone gives Elon as an example, say, no one is Elon.
cues.zh: 每当有人以埃隆作为榜样时，我们总说没人能像埃隆那样。

cues.en: That's not an example we use.
cues.zh: 那不是我们可以借鉴的榜样。

cues.en: We just, we look at him for inspiration.
cues.zh: 我们只是以他为灵感来源。

cues.en: I happen to know that he can put an engineer, because I have a friend whose daughter works for him in SpaceX.
cues.zh: 我恰好知道他能够安排工程师专注处理一个问题，哪怕只是一个小螺丝、一个连接点，也能持续六个月。

cues.en: He can put an engineer to work on one problem for six months, one screw, one connection.
cues.zh: 但最终做出的成果并非NASA所做项目的两倍简单，反而简单了500倍，成本更低、速度更快，

cues.en: But the result ends up being not twice as simple as anything NASA has done, but like 500 times as simple and cheaper and faster and
cues.zh: 而且更轻。

cues.en: lighter.
cues.zh: 打火机。

cues.en: So yes, it's going back.
cues.zh: 没错，事情会回到原点。

cues.en: You can call it first principles.
cues.zh: 你可以把它称作基本原则。

cues.en: You can call it asking every question.
cues.zh: 你也可以把它称作不断提问。

cues.en: But if you're the entrepreneur and you're going to run, or if you're an employee or a partner, ask why.
cues.zh: 但如果你是创业者并要亲自掌舵，或是作为员工或合伙人，就要追问原因。

cues.en: People don't because they don't want to be rude or inconvenience others or they're too concerned with being liked.
cues.zh: 人们不这么做，是因为他们不想失礼、不想给他人带来不便，或是太在意是否会被喜欢。

cues.en: So pushing back on a supplier or, you know, conventional status quo in any way is seen to be inconvenient.
cues.zh: 所以，以任何方式对供应商或传统现状提出质疑，都会被视为给他人带来麻烦。

cues.en: I'm going to try to say a different reason why they're not.
cues.zh: 我打算说说他们不这么做的另一个原因。

cues.en: Because they don't ask themselves why.
cues.zh: 因为他们从不问自己为什么。

cues.en: It's going to go back.
cues.zh: 事情终究会回到原点。

cues.en: This discussion can keep going back to the same basics.
cues.zh: 这样的讨论会不断回到同样的基础问题。

cues.en: A person who's comfortable asking himself why is he doing something, questioning himself or herself.
cues.zh: 一个习惯于追问自己为何要做某事、习惯于自我质疑的人，

cues.en: seeing negative things, seeing problems, and then enjoying the process of growing out of them will have no problem asking someone else why.
cues.zh: 能够看到负面事物和问题，也能享受克服它们的过程，这样的人自然不会介意去问别人原因。

cues.en: And whenever you ask someone why and they don't want to answer you, what are you hiding?
cues.zh: 每当你问别人原因而他们不想回答时，他们到底在隐瞒什么？

cues.en: This is a discussion.
cues.zh: 这是一场讨论。

cues.en: I usually, when I go into topics like this, start by telling the vendor, wherever it is, I want you to make money.
cues.zh: 通常在探讨这类话题时，我首先会告诉供应商，无论他们在哪里，我都希望他们能盈利。

cues.en: No one's trying to make you lose money, but we're on a mission.
cues.zh: 没人想让你亏钱，但我们有共同的使命。

cues.en: And if I'm going to pay even 20% more than I should, then that's 20% less of another building, another community, another neighborhood that Flo is not going to take
cues.zh: 如果我愿意多付哪怕20%的费用，那就意味着弗洛不会参与建设另一栋建筑、另一个社区或另一个街区的20%项目。

cues.en: part in.
cues.zh: 参与其中。

cues.en: This really does make a lot of sense to me.
cues.zh: 这对我来说确实很有道理。

cues.en: We have this Slack channel in our company called Paper Walls.
cues.zh: 我们公司有个名为Paper Walls的Slack频道。

cues.en: And the whole idea is that we're trying to encourage our team to push on paper walls.
cues.zh: 其核心理念就是鼓励团队去冲击那些看似坚固实则全是纸做的‘纸墙’。

cues.en: A paper wall is something that looks solid, but reveals itself to be completely made of paper.
cues.zh: 纸墙看起来很结实，但实际上完全是由纸构成的。

cues.en: The minute you try it, you ask why you push on it.
cues.zh: 一旦你试着去推它，就会好奇自己为什么要推它。

cues.en: And there's a story of a kid that worked for me in one of my companies for four years.
cues.zh: 还有一个故事，讲的是我曾在其中一家公司工作过四年的一个孩子。

cues.en: And he animates video.
cues.zh: 他还负责制作视频动画。

cues.en: I said to him, how long is it going to take you to animate a video for us?
cues.zh: 我问他，为我们制作一个视频动画需要多长时间？

cues.en: That's 30 minutes.
cues.zh: 他说需要30分钟。

cues.en: He said it takes nine days.
cues.zh: 他却称需要九天时间。

cues.en: right?
cues.zh: 对吧？

cues.en: He worked for me for four years.
cues.zh: 他在我的公司工作了四年。

cues.en: It took him nine days to animate the video.
cues.zh: 他最终花了九天时间才完成那个视频动画。

cues.en: We decided we want to launch a weekly channel.
cues.zh: 我们决定要开设一个每周更新的频道。

cues.en: I need him to do it in three or four days max so that the rest of the team can do it.
cues.zh: 我要求他最多在三到四天内完成，这样其他团队成员就能接手了。

cues.en: I say to him, how long is it going to take you?
cues.zh: 我又问他，到底需要多长时间？

cues.en: He says nine days.
cues.zh: 他回答说需要九天。

cues.en: And then because we'd established this culture in our company of pushing on paper walls, I said to him, why?
cues.zh: 由于我们公司一直有突破各种限制的文化，我便问他为什么。

cues.en: Do you know what he said to me?
cues.zh: 你知道他跟我说了什么吗？

cues.en: I think I said something like, what would it take to do it in two?
cues.zh: 我记得我当时大概是这么问的，要怎么做才能在两天内完成？

cues.en: And he went, Stephen, you just need to buy me a new laptop.
cues.zh: 然后他说，斯蒂芬，你只要给我买台新笔记本电脑就行。

cues.en: I have an old laptop.
cues.zh: 我有一台旧笔记本电脑。

cues.en: I thought, fucking hell, I've been paying him for four years.
cues.zh: 我当时就想，见鬼，我都给他发工资四年了。

cues.en: And he's been, think about how much time I've lost in those four years, just simply because I didn't ask that question.
cues.zh: 而他则说，想想看这四年里我失去了多少时间，就因为我没有问过那个问题。

cues.en: But also to your point, he never mentioned it.
cues.zh: 不过就你说的这点而言，他确实从未提起过。

cues.en: He never knew he was in a paper wall himself.
cues.zh: 他自己也从未意识到自己正面临着‘纸墙’。

cues.en: First year of WeWork, we opened one building.
cues.zh: WeWork成立的第一年，我们只开了一栋楼。

cues.en: Year nine of WeWork, we opened two buildings a day.
cues.zh: WeWork成立第九年，我们每天能开两栋楼。

cues.en: In 130 cities, 50 countries, 70 languages, 100,000 square foot per building, so that's 200
cues.zh: 业务覆盖130个城市、50个国家，使用70种语言，每栋楼的面积达10万平方英尺，也就是说每天总共是200

cues.en: ,000 square foot a day, 20,000 square meter for your European listeners.
cues.zh: 万平方英尺，换算成欧洲听众能理解的单位就是2万立方米。

cues.en: A day.
cues.zh: 一天时间。

cues.en: A lot of the same people who were only capable of doing the one and two participants, were leaders by that time, of being able to do one of the fastest physical global growths
cues.zh: 那些当初只能处理一两个参与者的同一些人，那时已经成为了能够实现全球最快业务增长的领导者，

cues.en: the world's ever seen.
cues.zh: 是全世界前所未见的增长速度。

cues.en: Same people.
cues.zh: 还是那些人。

cues.en: As you learn to, in your words, go through paper worlds, as you learn that anything is possible, suddenly this is the secret of high growth and momentum.
cues.zh: 当你学会用你的话来说穿越虚拟世界，当你明白一切皆有可能时，这突然就成了实现高速增长和持续动力的秘诀。

cues.en: Whatever you can do today, if your company starts growing fast, you'll be shocked what you'll be able to do in three months, nine months, and in two years, you're going to look back and not believe
cues.zh: 无论你今天能做到什么，如果你的公司开始快速成长，你会对自己在三个月、九个月乃至两年后能做到的事情感到震惊，回首往事时简直不敢相信

cues.en: that that was your capacity.
cues.zh: 那竟曾是你的能力极限。

cues.en: And I keep telling people, and they tell me, oh, I can't do this, and this takes three months.
cues.zh: 我不断告诉人们，而他们也会跟我说，哦，我做不到，这需要三个月时间。

cues.en: I say, guys, I've seen this done before.
cues.zh: 我会说，伙计们，我以前见过有人做到过。

cues.en: Forget I know we can do it.
cues.zh: 别管了，我知道我们一定能做到。

cues.en: It's easier now.
cues.zh: 现在做起来更简单了。

cues.en: I've already been there.
cues.zh: 我已经经历过这种事了。

cues.en: Now you just need to believe.
cues.zh: 现在你只需要保持信念即可。

cues.en: And it goes back to the belief.
cues.zh: 而这一切归根结底还是信念的问题。

cues.en: Then we're going to need to put the systems and the processes.
cues.zh: 那么我们就得建立相应的体系与流程。

cues.en: And today with technology, and this is where I think AI is very exciting, you could shortcut a lot of these things and do a much better work.
cues.zh: 如今借助技术，这也是我认为人工智能如此令人兴奋的地方，因为可以绕过很多繁琐步骤，从而把工作做得更好。

cues.en: But back to what you said about your company.
cues.zh: 不过还是回到你提到的公司情况上。

cues.en: I bet, when's the last time you sat with them in a circle?
cues.zh: 我猜，你上一次和他们围坐在一起是什么时候？

cues.en: How many employees?
cues.zh: 有多少员工？

cues.en: About 200 in total.
cues.zh: 总共大概200人。

cues.en: So 200 is a big number.
cues.zh: 200确实是个不小的数字。

cues.en: But if you took 30 of them, sat in a room, and actually asked them, what are you working on personally?
cues.zh: 但如果你挑选30个人，把他们聚在一个房间里，真正询问他们个人正在忙什么工作？

cues.en: What is your internal paperwork?
cues.zh: 你们内部的文书工作有哪些？

cues.en: What is your internal challenge?
cues.zh: 你们内部面临的最大挑战是什么？

cues.en: What's stopping you?
cues.zh: 是什么在阻碍你？

cues.en: And they got comfortable talking about it.
cues.zh: 而且他们渐渐习惯于谈论这个问题了。

cues.en: And then as a group, first of all, all their peers would hear.
cues.zh: 随后作为一个团队，首先他们的同僚们都会听到。

cues.en: And before you know it, their peers would help them.
cues.zh: 不知不觉间，他们的同僚们就会开始帮助他们。

cues.en: Hey, I remember that you said that this is a child for you.
cues.zh: 嘿，我记得你说过这对你来说就像个孩子。

cues.en: You're insecure.
cues.zh: 你缺乏自信。

cues.en: You don't talk in public.
cues.zh: 你不敢在公开场合讲话。

cues.en: You're a little judgmental.
cues.zh: 你有点爱评判别人。

cues.en: You're too hard on yourself.
cues.zh: 你对自己太苛刻了。

cues.en: Every person has another story.
cues.zh: 每个人都有不同的经历。

cues.en: Before you know it, the moment you get them used to grow internally, it will affect your business to grow externally.
cues.zh: 不知不觉间，一旦让他们习惯了内在成长，就会影响到企业的外在发展。

cues.en: In WeWork, the business grew faster than I could grow.
cues.zh: 在WeWork，业务的发展速度比我自身的成长速度还要快。

cues.en: That's where everything went wrong.
cues.zh: 问题就在这里出现了。

cues.en: I actually think whenever a company grows faster than its founder, one of two things will occur.
cues.zh: 其实我觉得，每当一家公司的成长速度超过其创始人的成长速度时，通常会发生两件事之一。

cues.en: Either it will crash, because that's what happens, or if somehow miraculously that founder is able to keep it all together, in my experience,
cues.zh: 要么公司会崩溃，因为事实就是如此；要么如果那位创始人奇迹般地能够把一切掌控住，以我的经验来看，

cues.en: they're not fulfilled and happy.

cues.en: How important for the founders listening and for the people that want to build or become is hard work?

cues.en: Ah, by the way, new answer to that question.
cues.zh: 啊，顺便说一下，对于这个问题有个新的答案。

cues.en: It is the most important thing, but we have to define hard work.
cues.zh: 努力工作确实是最重要的，但我们必须先明确什么是努力工作。

cues.en: Hard work as a founder is not just limited to how many hours you put in the office.
cues.zh: 作为创始人，努力工作并不仅仅取决于你在办公室里待多少小时。

cues.en: Hardware as a founder is how much time do you put on the business?
cues.zh: 作为创始人，努力工作意味着你要为业务投入多少时间？

cues.en: How much time are you putting on yourself?
cues.zh: 那你又为自己投入了多少时间？

cues.en: As you grow, you will be a better leader.
cues.zh: 随着事业的发展，你会成为更出色的领导者。

cues.en: You will be a better money raiser.
cues.zh: 你也会成为更优秀的融资能手。

cues.en: You will express your business better.
cues.zh: 你能更出色地阐述自己的业务理念。

cues.en: So hard work is the only way to do it.
cues.zh: 所以努力工作是实现这些目标的唯一途径。

cues.en: And you can't be 50%.
cues.zh: 而且你绝不能只投入50%的精力。

cues.en: And here's something else that your founders know.

cues.zh: 当我必须决定是否要再次全身心投入时，之所以这么难，是因为我知道根本不存在投入80%或90%这种说法。

cues.en: in.
cues.zh: 投入。

cues.en: Either you're 100% in and you're all in.
cues.zh: 要么全情投入100%，要么就别做。

cues.en: or it's not going to work.
cues.zh: 否则事情根本行不通。

cues.en: So how important is hard work?
cues.zh: 那么努力工作到底有多重要？

cues.en: Most important thing.
cues.zh: 是最重要的事情。

cues.en: What is hard work?
cues.zh: 什么是努力工作？

cues.en: Some of it is on you.

cues.zh: 顺便说一句，对于那些有孩子的听众，要是你不知道自己该努力什么，就听听你的孩子吧。

cues.en: There you were alluding to this like sort of magical thing that happens when one focuses on something.
cues.zh: 你刚才提到过，当一个人全神贯注于某件事时，就会产生某种神奇的效果。

cues.en: You were saying if you're like 90% in, it doesn't work.
cues.zh: 你是说如果只投入90%的精力，是行不通的；

cues.zh: 但要是投入100%的精力，就能成功。

cues.en: There's no time for questions.

cues.en: There's no time for fear because you're so in it.

cues.zh: 而如果你真的做到了，取得了某项成就，那也还远未发挥出你的潜力。

cues.en: But again, I'm redefining what 100% in meant.
cues.zh: 不过我还是在重新定义‘全情投入’的含义。

cues.zh: 我们谈过沃伦·巴菲特。

cues.zh: 他难道没有全情投入吗？

cues.en: No way.

cues.en: He keeps it open so he can have the important meetings, so he can read, so he can connect.
cues.zh: 他让办公室保持开放状态，这样就能召开重要会议、阅读，还能与人交流。

cues.en: There are different ways to be 100% in.
cues.zh: 全情投入有不同的方式。

cues.en: But you must, in life, in my opinion, be 100% in.
cues.zh: 但在我看来，人生中必须做到全情投入。

cues.zh: 我们会准备好演示文稿。

cues.en: We send them to them a few days before they actually read them.
cues.zh: 在实际阅读之前几天就把它们发给他们。

cues.en: And then they come for the meeting.
cues.zh: 然后他们就会来参加会议。

cues.en: So it's like 8.30 to 5.
cues.zh: 时间大概是从8点30分到5点。

cues.en: And then when it's done, I go to dinner with the two of them.
cues.zh: 会议结束后，我会和他们两人一起去吃晚饭。

cues.en: And the dinner starts by me saying, we sit down, usually wherever it is, please tell me what I can do better.
cues.zh: 晚餐一开始，我通常会先说，请坐，无论在哪儿，都请告诉我有哪些地方我可以改进。

cues.en: And the first time I asked them, they were a little bit uncomfortable.
cues.zh: 我第一次向他们提出请求时，他们显得有些为难。

cues.en: The second time, I literally remember Mark going like this, Mark Andrews, like this, like he was ready.
cues.zh: 第二次，我清楚地记得马克是这个反应，马克·安德鲁斯，就是那种已经做好准备的姿态。

cues.en: Ben taking out his notes.
cues.zh: 本拿出了他的笔记。

cues.en: That's a true partnership.
cues.zh: 那才是真正的合作伙伴关系。

cues.en: And we do it every single time.
cues.zh: 而且我们每次都会这么做。

cues.en: And when you have the previous, you said some of the biggest investors, in my opinion, A16Z, number one investor in the planet.
cues.zh: 之前你说过，依我看最顶尖的投资者当属A16Z，那是全球排名第一的投资机构。

cues.en: And if you're an entrepreneur today, and you can, that's where you want your money from.
cues.zh: 如果现在是创业者，而且条件允许，那当然希望从这类机构获得资金。

cues.en: If you're an entrepreneur today, and you take it from Benchmark, the company that took me out, that took Travis, superstar out, Jack Dorsey out.
cues.zh: 要是现在的创业者选择从Benchmark融资，那可就错了，这家公司可是曾投资过我、特拉维斯，还有杰克·多西这些行业巨星的。

cues.en: Travis from Uber.
cues.zh: 特拉维斯，来自Uber。

cues.en: Travis from Uber.
cues.zh: 特拉维斯，来自Uber。

cues.en: Jack Dorsey from Square, Twitter, Block, and many more, and many more.
cues.zh: 杰克·多西，来自Square、Twitter、Block以及更多其他公司。

cues.en: So when you choose your investors, look at their history.
cues.zh: 所以选择投资者时，一定要考察他们的过往记录。

cues.en: Are they the kind that support entrepreneurs like you?
cues.zh: 他们是那种会支持像你这样的创业者的吗？

cues.en: Are they going to take you to the next level?
cues.zh: 他们能帮你迈向新的高度吗？

cues.en: Or do they have a history that actually clashes with the entrepreneur?
cues.zh: 还是说他们的过往经历实际上与创业者相冲突？

cues.en: If they have a history that clashes with the entrepreneur, park them.
cues.zh: 如果他们的过往与创业者相冲突，那就避开他们。

cues.en: So there was two key things I pulled out from there.
cues.zh: 所以我从这些经验中总结出了两点关键点。

cues.en: The first was around this idea of like knowing when to go fast and slow and use technology as an example.
cues.zh: 第一点就是关于何时该快速行动、何时该放缓节奏，以技术为例进行说明。

cues.en: The second thing, which was opened up the story about A16Z is the right people and partners.
cues.zh: 第二点，也就是A16Z的故事所揭示的，那就是找到合适的人选和合作伙伴。

cues.en: So important.
cues.zh: 这一点非常重要。

cues.en: More.
cues.zh: 还有更多。

cues.en: If I had to choose one, right investors, right employees, right partners, most important thing.
cues.zh: 如果非得选一个最重要的，那就是合适的投资者、合适的员工、合适的合作伙伴。

cues.en: What did you learn about employees?
cues.zh: 你对员工有什么新的认识？

cues.en: Like what is a great team member?
cues.zh: 比如，什么样的员工才是优秀的团队成员？

cues.en: If I have a problem with an employee, there's only one person to blame, and that's me.
cues.zh: 如果我和某位员工之间存在问题，唯一该受责备的人只有我自己。

cues.en: And what are the mistakes that you made in choosing employees?
cues.zh: 那么你在挑选员工时犯了哪些错误呢？

cues.en: I think it's how I was leading that I've been learning more about.
cues.zh: 我觉得我一直在反思自己的领导方式。

cues.en: Where I used to lead from top to bottom, I now am learning how to lead bottom to up.
cues.zh: 过去我总是自上而下地指挥，现在我正在学习如何自下而上地带领团队。

cues.en: What's the difference?
cues.zh: 这两者有什么区别？

cues.en: Top to bottom means you think because someone reports into you, they have to do what you say.
cues.zh: 自上而下的方式意味着你认为只要有人向你汇报工作，就必须照你说的做。

cues.en: But it's not true.
cues.zh: 但事实并非如此。

cues.en: This is not a dictatorship.
cues.zh: 这并不是独裁行为。

cues.en: They have free will.
cues.zh: 他们拥有自主选择权。

cues.en: They can go work.
cues.zh: 他们可以选择去别的地方工作。

cues.en: If you hired someone, they're really talented.
cues.zh: 如果你雇佣了真正有才华的人，

cues.en: They'll go work elsewhere, especially great leaders.
cues.zh: 他们很可能会去其他地方工作，尤其是那些优秀的领导者。

cues.en: The more talented they are, the more the top to bottom does not work.
cues.zh: 他们的才华越出众，上下级之间的协作就越不顺畅。

cues.en: They won't be willing to do it.
cues.zh: 他们不会愿意这么做。

cues.en: They shouldn't.
cues.zh: 他们也不该这么做。

cues.en: Great talent is not willing to be managed like this.
cues.zh: 优秀的人才不愿被如此管理。

cues.en: Great talent wants to be inspired, wants me to see the full version of themselves even more than they see it.
cues.zh: 优秀的人才渴望得到激励，他们希望我看到他们最真实的模样，甚至比他们自己更希望如此。

cues.en: And they want the room to make mistakes, but also to grow.
cues.zh: 他们希望有空间去犯错，同时也能从中成长。

cues.en: But they also need feedback.
cues.zh: 但他们也需要反馈。

cues.en: If you have someone amazing and they're fucking up, sorry, they're missed.
cues.zh: 如果你手头有非常出色的人，而他们却搞砸了事情，很遗憾，他们就被浪费了。

cues.en: You can swear.
cues.zh: 你可以咒骂几句。

cues.en: I can swear and my kids are going to listen.
cues.zh: 我尽管咒骂，我的孩子们还是会听我的。

cues.en: It's all good.
cues.zh: 没关系的。

cues.en: They're fucking up.
cues.zh: 他们正在搞砸事情。

cues.en: Are you going to tell them?
cues.zh: 你打算告诉他们吗？

cues.en: Or because you're not comfortable with conflict, you're going to wait for 90 days.
cues.zh: 还是因为你不擅长处理冲突，所以打算等90天？

cues.en: And every time they're going to make that mistake, you're going to get so upset that by the time you communicate to them, it's too late.
cues.zh: 每次他们犯错时，你都会非常生气，等到你再和他们沟通时已经为时过晚。

cues.en: The moment they made a mistake, if you respect them, give them the feedback because that's the best thing for them.
cues.zh: 他们一犯错，如果你尊重他们，就给他们反馈，因为这对他们才是最有利的。

cues.en: By the way, when you give them the feedback, give them room to give you feedback.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，给他们反馈时，也要给他们空间来给你反馈。

cues.en: If you're going to manage these employees and you want to attract the best talent in the world, remember that power comes
cues.zh: 如果你要管理这些员工，并且想吸引世界上最优秀的人才，要记住，权力来自

cues.en: from influence, not control.
cues.zh: 影响力，而非控制力。

cues.en: If you think they need to do what you said because you're their boss, you've already lost.
cues.zh: 如果你认为他们必须按你说的做只是因为你是他们的老板，那你就已经输了。

cues.en: And it's a matter of time until it doesn't work out.
cues.zh: 这种情况迟早会出问题。

cues.en: If they're okay with it, just because you're the boss, you have to tell them what they do and they accept that power.
cues.zh: 如果他们仅仅因为你是老板就愿意接受你安排的工作，那他们并没有真正理解那种权力。

cues.en: They're not the right employee for you, and you're not the right boss for them.
cues.zh: 他们不是适合你的员工，而你也不是适合他们的老板。

cues.en: There's no chance you're getting the best out of them.
cues.zh: 你根本不可能让他们发挥出最佳水平。

cues.en: One of the parts in your journey that I have reflected on a lot, because it's a fascinating story, is the day that you meet Massa
cues.zh: 在你的创业历程中，有一个故事让我反复思考，因为它非常精彩，那就是你与马萨见面的那一天。

cues.en: at SoftBank.
cues.zh: 那是在软银。

cues.en: And I'm keen to understand the context of where the business was before you met Massa at SoftBank.
cues.zh: 我很想了解在你在软银遇见马萨之前，这家公司的状况如何。

cues.en: That particular story has always inspired me for a multitude of different reasons.
cues.zh: 那个特定的故事因为种种原因一直激励着我。

cues.en: But where was the business at?
cues.zh: 但那时的公司处于什么状况呢？

cues.en: Was it, it was 2017?
I want to tell you about the day I met Massa and I'm going to connect it to, I think, the biggest mistake I ever made in WeWork.
cues.zh: 我想跟你们讲讲我遇见马萨的那一天，同时也会把它和我曾在WeWork犯下的最大错误联系起来。

cues.en: I'll bring it together.
cues.zh: 我会把这两者结合起来讲。

cues.en: Massa is one of the best investors in the world.
cues.zh: 马萨是世界上最优秀的投资者之一。

cues.en: It's also one of the biggest investors in the world.
cues.zh: 他也是全球规模最大的投资者之一。

cues.en: In my story, Massa is the hero, even though a lot of people who didn't know the story correctly might have misunderstood.
cues.zh: 在我的故事里，马萨是主角，尽管很多不了解全貌的人可能会误解这一点。

cues.en: So in my story, Massa took a bet on me and he did amazing and he deserved to have become very successful from it.
cues.zh: 在我的故事中，马萨对我下了赌注，他表现极为出色，也完全有理由因此取得巨大成功。

cues.en: And he leads SoftBank.
cues.zh: 而他正是软银的领导者。

cues.en: Massa is the leader of SoftBank.
cues.zh: Massa就是软银的掌舵人。

cues.en: So if you want a little history of Massa, Massa is the leader of SoftBank.
cues.zh: 如果要了解一点关于Massa的背景，他便是软银的领导者。

cues.en: He becomes very well known to the world where he buys a tech conference actually in Vegas.
cues.zh: 他在拉斯维加斯买下了一场科技大会，因此举世闻名。

cues.en: And he buys this tech conference for, I think, about $880 million.
cues.zh: 我记得他花了大约8.8亿美元买下了那场科技大会。

cues.en: And at the same time, he has his own tech businesses, and he owns a phone company, and he starts growing and growing.
cues.zh: 与此同时，他还拥有自己的科技企业，包括一家手机公司，而且业务不断扩张。

cues.en: He's famous to have gone to Steve Jobs and said, I'm going to take the iPhone.
cues.zh: 他因曾去找史蒂夫·乔布斯并说‘我要把iPhone拿过来’而广为人知。

cues.en: When the iPhone just came out, he knew it was going to be a hit, and I'm going to give it to every subscriber in Japan.
cues.zh: 在iPhone刚推出时，他就预见到它会大受欢迎，于是决定把它提供给日本的每一位用户。

cues.en: He invents the leasing model for it and gives an iPhone that everybody signs to his service because everybody wanted the iPhone.
cues.zh: 他设计了相应的租赁模式，让所有想要iPhone的人都能通过他的服务获得手机。

cues.en: It's a lot of things.
cues.zh: 他做的事情实在很多。

cues.en: And then he gives Jack Ma.
cues.zh: 之后他又把钱给了马云。

cues.en: $20 million that over time, I think, becomes $200.
cues.zh: 2000万美元，后来我觉得这个数字增长到了2亿美元。

cues.en: For Alibaba?
cues.zh: 是为了阿里巴巴吗？

cues.en: For Alibaba, which at its peak is worth about $80 billion.
cues.zh: 是为了阿里巴巴，它在巅峰时期的估值约为800亿美元。

cues.en: Wow.
cues.zh: 哇。

cues.en: So at the time when I meet Masa, this is 2016.
cues.zh: 我与Masa见面的时候是2016年。

cues.en: Let's start with the night before.
cues.zh: 让我们从前一天晚上说起。

cues.en: The night before I meet Masa in New York City, I have a board meeting the day before.
cues.zh: 在纽约与Masa见面前的那个晚上，前一天我还有董事会会议。

cues.en: This is the old board.
cues.zh: 这是老董事会的成员。

cues.en: And we're all sitting together.
cues.zh: 我们所有人都坐在一起。

cues.en: I just raised that $16.
cues.zh: 我刚刚把估值提升到了160亿美元。

cues.en: I raised maybe six months before at $16 billion valuation.
cues.zh: 大概在六个月前，我就把估值提升到了160亿美元。

cues.en: How big is WeWork?
cues.zh: WeWork的规模有多大？

cues.en: It's about to do that year about $950 million in revenue.
cues.zh: 那一年它的营收大约在9.5亿美元左右。

cues.en: And the reason I know is because we were doubled in revenue every single year.
cues.zh: 我知道这一点是因为我们的营收每年都会翻一番。

cues.en: So WeWork, the business model was working very well and the four walls were working very well.
cues.zh: 所以WeWork的商业模式运作得非常好，实体办公空间业务也同样表现优异。

cues.en: What's the distinction, sorry, between the four walls and everything else?
cues.zh: 不好意思，实体办公空间业务和其他业务之间有什么区别呢？

cues.en: You have a retail business.
cues.zh: 那就是零售业务。

cues.en: You could have your stores could be doing really well, but your state not making money.
cues.zh: 你的门店可能运营得很好，但公司整体却赚不到钱。

cues.en: And your what's not making?
cues.zh: 那什么部分赚不到钱？

cues.en: State.
cues.zh: 公司整体。

cues.en: So let's say you're in New York City.
cues.zh: 假设你在纽约市。

cues.en: So let's talk high growth for a second.
cues.zh: 那我们先来聊聊高增长的情况。

cues.en: When you're growing as fast as we're growing, you're always putting new buildings on the map.
cues.zh: 当你的发展速度像我们这样快时，总会在不同地方开设新门店。

cues.en: A new building has a ramp up.
cues.zh: 新门店需要一段时间来达到正常运营状态。

cues.en: Usually ramp up of a retail store or a food or a restaurant could take two years, three years.
cues.zh: 通常一家零售店、食品店或餐厅要达到正常运营状态需要两到三年的时间。

cues.en: And we like to talk about ROI, return on investment, and how long does it take.
cues.zh: 我们喜欢讨论投资回报率以及实现这一回报需要多长时间。

cues.en: A great time to return your investment would be 24 months, 36 months, and then it can grow.
cues.zh: 理想的回本周期为24个月或36个月，之后业务还能继续发展。

cues.en: WeWork at its peak was returning its money somewhere between six months to nine months.
cues.zh: WeWork在发展巅峰期时，回本时间大约在6个月到9个月之间。

cues.en: And then afterwards, it's going up to 12 months and 18 months.
cues.zh: 之后这一周期会延长到12个月乃至18个月。

cues.en: So if you're going to grow, we grew in New York City to 130 buildings.
cues.zh: 如果我们想要持续扩张，比如在纽约市我们就把门店数量增加到了130家。

cues.en: So you can have 30 buildings.
cues.zh: 所以你也可能只有30家门店。

cues.en: If the following year you're adding 30 more buildings, those new 30 have to, per definition, lose money for at least the first six months, if not nine months.
cues.zh: 如果第二年又新增30家门店，按照规律，这些新开的门店至少在头6个月，甚至9个月内都会出现亏损。

cues.en: So you could be very profitable in these buildings, but not profitable in these, because they need time.
cues.zh: 有些门店可能会盈利，而有些则不会，因为它们需要时间来盈利。

cues.en: which means New York City, the city, doesn't look as a city profitable.
cues.zh: 这意味着从整体来看，纽约市作为城市并不具备盈利性。

cues.en: Or the country, if you're looking at your P&L, doesn't look as a country profitable.
cues.zh: 同样，从整体利润表来看，整个国家也不具备盈利性。

cues.en: Which is why in a high-growth business, you've got to get very specific and in the details, and you've got to really understand what's working,
cues.zh: 正因如此，在一家高速发展的企业中，必须非常细致地分析各项数据，真正弄清楚哪些措施有效，

cues.en: what's not.
cues.zh: 哪些措施无效。

cues.en: Even in a building, you can have one floor that's profitable because you opened it first, and the new floor that you opened after, not profitable yet.
cues.zh: 即便在同一栋楼里，也可能有一层因为最先开业而盈利，而之后开业的楼层目前还无法盈利。

cues.en: WeWork's technology was never able to count this way.
cues.zh: WeWork的现有技术从来无法以这种方式进行统计。

cues.en: Flows technology, if I threw it on WeWork today, I could tell you which square foot is, I forget which building is profitable or which floor is profitable.
cues.zh: 如果把Flows技术应用到WeWork上，我就能告诉你哪块面积、我忘了是哪栋楼或哪层楼在盈利。

cues.en: I could tell you which corner.
cues.zh: 我甚至能指出是哪个角落。

cues.en: It knows everything because it's a connected system.
cues.zh: 因为它是一个相互关联的系统，所以能掌握所有信息。

cues.en: It's not disconnected.
cues.zh: 它并非相互孤立。

cues.en: Back to what we're saying.
cues.zh: 回到我们正在讨论的内容。

cues.en: I'm sitting with the board and we decide that we want to turn the business, we're going to go out and raise money, turn the business profitable and take
cues.zh: 我和董事会一起开会，决定要扭转业务状况，我们会出去筹集资金，让业务实现盈利，然后

cues.en: it public.
cues.zh: 将其上市。

cues.en: How are you going to turn it profitable?
cues.zh: 你们打算如何让它实现盈利？

cues.en: All you have to do in a high growth business that's working to turn it profitable is stop growing.
cues.zh: 对于一家正处于高速增长且运转良好的企业来说，要让它实现盈利，只需停止增长即可。

cues.en: You just stop adding new buildings and you give time to all the buildings to catch up.
cues.zh: 停止新增办公楼，给所有现有建筑足够的时间跟上发展步伐。

cues.en: Remember I explained that in WeWork your problem was not demand, it was supply.
cues.zh: 记得我之前说过，在WeWork的问题不在于需求，而在于供给。

cues.en: So the moment you don't add more supply, the demand is greater than the supply, everything fills up.
cues.zh: 所以一旦不再增加供给，需求就会超过供给，所有位置都会被占满。

cues.en: The moment everything fills up and you didn't add anything new, you go cash flow positive.
cues.zh: 一旦所有位置都被占满且没有新增任何供给，公司的现金流就会转为正数。

cues.en: As simple as that.
cues.zh: 就是这么简单。

cues.en: So we sit in that board and we decide that I'm going to go and raise, and the number was three to 400 million, stop the growth, meaning stop
cues.zh: 于是我们在董事会上决定由我去筹集资金，目标金额是3.4亿美元，同时要停止业务扩张，也就是停止

cues.en: signing leases, maybe even move to management deals, something we'll talk about in floor in a second, and then take

cues.en: Those businesses, all you had to do was stop growing.
cues.zh: 对于那些企业来说，只要停止扩张就行。

cues.en: We were at a high growth stage.
cues.zh: 那时我们正处于高速增长的阶段。

cues.en: That's what high growth entrepreneurs do.
cues.zh: 高速成长的创业者就是这么做的。

cues.en: That's what the market wanted at the time.
cues.zh: 那也是当时市场所期望的。

cues.en: And that's what everybody knew we were doing.
cues.zh: 而这也是大家所知道的我们的业务内容。

cues.en: It was not a secret what we were doing.
cues.zh: 我们的业务并非什么秘密。

cues.en: And it was growing exponentially.
cues.zh: 而且它的增长速度极快。

cues.en: So we ended up agreeing on $4.2 billion.
cues.zh: 最终我们确定了42亿美元的价格。

cues.en: He takes an iPad.
cues.zh: 他拿出一台iPad。

cues.en: He writes it all down.
cues.zh: 他把所有内容都记了下来。

cues.en: This is all in that same car ride.
cues.zh: 这一切都发生在那次同车出行期间。

cues.en: He writes it all down.
cues.zh: 他把所有内容都记了下来。

cues.en: He signs his name, and he hands me the pen to sign mine.
cues.zh: 他签上自己的名字，然后把笔递给我让我签字。

cues.en: I look at it.
cues.zh: 我看了看。

cues.en: I sign.
cues.zh: 我签了字。

cues.en: He walks out of the car, says thank you very much, and goes to his meeting.
cues.zh: 他走下车，说了声非常感谢，然后去开会了。

cues.en: This is now about 4054 Street.
cues.zh: 这里就是4054街了。

cues.en: RHQ is on 18th Street.
cues.zh: 总部位于18街。

cues.en: I'm just standing there.
cues.zh: 我就站在那儿。

cues.en: I can't believe what just happened.
cues.zh: 我简直不敢相信刚才发生的事。

cues.en: It was not what I planned.
cues.zh: 这并非我原本的计划。

cues.en: And I start walking.
cues.zh: 然后我开始走路。

cues.en: I was like, I'm going to walk downtown.
cues.zh: 我心想，我要往市中心走走。

cues.en: I'm going to take a second.
cues.zh: 我需要一点时间。

cues.en: I'm going to walk.
cues.zh: 我会继续走路的。

cues.en: And every step I take, because until this point, this is 2016, we were five years of mission-driven.
cues.zh: 我每走一步，都要记住，直到那时还是2016年，我们已坚持以使命为导向五年了。

cues.en: You ask me about the fundamentals, we had all the right fundamentals in WeWork because we had the right culture.
cues.zh: 如果你问我核心要素是什么，WeWork拥有所有正确的核心要素，因为我们拥有正确的企业文化。

cues.en: And when you have the right culture, you can deal with any challenge.
cues.zh: 而有了正确的企业文化，就能应对任何挑战。

cues.en: We were mission-driven.
cues.zh: 我们的行动始终以使命为导向。

cues.en: We could break through any wall.
cues.zh: 我们能够突破任何障碍。

cues.en: We were teamwork.
cues.zh: 我们注重团队协作。

cues.en: We were blatant.
cues.zh: 我们的行事风格十分直接。

cues.en: We were together.
cues.zh: 我们始终团结在一起。

cues.en: We were friends.
cues.zh: 我们是朋友。

cues.en: We were one team.
cues.zh: 我们是一个整体团队。

cues.en: And I'm starting to walk down from 54th Street to 18th Street.
cues.zh: 现在我正从第54街开始往第18街走。

cues.en: And every step I take, suddenly, the ego starts coming up.
cues.zh: 每走一步，自负的情绪就会突然冒出来。

cues.en: Oh, $20 billion valuation.
cues.zh: 哦，估值高达200亿美元。

cues.en: Billion valuation in Japan.
cues.zh: 在日本的估值也有数十亿美元。

cues.en: On top of that, billion and a half valuation in Southeast Asia.
cues.zh: 除此之外，东南亚地区的估值更是有15亿美元左右。

cues.en: On top of that, $5 billion valuation in China.
cues.zh: 除此之外，中国的估值还有50亿美元。

cues.en: On top of that.
cues.zh: 除此之外。

cues.en: So a billion of that $4.2 was going to everybody, including to myself.
cues.zh: 在42亿美元中，有10亿美元会分给所有人，包括我自己。

cues.en: And I owned about...
cues.zh: 而我当时大约持有...

cues.en: proportionately about 25% of the company at the time.
cues.zh: 按比例算大约占公司25%的股份。

cues.en: So big numbers, numbers.
cues.zh: 都是巨大的数字，庞大的数字。

cues.en: I've never seen numbers.
cues.zh: 我从来没见过这么大的数字。

cues.en: Miguel was getting a lot.
cues.zh: 米格尔得到的份额很多。

cues.en: All our employees, the investors, many times more than they ever invested from that billion.
cues.zh: 我们所有的员工、投资者，拿到的都比他们当初投入的那一百亿多出很多倍。

cues.en: And every step that I'm taking, the ego comes up.
cues.zh: 而我每走一步，自负心就会冒出来。

cues.en: Oh, I feel so strong.
cues.zh: 哦，我觉得自己如此强大。

cues.en: I feel so big.
cues.zh: 我觉得自己如此了不起。

cues.en: You start doing your own math, 20 billion, 25%.
cues.zh: 你开始自己算账，200亿，25%。

cues.en: That's 5 billion.
cues.zh: 那就是50亿了。

cues.en: Then there's all the other ones.
cues.zh: 还有其他所有的那些。

cues.en: What's my net worth?
cues.zh: 我的净资产是多少？

cues.en: And before you know it, The guy that sat in the car was a mission-driven entrepreneur who really believed
cues.zh: 不知不觉间，那个坐在车里的人已经变成了一位以使命为驱动的企业家，他真心相信

cues.en: in creating a world where people make a life and not just a living.
cues.zh: 致力于打造一个让人们能够在此安家生活而非仅仅谋生的世界。

cues.en: Every step that I take, it goes higher and higher.
cues.zh: 我迈出的每一步，都让我的地位越升越高。

cues.en: And by the time I walk into HQ, 18th Street, I forgot what
cues.zh: 等我走到总部18街的办公室时，已经忘了那件事是什么

cues.en: we were all about.
cues.zh: 我们一直都在追求这个目标。

cues.en: Here's why ego is on the one hand very good and on the other hand very dangerous.
cues.zh: 这就是为什么自负一方面非常有益，另一方面又极其危险的原因。

cues.en: Ego and desire are the same word.
cues.zh: 自负与欲望其实是同一个词。

cues.en: Big ego just means big desire.
cues.zh: 过大的自负只意味着过强的欲望。

cues.en: Having huge desire is important to build huge things, but you have to manage it and control it.
cues.zh: 拥有强烈的渴望对于创造伟大的事业固然重要，但你必须学会管理并控制它。

cues.en: When I walked in, I got confused.
cues.zh: 当我走进去时，感到十分困惑。

cues.en: It suddenly became about the money.
cues.zh: 事情突然就变成了关于金钱的问题。

cues.en: All the stuff that Rebecca told me, all the stuff when we met, all the years of spiritual practice, everything, to the garbage.
cues.zh: 丽贝卡告诉我的所有话、我们见面时说的所有内容、这些年来我的所有心灵修炼，全都变成了无用之物。

cues.en: And what happens when the ego gets the best of you?
cues.zh: 那么当自负占据上风时会发生什么？

cues.en: You become blinded.
cues.zh: 你就会变得眼花看不清。

cues.en: What does that mean?
cues.zh: 那是什么意思？

cues.en: You make mistakes and bad decisions.
cues.zh: 你会犯错并做出糟糕的决定。

cues.en: And in a high-growth business, you need to make 100 decisions a day.
cues.zh: 在一家高速发展的企业里，你每天需要做出100个决策。

cues.en: And as we said before, at least 98 of them need to be correct.
cues.zh: 正如我们之前所说，其中至少有98个必须是正确的。

cues.en: Suddenly, you're blinded, and suddenly only 95 of them are correct, or 90.
cues.zh: 突然间你就看不清了，正确的决策数量可能只剩下95个，甚至是90个。

cues.en: Those mistakes, because you're growing so fast, the mistakes grow very fast also.
cues.zh: 由于发展速度如此之快，这些错误也会以同样的速度不断出现。

cues.en: The other thing, we were a company led from the top.
cues.zh: 另一点是，我们那家公司是由高层直接领导的。

cues.en: All great companies are led from the top.
cues.zh: 所有伟大的公司都是由高层来引领的。

cues.en: The one I lost it, everybody lost it.
cues.zh: 我失去了它，所有人也都失去了它。

cues.en: And it just spread.
cues.zh: 然后这种情况就迅速蔓延开了。

cues.en: And the moment, that's the beginning of the end.
cues.zh: 那一刻，就是走向终结的起点。

cues.en: And look, it took three years after that for everything to unfold, but it was that moment that was the moment that went.
cues.zh: 你看，之后过了三年所有事情才逐渐明朗，但正是那个时刻一切都出了问题。

cues.en: Is there anything that could have been said or done to have made you, when Masa offered you that $4 billion in that cab, are you ready
cues.zh: 当时有没有什么话可以说或什么事可以做，能让你在马萨那辆出租车里听到他开出40亿美元的条件时，就立刻准备好接受这个提议？

cues.en: for this?
cues.zh: 准备好面对这一切了吗？

cues.en: Sure.
cues.zh: 当然。

cues.en: I used to be closer.
cues.zh: 我以前和他们更亲近。

cues.en: We don't speak as much anymore today.
cues.zh: 现在我们不再像以前那样频繁交流了。

cues.en: I used to be much closer to Mark Benioff, the founder of Salesforce.
cues.zh: 我曾经和Salesforce的创始人马克·贝尼奥夫关系更为密切。

cues.en: He heard about Masa's offer and he called me and said, Adam, I only know you for a little bit and I know you're not going to listen to my advice, but
cues.zh: 他听说了麻萨的报价后给我打电话，说：亚当，我认识你的时间不长，也知道你不会听我的建议，但是

cues.en: I want you to fly to Japan and say no to Masa.
cues.zh: 我希望你飞往日本，拒绝麻萨的提议。

cues.en: I want you to take your company public.
cues.zh: 我希望你让公司上市。

cues.en: What was your last valuation?
cues.zh: 你上次的公司估值是多少？

cues.en: I said 16.
cues.zh: 我说的是16亿。

cues.en: He goes, great.
cues.zh: 他说，很好。

cues.en: I want you to take your company public for 5 billion.
cues.zh: 我希望你以50亿的价格让公司上市。

cues.en: I want you to sell 20% of it, a billion.
cues.zh: 我希望你出售20%的股份，也就是10亿。

cues.en: And I want you to learn how to be public CEO.
cues.zh: 而且我希望你能学会如何担任上市公司CEO。

cues.en: I promise you two things.
cues.zh: 我向你保证两件事。

cues.en: One, because your last valuation was 16 at five, everybody's going to think this is a great deal.
cues.zh: 第一，因为你们上次估值是5亿时的16亿，大家都会认为这是个非常划算的交易。

cues.en: People are going to rush to invest, including myself.
cues.zh: 包括我在内，大家都会争相投资。

cues.en: Everyone's going to rush to invest.
cues.zh: 所有人都会争相投资。

cues.en: You'll learn because it's very different to be public CEO and a private CEO.
cues.zh: 你会慢慢明白的，因为担任上市公司CEO和私人公司CEO是完全不同的体验。

cues.en: You're going to learn about profitability.
cues.zh: 你会学会如何提升盈利能力。

cues.en: You're going to learn all these things because I think you're a very fast student.
cues.zh: 你会掌握所有这些知识，因为我觉得你是个学得很快的人。

cues.en: And I guarantee you, before you know it, your valuation will be much larger.
cues.zh: 我向你保证，用不了多久，你的公司估值就会大幅上升。

cues.en: And he said, but I know you're not going to listen to me.
cues.zh: 他说，但我知道你不会听我的。

cues.en: And I didn't.
cues.zh: 我确实没有听。

cues.en: Was there a world that I could have said no?
cues.zh: 有哪种情况是我可以拒绝的吗？

cues.en: Not the kind of person that I was then and not with the tools I have.
cues.zh: 以我当时的性格，再加上没有现有的资源，是不可能的。

cues.en: Why didn't you listen to him?
cues.zh: 你为什么没听他的？

cues.en: We didn't know each other for long enough.
cues.zh: 我们相识的时间还不够长。

cues.en: I think it takes a lot of trust to listen to when someone gives you a counter advice.
cues.zh: 我觉得，要听进别人提出的反对意见，需要极大的信任。

cues.en: And by the way, there was another person also said no, but we'll put that aside for a second.
cues.zh: 顺便说一下，还有另一个人也说了反对，但我们暂且先不讨论那个。

cues.en: But here's what I think is more important about it.
cues.zh: 不过我觉得其中更关键的一点是。

cues.en: Let's say I said no.
cues.zh: 假设我当时拒绝了。

cues.en: And let's say WeWork would still be around.
cues.zh: 再假设WeWork依然存在。

cues.en: WeWork would be a $100 billion company today.
cues.zh: 如今WeWork会是一家价值1000亿美元的公司。

cues.en: Corona would have happened.
cues.zh: 新冠疫情依然会发生。

cues.en: We would have renegotiated all of our leases.
cues.zh: 我们会重新协商所有的租约。

cues.en: That of leases would become management deals.
cues.zh: 那些租约会变成管理协议。

cues.en: And we would have led the return to office.
cues.zh: 而且我们会引领员工重返办公室的趋势。

cues.en: We would have led that concept because obviously people work.
cues.zh: 我们会带头推行这个理念，因为显然人们还是需要到办公室工作。

cues.en: I know we spoke about it much better face-to-face than remote work.
cues.zh: 我知道我们讨论过，面对面交流远比远程办公更有效。

cues.en: And we would have been the leaders of the movement of return to office.
cues.zh: 我们会成为推动员工重返办公室运动的领头者。

cues.en: And WeWork was a great company.
cues.zh: WeWork曾是一家非常出色的公司。

cues.en: And even it would have launched WeLive, so a version of Flow.
cues.zh: 它甚至还会推出WeLive，也就是Flow的一个版本。

cues.en: But I had them.
cues.zh: 但我已经拥有了它们。

cues.en: wouldn't have learned all those lessons.
cues.zh: 也就不会学到那些经验教训了。

cues.en: I wouldn't be, I am so much happier today.
cues.zh: 我现在的幸福程度要高得多。

cues.en: Even as we're speaking, I'm noticing your discussion, like everything you're talking to me about makes me feel full.
cues.zh: 就在我们交谈的此刻，我注意到你们的讨论，你们跟我说的每一件事都让我感到心满意足。

cues.en: Even the challenging parts, I am so happy that they happened because they made me exactly who I'm meant to be.
cues.zh: 就连那些充满挑战的时光，我也很高兴它们发生过，因为它们造就了现在的我。

cues.en: Falling is not bad.
cues.zh: 跌倒并不是坏事。

cues.en: That's the thing that you and I are actually talking about.
cues.zh: 这正是你和我真正要探讨的话题。

cues.en: Falling is probably the most important part of life.
cues.zh: 跌倒或许才是人生中最重要的一部分。

cues.en: And most of us learn a lot more from falling than we do from succeeding.
cues.zh: 我们大多数人从跌倒中获得的收获，远比从成功中获得的更多。

cues.en: The thing that's bad is not when you fall.
cues.zh: 糟糕的并不是跌倒本身。

cues.en: It's how you get up.
cues.zh: 关键在于你如何重新站起来。

cues.en: If you just fell and you're, oh no, everybody saw me fall.
cues.zh: 如果你只是摔倒了，然后心里想着‘糟了，大家都看到我摔倒了’。

cues.en: I'm not going to hide under the covers for four years until everybody forgets whatever it is that happened.
cues.zh: 我可不会躲在被子下四年，直到所有人都忘记发生过的事。

cues.en: That's what's horrible.
cues.zh: 这才是最可怕的部分。

cues.en: That leads to the tragedy.
cues.zh: 这会引发悲剧。

cues.en: That leads to the trauma.
cues.zh: 这会造成心理创伤。

cues.en: If you fell, you look around, you're like, wow, everybody saw.
cues.zh: 如果你摔倒了，环顾四周就会发现，哇，大家都看到了。

cues.en: You clean up.
cues.zh: 你把身上弄干净。

cues.en: You get up and you say, let's do it again.
cues.zh: 然后站起来，说‘我们再试一次’。

cues.en: If you have that in you, nothing will stop you.
cues.zh: 只要你有这份决心，就没有什么能阻挡你。

cues.en: And it might take 10 times and 20 times and 50 times.
cues.zh: 可能需要尝试十次、二十次，甚至五十次。

cues.en: But if you fall enough times, then you might avoid falling.
cues.zh: 但只要摔得足够多，或许就能避免再次摔倒。

cues.en: There should be a button just down below here.
cues.zh: 应该就在这下面有个按钮。

cues.en: And if it says subscribe, you're already subscribed.
cues.zh: 如果上面显示的是订阅，那就说明你已经订阅了。

cues.en: If it says subscriber, that means you're not yet.
cues.zh: 如果显示的是订阅者，那就意味着你还没有订阅。

cues.en: And if you're not subscribed, please could you do us a favor and hit that button?
cues.zh: 如果你还没有订阅，能不能麻烦你按一下那个按钮？

cues.en: It helps the show more than you know.
cues.zh: 这对节目带来的帮助比你想象的要大得多。

cues.en: And according to the algorithm, you're someone that watches our show, but you haven't yet hit that button.
cues.zh: 根据算法，你是会观看我们节目的人，但还没有点击过那个按钮。

cues.en: Thank you so much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢。

cues.en: I'm thinking also about a founder that's 21 years old.
cues.zh: 我也在考虑一位21岁的创业者。

cues.en: They've got a startup or an idea that they want to start.
cues.zh: 他们有一个初创公司或者想要启动的一个想法。

cues.en: Like when I was 21 years old, my mom tells me, well, 18, if you do this, I won't speak to you again.
cues.zh: 就像我21岁的时候，我妈妈跟我说，18岁的时候如果你这么做，我就再也不跟你说话了。

cues.en: She was warning me against business because she had struggled in business herself.
cues.zh: 她是想警告我不要经商，因为她自己也曾经历过经商的困境。

cues.en: So that's a proxy of love, I guess.
cues.zh: 我想，那大概就是一种爱的体现吧。

cues.en: And then you've got other people here telling you that it's going to be amazing and you're going to make millions.
cues.zh: 然后还会有人跟你说这一定会非常棒，你能赚数百万。

cues.en: When you're in that situation, you've got noise.
cues.zh: 处于那种情况下时，周围全是杂音。

cues.en: How do you find the signal?
cues.zh: 那要如何找到真正的信号呢？

cues.en: Two ways.
cues.zh: 有两种方法。

cues.en: One, they have to go back to the mission.
cues.zh: 第一，他们必须回归最初的使命。

cues.en: So if one had a mission and then someone offers them something and it's off mission, and you're like, oh, I'm going to do it anyway because it's good
cues.zh: 所以如果一个人有明确的使命，却有人提出一些偏离使命的事情，而你还是会想，好吧，反正这事儿有好处，我还是会去做。

cues.en: money, but it's off mission, that already is a warning sign.
cues.zh: 哪怕能赚钱，但若偏离了使命，那本身就是个警示信号。

cues.en: But I think the other one, which is something that I have more today than I used to back then, one needs a practice.
cues.zh: 不过我觉得另一种方法——现在我比过去更常采用这种方法——就是需要坚持练习。

cues.en: Part of the way to drown the noise is with a practice.
